title: Density of polynomials whose Aron–Berner extensions attain their norms
summary: A machine-checked proof, in Lean 4 with Mathlib, of the polynomial Lindenstrauss theorem: for every real or complex Banach space X and every n ≥ 1, the n-homogeneous polynomials whose Aron–Berner extensions attain their norms are dense, for scalar and for vector values.

article.title: Density of polynomials whose Aron–Berner extensions attain their norms

statements.label: thm:main
statements.latex:
Let $X$ be a real or complex Banach space and let $n\ge1$. The set of all $P\in\Pn$ whose canonical extensions to $X^{**}$ attain their norms is dense in $\Pn$. More precisely, for every $P\in\Pn$ and every $\eps>0$ there exist $Q\in\Pn$ and $z\in B_{X^{**}}$ such that
\[
 \norm{Q-P}<\eps,
 \qquad
 |\widetilde Q(z)|=\norm{\widetilde Q}=\norm Q.
\]
statements.note: Proved for any RCLike field, so over ℝ and ℂ at once; X need not be complete. The density statement is also given with a sequence Qₖ → P.

statements.label: lem:isometry
statements.title: {\cite[Theorem~3]{DG}}
statements.latex: For every $P\in\Pn$, the canonical extension satisfies $\norm{\widetilde P}=\norm P$. The map $P\mapsto\widetilde P$ is linear.
statements.note: The article cites Davie and Gamelin; the formalization proves their argument for both scalar fields, scalar- and vector-valued.

statements.label: lem:K
statements.note: Proved by compactness of the unit sphere of the coefficient space instead of Vandermonde interpolation.

statements.label: lem:geometry
rem:real
statements.latex:
Under the hypotheses of Lemma~\ref{lem:geometry}, if $\K=\R$, then
\begin{equation}
 |\check P(u_1,\ldots,u_n)|\ge M-C_nE,
 \qquad C_n=D_n\bigl(1+2n(n-1)c_n\bigr).
\end{equation}
For $E\ge M$ the assertion is trivial because $C_n\ge1$. For $0\le E<M$, retain the notation $\rho$, $\xi$, $\upsilon$, $y_i$ and $v_i$ from the proof of Lemma~\ref{lem:geometry}. For real numbers $\xi,\upsilon$ one has
\[
 |\xi-\upsilon|+|\xi+\upsilon|=2\max\{|\xi|,|\upsilon|\}\le2 :
\]
if $\xi$ and $\upsilon$ have the same sign, then $|\xi+\upsilon|=|\xi|+|\upsilon|$ and $|\xi-\upsilon|=\bigl||\xi|-|\upsilon|\bigr|$, and otherwise the two expressions exchange their roles. Since $|\xi+\upsilon|\ge2(1-\rho)^{1/n}$ by the first part of that proof, and $(1-\rho)^{1/n}\ge1-\rho$, it follows that
\[
 |\xi-\upsilon|\le2\bigl[1-(1-\rho)^{1/n}\bigr]\le2\rho.
\]
Thus \eqref{eq:compatibility} holds with $2\rho$ in place of $2\sqrt\rho$, and the comparison argument leading to \eqref{eq:convexdistance} gives $\norm{y_1-v_1}\le2(n-1)\rho$. Moreover $P(y_1)$ is real and $M-E\le P(y_1)\le M$, so $|P(y_1)-M|\le E$. Hence, by \eqref{eq:lipschitz} and $M\rho=E$,
\[
 |P(v)-M|\le nc_nM\cdot2(n-1)\rho+E=\bigl(1+2n(n-1)c_n\bigr)E
 \quad\bigl(v\in\conv\{z_1,\ldots,z_n\}\bigr)
\]
in place of \eqref{eq:flat}, and the finite-difference argument at the end of the same proof yields \eqref{eq:realbound}. In the real version of the main proof, \eqref{eq:stageMixed} is then replaced by $|A_j(x_{i_1},\ldots,x_{i_n})|\ge M_j-C_n\Gamma_n\alpha_j$, and one may take
\[
 \eta_j=\bigl(C_n\Gamma_n+4c_n+4\bigr)\alpha_j
\]
instead of \eqref{eq:eta}. The rest of the proof remains the same.

statements.label: thm:vector
statements.latex:
Let $X$ and $Y$ be Banach spaces over $\K$ and let $n\ge1$. The set of all $P\in\PnY$ whose canonical extensions attain their norms is dense in $\PnY$. More precisely, for every $P\in\PnY$ and every $\eps>0$ there exist $Q\in\PnY$ and $z\in B_{X^{**}}$ such that
\[
 \norm{Q-P}<\eps,
 \qquad
 \norm{\widetilde Q(z)}=\norm{\widetilde Q}=\norm Q.
\]
statements.note: Only the codomain Y is assumed complete. For Y = 𝕂 it gives Theorem 2.1, which is how the formal proof obtains the scalar case.

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.alpha
declarations.signature: def alpha (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.source: def alpha (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : ℝ := a ^ (2 ^ k)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.alpha_zero
declarations.signature: lemma alpha_zero (a : ℝ) : alpha a 0 = a
declarations.source: lemma alpha_zero (a : ℝ) : alpha a 0 = a := by simp [alpha]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.alpha_pos
declarations.signature: lemma alpha_pos (ha : 0 < a) (k : ℕ) : 0 < alpha a k
declarations.source: lemma alpha_pos (ha : 0 < a) (k : ℕ) : 0 < alpha a k := pow_pos ha _

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.alpha_succ
declarations.signature: lemma alpha_succ (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : alpha a (k + 1) = alpha a k ^ 2
declarations.source:
lemma alpha_succ (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : alpha a (k + 1) = alpha a k ^ 2 := by
  simp only [alpha, pow_succ, pow_mul]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.alpha_le
declarations.signature: lemma alpha_le (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) (k : ℕ) : alpha a k ≤ a
declarations.source:
lemma alpha_le (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) (k : ℕ) : alpha a k ≤ a := by
  unfold alpha
  calc a ^ (2 ^ k) ≤ a ^ 1 := pow_le_pow_of_le_one ha0 ha1 (Nat.one_le_two_pow)
    _ = a := pow_one a

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.alpha_anti
declarations.signature:
lemma alpha_anti (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) {k m : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) :
    alpha a m ≤ alpha a k
declarations.source:
lemma alpha_anti (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) {k m : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) :
    alpha a m ≤ alpha a k :=
  pow_le_pow_of_le_one ha0 ha1 (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hkm)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.alpha_add_le
declarations.signature:
lemma alpha_add_le (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) (k i : ℕ) :
    alpha a (k + i) ≤ alpha a k ^ (i + 1)
declarations.source:
lemma alpha_add_le (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) (k i : ℕ) :
    alpha a (k + i) ≤ alpha a k ^ (i + 1) := by
  unfold alpha
  rw [pow_add, pow_mul]
  exact pow_le_pow_of_le_one (pow_nonneg ha0 _) (pow_le_one₀ ha0 ha1)
    (Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := i))

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.tendsto_alpha
declarations.signature: lemma tendsto_alpha (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a < 1) : Tendsto (alpha a) atTop (𝓝 0)
declarations.source:
lemma tendsto_alpha (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a < 1) : Tendsto (alpha a) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have h : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => a ^ (k + 1)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one ha0 ha1).comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  apply squeeze_zero (fun k => (pow_pos' ha0 k)) _ h
  intro k
  have := alpha_add_le ha0 ha1.le 0 k
  simpa [alpha_zero] using this
where
  pow_pos' (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ alpha a k := pow_nonneg ha0 _

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.tendsto_alpha.pow_pos'
declarations.signature: pow_pos' (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ alpha a k
declarations.source: pow_pos' (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ alpha a k := pow_nonneg ha0 _

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.geom_bound
declarations.signature:
lemma geom_bound {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx : x ≤ 1 / 2) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range N, x ^ (i + 1) ≤ 2 * x - 2 * x ^ (N + 1)
declarations.source:
lemma geom_bound {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx : x ≤ 1 / 2) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range N, x ^ (i + 1) ≤ 2 * x - 2 * x ^ (N + 1) := by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
    have : 2 * x ^ (N + 2) ≤ x ^ (N + 1) := by
      rw [pow_succ]
      nlinarith [pow_nonneg hx0 (N + 1)]
    linarith

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.sum_alpha_le
declarations.signature:
lemma sum_alpha_le (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1 / 2) (k N : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range N, alpha a (k + i) ≤ 2 * alpha a k
declarations.source:
lemma sum_alpha_le (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1 / 2) (k N : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range N, alpha a (k + i) ≤ 2 * alpha a k := by
  have hk0 : 0 ≤ alpha a k := pow_nonneg ha0 _
  have hk1 : alpha a k ≤ 1 / 2 := (alpha_le ha0 (by linarith) k).trans ha1
  calc ∑ i ∈ range N, alpha a (k + i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ range N, alpha a k ^ (i + 1) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => alpha_add_le ha0 (by linarith) k i
    _ ≤ 2 * alpha a k - 2 * alpha a k ^ (N + 1) := geom_bound hk0 hk1 N
    _ ≤ 2 * alpha a k := by nlinarith [pow_nonneg hk0 (N + 1)]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.sum_alpha_sq_le
declarations.signature:
lemma sum_alpha_sq_le (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1 / 2) (k N : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range N, alpha a (k + i) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * alpha a k ^ 2
declarations.source:
lemma sum_alpha_sq_le (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1 / 2) (k N : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range N, alpha a (k + i) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * alpha a k ^ 2 := by
  have h := sum_alpha_le ha0 ha1 (k + 1) N
  rw [alpha_succ] at h
  calc ∑ i ∈ range N, alpha a (k + i) ^ 2 = ∑ i ∈ range N, alpha a (k + 1 + i) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [← alpha_succ]; congr 1; ring
    _ ≤ 2 * alpha a k ^ 2 := h

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.prod_one_add_alpha
declarations.signature:
lemma prod_one_add_alpha (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (1 - a) * ∏ h ∈ range k, (1 + alpha a h) = 1 - alpha a k
declarations.source:
lemma prod_one_add_alpha (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (1 - a) * ∏ h ∈ range k, (1 + alpha a h) = 1 - alpha a k := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [alpha_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, ← mul_assoc, ih, alpha_succ]
    ring

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.MLin
declarations.signature:
abbrev MLin (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (X : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X]
    (Y : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace 𝕜 Y] (n : ℕ)
declarations.source:
abbrev MLin (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (X : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X]
    (Y : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace 𝕜 Y] (n : ℕ) :=
  ContinuousMultilinearMap 𝕜 (fun _ : Fin n => X) Y

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.diag
declarations.doc: The diagonal {lit}`x ↦ A (x, …, x)` of a multilinear map: the associated polynomial.
declarations.signature: def diag {n : ℕ} (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) (x : X) : Y
declarations.source: def diag {n : ℕ} (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) (x : X) : Y := A (fun _ => x)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.IsSymm
declarations.doc: A multilinear map is symmetric if it is invariant under permutations of its arguments.
declarations.signature: def IsSymm {n : ℕ} (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : Prop
declarations.source:
def IsSymm {n : ℕ} (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : Prop :=
  ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (v : Fin n → X), A (v ∘ σ) = A v

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.IsHomPoly
declarations.doc:
{lit}`P : X → Y` is a continuous {lit}`n`-homogeneous polynomial: {lit}`P x = L (x, …, x)` for some
continuous {lit}`n`-linear map {lit}`L`.
declarations.signature:
def IsHomPoly (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X]
    {Y : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace 𝕜 Y] (n : ℕ) (P : X → Y) : Prop
declarations.source:
def IsHomPoly (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X]
    {Y : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace 𝕜 Y] (n : ℕ) (P : X → Y) : Prop :=
  ∃ L : MLin 𝕜 X Y n, ∀ x, P x = L (fun _ => x)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.polyNorm
declarations.doc: The sup norm over the closed unit ball: {lit}`‖P‖ = sup_{‖x‖ ≤ 1} ‖P x‖`.
declarations.signature: def polyNorm {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] (P : E → F) : ℝ
declarations.source:
def polyNorm {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] (P : E → F) : ℝ :=
  sSup ((fun x => ‖P x‖) '' Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.polyNorm_nonneg
declarations.signature: lemma polyNorm_nonneg (P : E → F) : 0 ≤ polyNorm P
declarations.source:
lemma polyNorm_nonneg (P : E → F) : 0 ≤ polyNorm P := by
  apply Real.sSup_nonneg
  rintro _ ⟨x, -, rfl⟩
  exact norm_nonneg _

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.polyNorm_le
declarations.signature:
lemma polyNorm_le {P : E → F} {M : ℝ} (hM0 : 0 ≤ M) (h : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖P x‖ ≤ M) :
    polyNorm P ≤ M
declarations.source:
lemma polyNorm_le {P : E → F} {M : ℝ} (hM0 : 0 ≤ M) (h : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖P x‖ ≤ M) :
    polyNorm P ≤ M := by
  apply Real.sSup_le _ hM0
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  exact h x (by simpa using hx)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.norm_le_polyNorm
declarations.signature:
lemma norm_le_polyNorm {P : E → F} {M : ℝ} (h : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖P x‖ ≤ M) {x : E}
    (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) : ‖P x‖ ≤ polyNorm P
declarations.source:
lemma norm_le_polyNorm {P : E → F} {M : ℝ} (h : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖P x‖ ≤ M) {x : E}
    (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) : ‖P x‖ ≤ polyNorm P := by
  apply le_csSup
  · refine ⟨M, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact h y (by simpa using hy)
  · exact ⟨x, by simpa using hx, rfl⟩

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.exists_near_polyNorm
declarations.signature:
lemma exists_near_polyNorm {P : E → F} {δ : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) : ∃ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 ∧ polyNorm P - δ < ‖P x‖
declarations.source:
lemma exists_near_polyNorm {P : E → F} {δ : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) : ∃ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 ∧ polyNorm P - δ < ‖P x‖ := by
  have hne : ((fun x => ‖P x‖) '' Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1).Nonempty :=
    ⟨_, 0, by simp, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, hlt⟩ := exists_lt_of_lt_csSup hne (show polyNorm P - δ < polyNorm P by
    linarith)
  exact ⟨x, by simpa using hx, hlt⟩

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.diag_apply
declarations.signature: @[simp] lemma diag_apply (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) (x : X) : diag A x = A (fun _ => x)
declarations.source: @[simp] lemma diag_apply (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) (x : X) : diag A x = A (fun _ => x) := rfl

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.diag_add
declarations.signature: lemma diag_add (A B : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : diag (A + B) = diag A + diag B
declarations.source:
lemma diag_add (A B : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : diag (A + B) = diag A + diag B := by
  ext x; simp

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.diag_sub
declarations.signature: lemma diag_sub (A B : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : diag (A - B) = diag A - diag B
declarations.source:
lemma diag_sub (A B : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : diag (A - B) = diag A - diag B := by
  ext x; simp

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.diag_smul
declarations.signature: lemma diag_smul (c : 𝕜) (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : diag (c • A) = c • diag A
declarations.source:
lemma diag_smul (c : 𝕜) (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : diag (c • A) = c • diag A := by
  ext x; simp

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.diag_smul_arg
declarations.signature:
lemma diag_smul_arg (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) (c : 𝕜) (x : X) :
    diag A (c • x) = c ^ n • diag A x
declarations.source:
lemma diag_smul_arg (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) (c : 𝕜) (x : X) :
    diag A (c • x) = c ^ n • diag A x := by
  simp only [diag_apply]
  rw [show (fun _ : Fin n => c • x) = (fun i => (fun _ => c) i • (fun _ => x) i) from rfl,
    ContinuousMultilinearMap.map_smul_univ]
  simp

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.norm_apply_le_of_ball
declarations.signature:
lemma norm_apply_le_of_ball (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) {v : Fin n → X} (hv : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖A v‖ ≤ ‖A‖
declarations.source:
lemma norm_apply_le_of_ball (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) {v : Fin n → X} (hv : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖A v‖ ≤ ‖A‖ := by
  calc ‖A v‖ ≤ ‖A‖ * ∏ i, ‖v i‖ := A.le_opNorm v
    _ ≤ ‖A‖ * 1 := by
        gcongr
        exact Finset.prod_le_one₀ (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun i _ => hv i)
    _ = ‖A‖ := mul_one _

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.diag_bound
declarations.signature: lemma diag_bound (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : ∀ x : X, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖diag A x‖ ≤ ‖A‖
declarations.source:
lemma diag_bound (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : ∀ x : X, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖diag A x‖ ≤ ‖A‖ :=
  fun _ hx => norm_apply_le_of_ball A (fun _ => hx)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.norm_diag_le_polyNorm
declarations.signature:
lemma norm_diag_le_polyNorm (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) {x : X} (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖diag A x‖ ≤ polyNorm (diag A)
declarations.source:
lemma norm_diag_le_polyNorm (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) {x : X} (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖diag A x‖ ≤ polyNorm (diag A) :=
  norm_le_polyNorm (diag_bound A) hx

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.polyNorm_diag_le_opNorm
declarations.signature: lemma polyNorm_diag_le_opNorm (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : polyNorm (diag A) ≤ ‖A‖
declarations.source:
lemma polyNorm_diag_le_opNorm (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : polyNorm (diag A) ≤ ‖A‖ :=
  polyNorm_le (norm_nonneg _) (diag_bound A)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.norm_diag_le
declarations.signature:
lemma norm_diag_le (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) (x : X) :
    ‖diag A x‖ ≤ polyNorm (diag A) * ‖x‖ ^ n
declarations.source:
lemma norm_diag_le (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) (x : X) :
    ‖diag A x‖ ≤ polyNorm (diag A) * ‖x‖ ^ n := by
  rcases eq_or_ne x 0 with rfl | hx
  · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · simpa using norm_diag_le_polyNorm A (x := (0 : X)) (by simp)
    · have : diag A (0 : X) = 0 := by
        simp only [diag_apply]
        exact A.map_coord_zero ⟨0, hn⟩ rfl
      rw [this, norm_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg (polyNorm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
  · have hxpos : 0 < ‖x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hx
    set y : X := ((‖x‖⁻¹ : ℝ) : 𝕜) • x
    have hy : ‖y‖ ≤ 1 := by
      simp only [y, norm_smul, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_inv, abs_norm]
      rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hxpos.ne']
    have hxy : x = ((‖x‖ : ℝ) : 𝕜) • y := by
      simp only [y, smul_smul, ← RCLike.ofReal_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hxpos.ne',
        RCLike.ofReal_one, one_smul]
    rw [hxy, diag_smul_arg, norm_smul, norm_pow, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_norm, mul_comm]
    have := norm_diag_le_polyNorm A hy
    have h2 : ‖(((‖x‖ : ℝ) : 𝕜) • y)‖ = ‖x‖ := by rw [← hxy]
    rw [h2]
    gcongr

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.polyNorm_diag_add_le
declarations.signature:
lemma polyNorm_diag_add_le (A B : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) :
    polyNorm (diag (A + B)) ≤ polyNorm (diag A) + polyNorm (diag B)
declarations.source:
lemma polyNorm_diag_add_le (A B : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) :
    polyNorm (diag (A + B)) ≤ polyNorm (diag A) + polyNorm (diag B) := by
  apply polyNorm_le (add_nonneg (polyNorm_nonneg _) (polyNorm_nonneg _))
  intro x hx
  rw [diag_add, Pi.add_apply]
  exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (norm_diag_le_polyNorm A hx)
    (norm_diag_le_polyNorm B hx))

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.polyNorm_diag_smul
declarations.signature:
lemma polyNorm_diag_smul (c : 𝕜) (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) :
    polyNorm (diag (c • A)) = ‖c‖ * polyNorm (diag A)
declarations.source:
lemma polyNorm_diag_smul (c : 𝕜) (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) :
    polyNorm (diag (c • A)) = ‖c‖ * polyNorm (diag A) := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply polyNorm_le (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (polyNorm_nonneg _))
    intro x hx
    rw [diag_smul, Pi.smul_apply, norm_smul]
    gcongr
    exact norm_diag_le_polyNorm A hx
  · rcases eq_or_ne c 0 with rfl | hc
    · simp [polyNorm_nonneg]
    · have h : polyNorm (diag A) ≤ ‖c‖⁻¹ * polyNorm (diag (c • A)) := by
        apply polyNorm_le (mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (norm_nonneg _)) (polyNorm_nonneg _))
        intro x hx
        have h1 := norm_diag_le_polyNorm (c • A) hx
        rw [diag_smul, Pi.smul_apply, norm_smul] at h1
        rw [le_inv_mul_iff₀ (norm_pos_iff.mpr hc)]
        exact h1
      rw [le_inv_mul_iff₀ (norm_pos_iff.mpr hc)] at h
      exact h

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.polyNorm_diag_neg
declarations.signature: lemma polyNorm_diag_neg (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : polyNorm (diag (-A)) = polyNorm (diag A)
declarations.source:
lemma polyNorm_diag_neg (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : polyNorm (diag (-A)) = polyNorm (diag A) := by
  have := polyNorm_diag_smul (-1 : 𝕜) A
  simpa using this

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.polyNorm_diag_sub_comm
declarations.signature:
lemma polyNorm_diag_sub_comm (A B : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) :
    polyNorm (diag (A - B)) = polyNorm (diag (B - A))
declarations.source:
lemma polyNorm_diag_sub_comm (A B : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) :
    polyNorm (diag (A - B)) = polyNorm (diag (B - A)) := by
  rw [← neg_sub, polyNorm_diag_neg]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.polyNorm_diag_sub_le
declarations.signature:
lemma polyNorm_diag_sub_le (A B : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) :
    polyNorm (diag A) ≤ polyNorm (diag B) + polyNorm (diag (A - B))
declarations.source:
lemma polyNorm_diag_sub_le (A B : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) :
    polyNorm (diag A) ≤ polyNorm (diag B) + polyNorm (diag (A - B)) := by
  have := polyNorm_diag_add_le B (A - B)
  simpa using this

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.abs_polyNorm_diag_sub_le
declarations.signature:
lemma abs_polyNorm_diag_sub_le (A B : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) :
    |polyNorm (diag A) - polyNorm (diag B)| ≤ polyNorm (diag (A - B))
declarations.source:
lemma abs_polyNorm_diag_sub_le (A B : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) :
    |polyNorm (diag A) - polyNorm (diag B)| ≤ polyNorm (diag (A - B)) := by
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · have := polyNorm_diag_sub_le B A
    rw [polyNorm_diag_sub_comm] at this
    linarith
  · have := polyNorm_diag_sub_le A B
    linarith

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.isClosed_isSymm
declarations.signature: lemma isClosed_isSymm : IsClosed {A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n | IsSymm A}
declarations.source:
lemma isClosed_isSymm : IsClosed {A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n | IsSymm A} := by
  have : {A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n | IsSymm A} =
      ⋂ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), ⋂ v : Fin n → X, {A | A (v ∘ σ) = A v} := by
    ext A; simp [IsSymm]
  rw [this]
  refine isClosed_iInter fun σ => isClosed_iInter fun v => ?_
  exact isClosed_eq (continuous_eval_const _) (continuous_eval_const _)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.symmetrize
declarations.doc: Symmetrization {lit}`(1/n!) ∑_σ A ∘ σ` of a multilinear map.
declarations.signature: def symmetrize (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : MLin 𝕜 X Y n
declarations.source:
def symmetrize (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : MLin 𝕜 X Y n :=
  ((n.factorial : 𝕜))⁻¹ • ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), A.domDomCongr σ

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.domDomCongr_apply'
declarations.signature:
lemma domDomCongr_apply' (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (v : Fin n → X) :
    A.domDomCongr σ v = A (v ∘ σ)
declarations.source:
lemma domDomCongr_apply' (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (v : Fin n → X) :
    A.domDomCongr σ v = A (v ∘ σ) := by
  simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.domDomCongr]
  rfl

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.symmetrize_apply
declarations.signature:
lemma symmetrize_apply (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) (v : Fin n → X) :
    symmetrize A v = ((n.factorial : 𝕜))⁻¹ • ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), A (v ∘ σ)
declarations.source:
lemma symmetrize_apply (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) (v : Fin n → X) :
    symmetrize A v = ((n.factorial : 𝕜))⁻¹ • ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), A (v ∘ σ) := by
  simp [symmetrize]
  rfl

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.isSymm_symmetrize
declarations.signature: lemma isSymm_symmetrize (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : IsSymm (symmetrize A)
declarations.source:
lemma isSymm_symmetrize (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : IsSymm (symmetrize A) := by
  intro τ v
  rw [symmetrize_apply, symmetrize_apply]
  congr 1
  exact Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.mulLeft τ) _ _ (fun σ => by simp [Function.comp_assoc])

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.diag_symmetrize
declarations.signature: lemma diag_symmetrize (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : diag (symmetrize A) = diag A
declarations.source:
lemma diag_symmetrize (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : diag (symmetrize A) = diag A := by
  ext x
  simp only [diag_apply, symmetrize_apply]
  have : ∀ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), A ((fun _ : Fin n => x) ∘ σ) = A (fun _ => x) :=
    fun σ => rfl
  simp only [this, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_perm, Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul 𝕜, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (by exact_mod_cast
    (Nat.factorial_pos n).ne'), one_smul]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.symmetrize_of_isSymm
declarations.signature: lemma symmetrize_of_isSymm {A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n} (hA : IsSymm A) : symmetrize A = A
declarations.source:
lemma symmetrize_of_isSymm {A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n} (hA : IsSymm A) : symmetrize A = A := by
  ext v
  rw [symmetrize_apply]
  simp only [hA _ v, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_perm, Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul 𝕜, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (by exact_mod_cast
    (Nat.factorial_pos n).ne'), one_smul]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.chainApply
declarations.doc: {lit}`chainApply f u t x = S_{u₀,f₀}(t₀) (S_{u₁,f₁}(t₁) (⋯ (S_{u_{d-1},f_{d-1}}(t_{d-1}) x)))`.
declarations.signature:
def chainApply : ∀ {d : ℕ}, (Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) → (Fin d → X) → (Fin d → ℝ) → X → X
  | 0, _, _, _, x => x
  | _ + 1, f, u, t, x =>
    substOp (f 0) (u 0) (t 0) (chainApply (Fin.tail f) (Fin.tail u) (Fin.tail t) x)
declarations.source:
def chainApply : ∀ {d : ℕ}, (Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) → (Fin d → X) → (Fin d → ℝ) → X → X

  | _ + 1, f, u, t, x =>

@[simp] lemma chainApply_zero (f : Fin 0 → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin 0 → X) (t : Fin 0 → ℝ)

declarations.source:
@[simp] lemma chainApply_zero (f : Fin 0 → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin 0 → X) (t : Fin 0 → ℝ)

declarations.source:
lemma chainApply_succ {d : ℕ} (f : Fin (d + 1) → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin (d + 1) → X)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.norm_chainApply_le
declarations.doc: A composition of contractions is a contraction.
declarations.signature:
lemma norm_chainApply_le : ∀ {d : ℕ} (f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin d → X)
    (t : Fin d → ℝ), (∀ i, ‖f i‖ ≤ 1) → (∀ i, ‖u i‖ ≤ 1) → (∀ i, t i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
    ∀ x, ‖chainApply f u t x‖ ≤ ‖x‖
  | 0, _, _, _, _, _, _, x => le_rfl
  | d + 1, f, u, t, hf, hu, ht, x => by
    rw [chainApply_succ]
    refine (norm_substOp_le (hf 0) (hu 0) (ht 0).1 (ht 0).2 _).trans ?_
    exact norm_chainApply_le (Fin.tail f) (Fin.tail u) (Fin.tail t) (fun i => hf _)
      (fun i => hu _) (fun i => ht _) x
declarations.source:
lemma norm_chainApply_le : ∀ {d : ℕ} (f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin d → X)
    (t : Fin d → ℝ), (∀ i, ‖f i‖ ≤ 1) → (∀ i, ‖u i‖ ≤ 1) → (∀ i, t i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
    ∀ x, ‖chainApply f u t x‖ ≤ ‖x‖
  | 0, _, _, _, _, _, _, x => le_rfl
  | d + 1, f, u, t, hf, hu, ht, x => by
    rw [chainApply_succ]
    refine (norm_substOp_le (hf 0) (hu 0) (ht 0).1 (ht 0).2 _).trans ?_
    exact norm_chainApply_le (Fin.tail f) (Fin.tail u) (Fin.tail t) (fun i => hf _)
      (fun i => hu _) (fun i => ht _) x

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.chainApply_eq_self
declarations.signature:
lemma chainApply_eq_self : ∀ {d : ℕ} (f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin d → X)
    (t : Fin d → ℝ), (∀ i, t i = 0) → ∀ x, chainApply f u t x = x
  | 0, _, _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | d + 1, f, u, t, ht, x => by
    rw [chainApply_succ, ht 0, substOp_zero]
    exact chainApply_eq_self _ _ _ (fun i => ht _) x
declarations.source:
lemma chainApply_eq_self : ∀ {d : ℕ} (f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin d → X)
    (t : Fin d → ℝ), (∀ i, t i = 0) → ∀ x, chainApply f u t x = x
  | 0, _, _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | d + 1, f, u, t, ht, x => by
    rw [chainApply_succ, ht 0, substOp_zero]
    exact chainApply_eq_self _ _ _ (fun i => ht _) x

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.chainApply_single
declarations.signature:
lemma chainApply_single : ∀ {d : ℕ} (f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin d → X)
    (t : Fin d → ℝ) (j : Fin d), (∀ h, h ≠ j → t h = 0) → ∀ x,
    chainApply f u t x = substOp (f j) (u j) (t j) x
  | 0, _, _, _, j, _, _ => Fin.elim0 j
  | d + 1, f, u, t, j, ht, x => by
    rw [chainApply_succ]
    induction j using Fin.cases with
    | zero =>
      rw [chainApply_eq_self (Fin.tail f) (Fin.tail u) (Fin.tail t)
        (fun i => ht i.succ (Fin.succ_ne_zero i))]
    | succ j' =>
      have h0 : t 0 = 0
declarations.source:
lemma chainApply_single : ∀ {d : ℕ} (f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin d → X)
    (t : Fin d → ℝ) (j : Fin d), (∀ h, h ≠ j → t h = 0) → ∀ x,
    chainApply f u t x = substOp (f j) (u j) (t j) x
  | 0, _, _, _, j, _, _ => Fin.elim0 j
  | d + 1, f, u, t, j, ht, x => by
    rw [chainApply_succ]
    induction j using Fin.cases with
    | zero =>
      rw [chainApply_eq_self (Fin.tail f) (Fin.tail u) (Fin.tail t)
        (fun i => ht i.succ (Fin.succ_ne_zero i))]
    | succ j' =>
      have h0 : t 0 = 0 := ht 0 (Fin.succ_ne_zero j').symm
      rw [h0, substOp_zero]
      exact chainApply_single (Fin.tail f) (Fin.tail u) (Fin.tail t) j'
        (fun h hh => ht _ (fun e => hh (Fin.succ_injective _ e))) x

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.chainApply_pair
declarations.signature:
lemma chainApply_pair : ∀ {d : ℕ} (f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin d → X)
    (t : Fin d → ℝ) (i j : Fin d), i < j → (∀ h, h ≠ i → h ≠ j → t h = 0) → ∀ x,
    chainApply f u t x = substOp (f i) (u i) (t i) (substOp (f j) (u j) (t j) x)
  | 0, _, _, _, i, _, _, _, _ => Fin.elim0 i
  | d + 1, f, u, t, i, j, hij, ht, x => by
    rw [chainApply_succ]
    induction i using Fin.cases with
    | zero =>
      induction j using Fin.cases with
      | zero => exact absurd hij (lt_irrefl _)
      | succ j' =>
        rw [chainApply_single (Fin.tail f) (Fin.tail u) (Fin.tail t) j'
          (fun h hh => ht _ (Fin.succ_ne_zero h) (fun e => hh (Fin.succ_injective _ e))) x]
        rfl
    | succ i' =>
      induction j using Fin.cases with
      | zero => exact absurd hij (not_lt.mpr (Fin.zero_le _))
      | succ j' =>
        have h0 : t 0 = 0
declarations.source:
lemma chainApply_pair : ∀ {d : ℕ} (f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin d → X)
    (t : Fin d → ℝ) (i j : Fin d), i < j → (∀ h, h ≠ i → h ≠ j → t h = 0) → ∀ x,
    chainApply f u t x = substOp (f i) (u i) (t i) (substOp (f j) (u j) (t j) x)
  | 0, _, _, _, i, _, _, _, _ => Fin.elim0 i
  | d + 1, f, u, t, i, j, hij, ht, x => by
    rw [chainApply_succ]
    induction i using Fin.cases with
    | zero =>
      induction j using Fin.cases with
      | zero => exact absurd hij (lt_irrefl _)
      | succ j' =>
        rw [chainApply_single (Fin.tail f) (Fin.tail u) (Fin.tail t) j'
          (fun h hh => ht _ (Fin.succ_ne_zero h) (fun e => hh (Fin.succ_injective _ e))) x]
        rfl
    | succ i' =>
      induction j using Fin.cases with
      | zero => exact absurd hij (not_lt.mpr (Fin.zero_le _))
      | succ j' =>
        have h0 : t 0 = 0 := ht 0 (Fin.succ_ne_zero i').symm (Fin.succ_ne_zero j').symm
        rw [h0, substOp_zero]
        exact chainApply_pair (Fin.tail f) (Fin.tail u) (Fin.tail t) i' j'
          (Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hij)
          (fun h hi hj => ht _ (fun e => hi (Fin.succ_injective _ e))
            (fun e => hj (Fin.succ_injective _ e))) x

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.zv
declarations.doc:
The points {lit}`z₀,…,z_{d-1}, z_d` of the proof of Lemma {lit}`lem:geometry`:
{lit}`zᵢ = fᵢ(x) uᵢ` for {lit}`i < d` and {lit}`z_d = x`.
declarations.signature: def zv {d : ℕ} (f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin d → X) (x : X) : Fin (d + 1) → X
declarations.source:
def zv {d : ℕ} (f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin d → X) (x : X) : Fin (d + 1) → X :=
  Fin.lastCases x (fun j => f j x • u j)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.zv_last
declarations.signature:
@[simp] lemma zv_last {d : ℕ} (f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin d → X) (x : X) :
    zv f u x (Fin.last d) = x
declarations.source:
@[simp] lemma zv_last {d : ℕ} (f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin d → X) (x : X) :
    zv f u x (Fin.last d) = x := by simp [zv]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.zv_castSucc
declarations.signature:
@[simp] lemma zv_castSucc {d : ℕ} (f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin d → X) (x : X)
    (j : Fin d) : zv f u x j.castSucc = f j x • u j
declarations.source:
@[simp] lemma zv_castSucc {d : ℕ} (f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin d → X) (x : X)
    (j : Fin d) : zv f u x j.castSucc = f j x • u j := by simp [zv]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.zv_zero
declarations.signature:
lemma zv_zero {d : ℕ} (f : Fin (d + 1) → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin (d + 1) → X) (x : X) :
    zv f u x 0 = f 0 x • u 0
declarations.source:
lemma zv_zero {d : ℕ} (f : Fin (d + 1) → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin (d + 1) → X) (x : X) :
    zv f u x 0 = f 0 x • u 0 := by
  have : (0 : Fin (d + 2)) = (0 : Fin (d + 1)).castSucc := rfl
  rw [this, zv_castSucc]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.zv_succ
declarations.signature:
lemma zv_succ {d : ℕ} (f : Fin (d + 1) → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin (d + 1) → X) (x : X)
    (k : Fin (d + 1)) : zv f u x k.succ = zv (Fin.tail f) (Fin.tail u) x k
declarations.source:
lemma zv_succ {d : ℕ} (f : Fin (d + 1) → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin (d + 1) → X) (x : X)
    (k : Fin (d + 1)) : zv f u x k.succ = zv (Fin.tail f) (Fin.tail u) x k := by
  induction k using Fin.lastCases with
  | last => rw [Fin.succ_last, zv_last, zv_last]
  | cast j => rw [Fin.succ_castSucc, zv_castSucc, zv_castSucc]; rfl

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.norm_zv_le
declarations.source:
lemma norm_zv_le {d : ℕ} {f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X} {u : Fin d → X} {x : X}
    (hf : ∀ i, ‖f i‖ ≤ 1) (hu : ∀ i, ‖u i‖ ≤ 1) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) (k : Fin (d + 1)) :
    ‖zv f u x k‖ ≤ 1 := by
  induction k using Fin.lastCases with
  | last => rw [zv_last]; exact hx
  | cast j =>
    rw [zv_castSucc, norm_smul]
    calc ‖f j x‖ * ‖u j‖ ≤ (‖f j‖ * ‖x‖) * 1 := by
          gcongr
          · exact (f j).le_opNorm x
          · exact hu j
      _ ≤ (1 * 1) * 1 := by gcongr; exact hf j
      _ = 1 := by ring

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.chain_approx
declarations.doc:
Comparison of the composed vectors with convex combinations of the points {lit}`zᵢ`
(equations {lit}`eq:convexdistance` and {lit}`eq:weights`): every convex combination of
{lit}`z₀,…,z_d` is within {lit}`d δ` of some composed vector.
declarations.signature:
theorem chain_approx : ∀ {d : ℕ} (f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin d → X) (x : X)
    (δ : ℝ), 0 ≤ δ → (∀ i, ‖f i‖ ≤ 1) → (∀ i, ‖u i‖ ≤ 1) →
    (∀ i j : Fin d, i < j → ‖f i (f j x • u j) - f i x‖ ≤ δ) →
    ∀ θ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 ≤ θ k) → ∑ k, θ k = 1 →
    ∃ t : Fin d → ℝ, (∀ i, t i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
      ‖chainApply f u t x - ∑ k, ((θ k : ℝ) : 𝕜) • zv f u x k‖ ≤ d * δ
  | 0, f, u, x, δ, _, _, _, _, θ, _, hsum => by
    refine ⟨fun i => Fin.elim0 i, fun i => Fin.elim0 i, ?_⟩
    have h0 : θ 0 = 1
declarations.source:
theorem chain_approx : ∀ {d : ℕ} (f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin d → X) (x : X)
    (δ : ℝ), 0 ≤ δ → (∀ i, ‖f i‖ ≤ 1) → (∀ i, ‖u i‖ ≤ 1) →
    (∀ i j : Fin d, i < j → ‖f i (f j x • u j) - f i x‖ ≤ δ) →
    ∀ θ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 ≤ θ k) → ∑ k, θ k = 1 →
    ∃ t : Fin d → ℝ, (∀ i, t i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
      ‖chainApply f u t x - ∑ k, ((θ k : ℝ) : 𝕜) • zv f u x k‖ ≤ d * δ
  | 0, f, u, x, δ, _, _, _, _, θ, _, hsum => by
    refine ⟨fun i => Fin.elim0 i, fun i => Fin.elim0 i, ?_⟩
    have h0 : θ 0 = 1 := by simpa using hsum
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_one, h0, chainApply_zero, show (0 : Fin 1) = Fin.last 0 from rfl, zv_last]
    simp
  | d + 1, f, u, x, δ, hδ, hf, hu, hcomp, θ, hθ, hsum => by
    set θ0 := θ 0 with hθ0
    set θ' : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ := fun k => θ k.succ with hθ'
    have hsum' : ∑ k, θ' k = 1 - θ0 := by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at hsum; simp only [θ']; linarith
    have hθ0le : θ0 ≤ 1 := by
      have : 0 ≤ ∑ k, θ' k := Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => hθ _
      linarith
    -- normalized weights
    set θ'' : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ := fun k =>
      if θ0 < 1 then θ' k / (1 - θ0) else (if k = Fin.last d then 1 else 0) with hθ''
    have hθ''nn : ∀ k, 0 ≤ θ'' k := by
      intro k
      by_cases h1 : θ0 < 1
      · simp only [θ'', ite_eq_left h1]
        exact div_nonneg (hθ _) (by linarith)
      · simp only [θ'', ite_eq_right h1]
        split_ifs
        · exact zero_le_one
        · exact le_rfl
    have hθ''sum : ∑ k, θ'' k = 1 := by
      by_cases h1 : θ0 < 1
      · simp only [θ'', ite_eq_left h1]
        rw [← Finset.sum_div, hsum', div_self (by linarith)]
      · simp only [θ'', ite_eq_right h1]
        simp
    have hθ'rel : ∀ k, θ' k = (1 - θ0) * θ'' k := by
      intro k
      by_cases h1 : θ0 < 1
      · simp only [θ'', ite_eq_left h1]
        have hne : (1 - θ0) ≠ 0 := (sub_pos.mpr h1).ne'
        field_simp
      · simp only [θ'', ite_eq_right h1]
        have h1' : θ0 = 1 := le_antisymm hθ0le (not_lt.mp h1)
        have hz : θ' k = 0 := by
          have hnn : ∀ k ∈ Finset.univ, 0 ≤ θ' k := fun k _ => hθ _
          have h0sum : ∑ k, θ' k = 0 := by rw [hsum', h1']; ring
          exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hnn).mp h0sum k (Finset.mem_univ _)
        rw [hz, h1']; ring
    obtain ⟨t', ht', hdist⟩ := chain_approx (Fin.tail f) (Fin.tail u) x δ hδ
      (fun i => hf _) (fun i => hu _)
      (fun i j hij => hcomp _ _ (Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.mpr hij)) θ'' hθ''nn hθ''sum
    refine ⟨Fin.cons θ0 t', ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      induction i using Fin.cases with
      | zero => exact ⟨hθ _, hθ0le⟩
      | succ i => simpa using ht' i
    · set y := chainApply (Fin.tail f) (Fin.tail u) t' x with hy
      set v' := ∑ k, ((θ'' k : ℝ) : 𝕜) • zv (Fin.tail f) (Fin.tail u) x k with hv'
      have htarget : ∑ k, ((θ k : ℝ) : 𝕜) • zv f u x k =
          ((1 - θ0 : ℝ) : 𝕜) • v' + ((θ0 : ℝ) : 𝕜) • (f 0 x • u 0) := by
        rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ, zv_zero, hv', Finset.smul_sum]
        simp_rw [zv_succ, smul_smul, ← RCLike.ofReal_mul]
        rw [add_comm]
        congr 1
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
        rw [← hθ'rel k]
      have hchain : chainApply f u (Fin.cons θ0 t') x = substOp (f 0) (u 0) θ0 y := by
        rw [chainApply_succ]
        simp [hy]
      rw [hchain, htarget]
      have hid : substOp (f 0) (u 0) θ0 y -
          (((1 - θ0 : ℝ) : 𝕜) • v' + ((θ0 : ℝ) : 𝕜) • (f 0 x • u 0)) =
          substOp (f 0) (u 0) θ0 (y - v') + ((θ0 : ℝ) : 𝕜) • ((f 0 v' - f 0 x) • u 0) := by
        simp only [substOp_apply, map_sub]
        module
      rw [hid]
      -- the defect `f₀(v') - f₀(x)`
      have hdefect : ‖f 0 v' - f 0 x‖ ≤ δ := by
        have hfx : f 0 x = ∑ k, ((θ'' k : ℝ) : 𝕜) * f 0 x := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← RCLike.ofReal_sum, hθ''sum]; simp
        have hfv : f 0 v' = ∑ k, ((θ'' k : ℝ) : 𝕜) * f 0 (zv (Fin.tail f) (Fin.tail u) x k) := by
          rw [hv', map_sum]; simp
        rw [hfx, hfv, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        calc ‖∑ k, (((θ'' k : ℝ) : 𝕜) * f 0 (zv (Fin.tail f) (Fin.tail u) x k) -
              ((θ'' k : ℝ) : 𝕜) * f 0 x)‖
            ≤ ∑ k, ‖((θ'' k : ℝ) : 𝕜) * f 0 (zv (Fin.tail f) (Fin.tail u) x k) -
              ((θ'' k : ℝ) : 𝕜) * f 0 x‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
          _ ≤ ∑ k, θ'' k * δ := by
              gcongr with k
              rw [← mul_sub, norm_mul, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_of_nonneg (hθ''nn k)]
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (hθ''nn k)
              induction k using Fin.lastCases with
              | last => simpa using hδ
              | cast j =>
                rw [zv_castSucc]
                exact hcomp 0 j.succ (Fin.succ_pos j)
          _ = δ := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hθ''sum, one_mul]
      calc ‖substOp (f 0) (u 0) θ0 (y - v') + ((θ0 : ℝ) : 𝕜) • ((f 0 v' - f 0 x) • u 0)‖
          ≤ ‖substOp (f 0) (u 0) θ0 (y - v')‖ + ‖((θ0 : ℝ) : 𝕜) • ((f 0 v' - f 0 x) • u 0)‖ :=
            norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖y - v'‖ + 1 * (δ * 1) := by
            gcongr
            · exact norm_substOp_le (hf 0) (hu 0) (hθ 0) hθ0le _
            · rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_of_nonneg (hθ 0)]
              gcongr
              · exact hu 0
        _ ≤ d * δ + δ := by linarith
        _ = ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ := by push_cast; ring

declarations.source:
lemma defc_base [Nontrivial X] (ha : 0 < a) (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) {k ℓ : ℕ} (hkl : k ≤ ℓ) :
    defc A a k (seqg A a ℓ) (seqx A a ℓ) ≤ 5 * alpha a k ^ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨N, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hkl
  have h1 := defc_backward_iter (A := A) ha (by linarith) k N (norm_seqg (A := A) ha (k + N))
    (norm_seqx (A := A) ha (k + N)).le
  have h2 := defc_self (A := A) ha (k + N)
  have h3 := alpha_anti ha.le (by linarith) (Nat.le_add_right k N)
  have h4 := alpha_pos ha (k + N)
  nlinarith

theorem defc_chain [Nontrivial X] (ha : 0 < a) (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) (ℓ : ℕ) :
    ∀ (D : ℕ) (ι : Fin (D + 1) → ℕ), StrictMono ι → (∀ i, ι i < ℓ) →
      ∃ c : 𝕜, ‖c‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ t : Fin (D + 1) → ℝ, (∀ i, t i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        defc A a (ι 0) (c • seqg A a (ι 0))
          (chainApply (fun i => seqf A a (ι i)) (fun i => seqx A a (ι i)) t (seqx A a ℓ)) ≤
          (7 * Kc (d + 1)) ^ (D + 1) * alpha a (ι 0)
  | 0, ι, hι, hℓ => by
    set i
declarations.source:
theorem defc_chain [Nontrivial X] (ha : 0 < a) (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) (ℓ : ℕ) :
    ∀ (D : ℕ) (ι : Fin (D + 1) → ℕ), StrictMono ι → (∀ i, ι i < ℓ) →
      ∃ c : 𝕜, ‖c‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ t : Fin (D + 1) → ℝ, (∀ i, t i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        defc A a (ι 0) (c • seqg A a (ι 0))
          (chainApply (fun i => seqf A a (ι i)) (fun i => seqx A a (ι i)) t (seqx A a ℓ)) ≤
          (7 * Kc (d + 1)) ^ (D + 1) * alpha a (ι 0)
  | 0, ι, hι, hℓ => by
    set i := ι 0
    refine ⟨seqg A a ℓ (seqw A a i), norm_apply_seqw_le i (norm_seqg (A := A) ha ℓ), ?_⟩
    intro t ht
    rw [chainApply_succ, chainApply_zero, ← nextG_eq]
    have h1 := defc_insert (A := A) ha i (norm_seqg (A := A) ha ℓ) (norm_seqx (A := A) ha ℓ).le (ht 0)
    have h2 : defc A a (i + 1) (seqg A a ℓ) (seqx A a ℓ) ≤ 5 * (alpha a i ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
      have := defc_base (A := A) ha ha8 (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (hℓ 0))
      rwa [alpha_succ] at this
    have h3 := lam_le (A := A) ha (by linarith) i
    have hα := alpha_pos ha i
    have hα1 := alpha_le ha.le (by linarith) i
    have hK := one_le_Kc (d + 1)
    have h5 : (alpha a i ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ alpha a i ^ 2 := by
      have : alpha a i ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
      nlinarith
    have hB : defc A a (i + 1) (seqg A a ℓ) (seqx A a ℓ) + lam A a i ≤ 7 * alpha a i ^ 2 := by
      linarith
    calc _ ≤ Kc (d + 1) / alpha a i *
          (defc A a (i + 1) (seqg A a ℓ) (seqx A a ℓ) + lam A a i) := h1
      _ ≤ Kc (d + 1) / alpha a i * (7 * alpha a i ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB (div_nonneg (by linarith) hα.le)
      _ = (7 * Kc (d + 1)) ^ (0 + 1) * alpha a i := by field_simp; ring
  | D + 1, ι, hι, hℓ => by
    have hι' : StrictMono (Fin.tail ι) := hι.comp (Fin.strictMono_succ)
    obtain ⟨c', hc', hbound⟩ := defc_chain ha ha8 ℓ D (Fin.tail ι) hι' (fun i => hℓ _)
    set j := ι 0
    set k := ι 1
    have hjk : j < k := hι (show (0 : Fin (D + 2)) < 1 from Fin.zero_lt_one)
    set g := c' • seqg A a k with hgdef
    have hg : ‖g‖ ≤ 1 := norm_smul_seqg_le ha k hc'
    refine ⟨g (seqw A a j), norm_apply_seqw_le j hg, ?_⟩
    intro t ht
    rw [chainApply_succ, ← nextG_eq]
    set y := chainApply (Fin.tail fun i => seqf A a (ι i)) (Fin.tail fun i => seqx A a (ι i))
      (Fin.tail t) (seqx A a ℓ) with hydef
    have hy : ‖y‖ ≤ 1 :=
      (norm_chainApply_le _ _ _ (fun i => (norm_seqf ha _).le) (fun i => (norm_seqx ha _).le)
        (fun i => ht _) _).trans (norm_seqx (A := A) ha ℓ).le
    have hyb : defc A a k g y ≤ (7 * Kc (d + 1)) ^ (D + 1) * alpha a k :=
      hbound (Fin.tail t) (fun i => ht _)
    set C := (7 * Kc (d + 1)) ^ (D + 1) with hC
    have hK := one_le_Kc (d + 1)
    have hC1 : 1 ≤ C := one_le_pow₀ (by linarith)
    have hα := alpha_pos ha j
    have hα1 := alpha_le ha.le (by linarith) j
    -- backward from `k` to `j + 1`
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hjk)
    have hback := defc_backward_iter (A := A) ha (by linarith) (j + 1) N hg hy
    rw [← hN] at hback
    have hαk : alpha a k ≤ alpha a j ^ 2 := by
      rw [← alpha_succ]; exact alpha_anti ha.le (by linarith) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hjk)
    rw [alpha_succ] at hback
    have h1 := defc_insert (A := A) ha j hg hy (ht 0)
    have h3 := lam_le (A := A) ha (by linarith) j
    have hB : defc A a (j + 1) g y + lam A a j ≤
        C * alpha a j ^ 2 + 4 * alpha a j ^ 4 + 2 * alpha a j ^ 2 := by
      have : C * alpha a k ≤ C * alpha a j ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hαk (by linarith)
      have : (alpha a j ^ 2) ^ 2 = alpha a j ^ 4 := by ring
      linarith
    have hα3 : alpha a j ^ 3 ≤ alpha a j := by
      have : alpha a j ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
      nlinarith
    calc _ ≤ Kc (d + 1) / alpha a j * (defc A a (j + 1) g y + lam A a j) := h1
      _ ≤ Kc (d + 1) / alpha a j * (C * alpha a j ^ 2 + 4 * alpha a j ^ 4 + 2 * alpha a j ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB (div_nonneg (by linarith) hα.le)
      _ = Kc (d + 1) * (C * alpha a j + 4 * alpha a j ^ 3 + 2 * alpha a j) := by
          field_simp
      _ ≤ Kc (d + 1) * (7 * C * alpha a j) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by linarith)
          nlinarith
      _ = (7 * Kc (d + 1)) ^ (D + 1 + 1) * alpha a j := by rw [pow_succ, hC]; ring

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.exists_good
declarations.signature:
lemma exists_good [Nontrivial X] (P : MLin 𝕜 X Y (d + 1)) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ t : Choice 𝕜 X Y, Good P δ t
declarations.source:
lemma exists_good [Nontrivial X] (P : MLin 𝕜 X Y (d + 1)) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ t : Choice 𝕜 X Y, Good P δ t := by
  -- a unit vector almost norming `P`
  have hx : ∃ x : X, ‖x‖ = 1 ∧ polyNorm (diag P) - δ ≤ ‖diag P x‖ := by
    obtain ⟨x0, hx0, hlt⟩ := exists_near_polyNorm (P := diag P) hδ
    by_cases h0 : x0 = 0
    · obtain ⟨e0, he0⟩ := exists_ne (0 : X)
      have he0p : 0 < ‖e0‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr he0
      refine ⟨((‖e0‖⁻¹ : ℝ) : 𝕜) • e0, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [norm_smul, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_inv, abs_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ he0p.ne']
      have : diag P (0 : X) = 0 := by
        simp only [diag_apply]; exact P.map_coord_zero 0 rfl
      · rw [h0, this, norm_zero] at hlt
        exact hlt.le.trans (norm_nonneg _)
    · have hpos : 0 < ‖x0‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr h0
      refine ⟨((‖x0‖⁻¹ : ℝ) : 𝕜) • x0, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [norm_smul, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_inv, abs_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hpos.ne']
      · rw [diag_smul_arg, norm_smul, norm_pow, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_inv, abs_norm]
        have h1 : 1 ≤ (‖x0‖⁻¹) ^ (d + 1) := one_le_pow₀ (one_le_inv₀ hpos |>.mpr hx0)
        have h2 : ‖diag P x0‖ ≤ (‖x0‖⁻¹) ^ (d + 1) * ‖diag P x0‖ :=
          le_mul_of_one_le_left (norm_nonneg _) h1
        linarith
  obtain ⟨x, hxn, hxP⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨f, hfn, hfx⟩ := exists_dual_vector 𝕜 x (by rw [← norm_ne_zero_iff, hxn]; norm_num)
  obtain ⟨g, hgn, hgP⟩ := exists_dual_vector'' 𝕜 (diag P x)
  exact ⟨(x, f, g), ⟨hxn, hxP, hfn, by simpa [hxn] using hfx, hgn, hgP⟩⟩

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.polyNorm_comp_le
declarations.signature:
lemma polyNorm_comp_le {m : ℕ} (g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y) (P : MLin 𝕜 X Y m) :
    polyNorm (diag (g.compContinuousMultilinearMap P)) ≤ ‖g‖ * polyNorm (diag P)
declarations.source:
lemma polyNorm_comp_le {m : ℕ} (g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y) (P : MLin 𝕜 X Y m) :
    polyNorm (diag (g.compContinuousMultilinearMap P)) ≤ ‖g‖ * polyNorm (diag P) := by
  apply polyNorm_le (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (polyNorm_nonneg _))
  intro x hx
  simp only [diag_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe,
    Function.comp_apply]
  calc ‖g (P fun _ => x)‖ ≤ ‖g‖ * ‖P fun _ => x‖ := g.le_opNorm _
    _ ≤ ‖g‖ * polyNorm (diag P) := by gcongr; exact norm_diag_le_polyNorm P hx

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.polyNorm_smulRight_le
declarations.signature:
lemma polyNorm_smulRight_le {m : ℕ} (R : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 m) (w : Y) :
    polyNorm (diag (R.smulRight w)) ≤ polyNorm (diag R) * ‖w‖
declarations.source:
lemma polyNorm_smulRight_le {m : ℕ} (R : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 m) (w : Y) :
    polyNorm (diag (R.smulRight w)) ≤ polyNorm (diag R) * ‖w‖ := by
  apply polyNorm_le (mul_nonneg (polyNorm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
  intro x hx
  simp only [diag_apply, ContinuousMultilinearMap.smulRight_apply, norm_smul]
  gcongr
  exact norm_diag_le_polyNorm R hx

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.polyNorm_seq_increment
declarations.signature:
lemma polyNorm_seq_increment [Nontrivial X] (ha : 0 < a) (k : ℕ) :
    polyNorm (diag (seqP A a (k + 1) - seqP A a k)) ≤ alpha a k * seqM A a k
declarations.source:
lemma polyNorm_seq_increment [Nontrivial X] (ha : 0 < a) (k : ℕ) :
    polyNorm (diag (seqP A a (k + 1) - seqP A a k)) ≤ alpha a k * seqM A a k := by
  rw [seqP_succ, add_sub_cancel_left, polyNorm_diag_smul, RCLike.norm_ofReal,
    abs_of_pos (alpha_pos ha k)]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (alpha_pos ha k).le
  calc polyNorm (diag ((Rop (seqx A a k) (seqf A a k)
          ((seqg A a k).compContinuousMultilinearMap (seqP A a k))).smulRight (seqw A a k)))
      ≤ polyNorm (diag (Rop (seqx A a k) (seqf A a k)
          ((seqg A a k).compContinuousMultilinearMap (seqP A a k)))) * ‖seqw A a k‖ :=
        polyNorm_smulRight_le _ _
    _ ≤ polyNorm (diag ((seqg A a k).compContinuousMultilinearMap (seqP A a k))) * 1 := by
        gcongr
        · exact polyNorm_nonneg _
        · exact polyNorm_Rop_le _ (norm_seqf ha k).le (norm_seqx ha k).le
        · exact norm_seqw_le k
    _ ≤ (‖seqg A a k‖ * seqM A a k) * 1 := by
        gcongr; exact polyNorm_comp_le _ _
    _ ≤ (1 * seqM A a k) * 1 := by
        gcongr
        · exact polyNorm_nonneg _
        · exact norm_seqg ha k
    _ = seqM A a k := by ring

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.diag_seqP_succ
declarations.doc: The value of {lit}`P_{k+1}` in terms of {lit}`P_k`.
declarations.signature:
lemma diag_seqP_succ (k : ℕ) (y : X) :
    diag (seqP A a (k + 1)) y = diag (seqP A a k) y + ((alpha a k : ℝ) : 𝕜) •
      ((∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (seqg A a k).compContinuousMultilinearMap (seqP A a k)
          (fun _ => substOp (seqf A a k) (seqx A a k) t y)) • seqw A a k)
declarations.source:
lemma diag_seqP_succ (k : ℕ) (y : X) :
    diag (seqP A a (k + 1)) y = diag (seqP A a k) y + ((alpha a k : ℝ) : 𝕜) •
      ((∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (seqg A a k).compContinuousMultilinearMap (seqP A a k)
          (fun _ => substOp (seqf A a k) (seqx A a k) t y)) • seqw A a k) := by
  rw [seqP_succ, diag_add, Pi.add_apply, diag_smul, Pi.smul_apply]
  congr 2
  simp only [diag_apply, ContinuousMultilinearMap.smulRight_apply]
  rw [← diag_apply, diag_Rop]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.diag_seqP_succ_seqx
declarations.signature:
lemma diag_seqP_succ_seqx [Nontrivial X] (ha : 0 < a) (k : ℕ) :
    diag (seqP A a (k + 1)) (seqx A a k) =
      ((1 + alpha a k : ℝ) : 𝕜) • diag (seqP A a k) (seqx A a k)
declarations.source:
lemma diag_seqP_succ_seqx [Nontrivial X] (ha : 0 < a) (k : ℕ) :
    diag (seqP A a (k + 1)) (seqx A a k) =
      ((1 + alpha a k : ℝ) : 𝕜) • diag (seqP A a k) (seqx A a k) := by
  rw [seqP_succ, diag_add, Pi.add_apply, diag_smul, Pi.smul_apply]
  simp only [diag_apply, ContinuousMultilinearMap.smulRight_apply]
  rw [← diag_apply (Rop _ _ _), diag_Rop_fix _ (seqf_seqx ha k)]
  simp only [diag_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe,
    Function.comp_apply]
  have hg' : (seqg A a k) (seqP A a k fun _ => seqx A a k) =
      ((‖seqP A a k fun _ => seqx A a k‖ : ℝ) : 𝕜) := (seq_good (A := A) ha k).g_P
  rw [hg']
  have hw : ((‖seqP A a k fun _ => seqx A a k‖ : ℝ) : 𝕜) • seqw A a k =
      seqP A a k fun _ => seqx A a k := by
    unfold seqw wvec
    rw [smul_smul, ← RCLike.ofReal_mul]
    by_cases h : ‖seqP A a k fun _ => seqx A a k‖ = 0
    · have h0 : (seqP A a k fun _ => seqx A a k) = 0 := norm_eq_zero.mp h
      simp only [diag_apply]
      rw [show (seqT A a k).1 = seqx A a k from rfl, h0, smul_zero]
    · simp only [diag_apply]
      rw [show (seqT A a k).1 = seqx A a k from rfl, mul_inv_cancel₀ h, RCLike.ofReal_one,
        one_smul]
  rw [hw]
  rw [show ((1 + alpha a k : ℝ) : 𝕜) = 1 + ((alpha a k : ℝ) : 𝕜) by push_cast; ring, add_smul,
    one_smul]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.seqM_succ_bounds
declarations.signature:
lemma seqM_succ_bounds [Nontrivial X] (ha : 0 < a) (k : ℕ) :
    (1 + alpha a k) * (seqM A a k - alpha a k ^ 2) ≤ seqM A a (k + 1) ∧
      seqM A a (k + 1) ≤ (1 + alpha a k) * seqM A a k
declarations.source:
lemma seqM_succ_bounds [Nontrivial X] (ha : 0 < a) (k : ℕ) :
    (1 + alpha a k) * (seqM A a k - alpha a k ^ 2) ≤ seqM A a (k + 1) ∧
      seqM A a (k + 1) ≤ (1 + alpha a k) * seqM A a k := by
  have hα := alpha_pos ha k
  constructor
  · have h1 := norm_diag_le_polyNorm (seqP A a (k + 1)) (norm_seqx (A := A) ha k).le
    rw [diag_seqP_succ_seqx ha, norm_smul, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_of_pos (by linarith)] at h1
    have h2 := (seq_good (A := A) ha k).near
    change seqM A a k - alpha a k ^ 2 ≤ ‖diag (seqP A a k) (seqx A a k)‖ at h2
    calc (1 + alpha a k) * (seqM A a k - alpha a k ^ 2)
        ≤ (1 + alpha a k) * ‖diag (seqP A a k) (seqx A a k)‖ := by gcongr
      _ ≤ seqM A a (k + 1) := h1
  · have h1 := polyNorm_diag_sub_le (seqP A a (k + 1)) (seqP A a k)
    have h2 := polyNorm_seq_increment (A := A) ha k
    unfold seqM at *
    nlinarith

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.one_le_seqM
declarations.signature:
lemma one_le_seqM [Nontrivial X] (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a) (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) :
    ∀ k, 1 ≤ seqM A a k
  | 0 => by simp [seqM, seqP, hA1]
  | k + 1 => by
    have ih
declarations.source:
lemma one_le_seqM [Nontrivial X] (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a) (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) :
    ∀ k, 1 ≤ seqM A a k
  | 0 => by simp [seqM, seqP, hA1]
  | k + 1 => by
    have ih := one_le_seqM hA1 ha ha8 k
    have hα := alpha_pos ha k
    have hα8 : alpha a k < 1 / 8 := (alpha_le ha.le (by linarith) k).trans_lt ha8
    have := (seqM_succ_bounds (A := A) ha k).1
    nlinarith

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.seqM_le_prod
declarations.signature:
lemma seqM_le_prod [Nontrivial X] (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∀ k, seqM A a k ≤ ∏ h ∈ range k, (1 + alpha a h)
  | 0 => by simp [seqM, seqP, hA1]
  | k + 1 => by
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ]
    have
declarations.source:
lemma seqM_le_prod [Nontrivial X] (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∀ k, seqM A a k ≤ ∏ h ∈ range k, (1 + alpha a h)
  | 0 => by simp [seqM, seqP, hA1]
  | k + 1 => by
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ]
    have := (seqM_succ_bounds (A := A) ha k).2
    have ih := seqM_le_prod hA1 ha k
    have hα := alpha_pos ha k
    nlinarith

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.seqM_le
declarations.signature:
lemma seqM_le [Nontrivial X] (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (k : ℕ) :
    seqM A a k ≤ 1 / (1 - a)
declarations.source:
lemma seqM_le [Nontrivial X] (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (k : ℕ) :
    seqM A a k ≤ 1 / (1 - a) := by
  have h1 := seqM_le_prod hA1 ha k
  have h2 := prod_one_add_alpha a k
  have h3 : 0 < 1 - a := by linarith
  rw [le_div_iff₀ h3]
  have := alpha_pos ha k
  nlinarith

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.norm_diagExtV_le
declarations.doc:
The Davie–Gamelin bound for the vector-valued extension:
{lit}`‖P̃(z)‖ ≤ ‖P‖` for {lit}`‖z‖ ≤ 1`.
declarations.signature:
lemma norm_diagExtV_le {B : MLin 𝕜 X Y d} (hB : IsSymm B) (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖diagExtV z B‖ ≤ polyNorm (diag B)
declarations.source:
lemma norm_diagExtV_le {B : MLin 𝕜 X Y d} (hB : IsSymm B) (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖diagExtV z B‖ ≤ polyNorm (diag B) := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (polyNorm_nonneg _)
  intro g
  rw [diagExtV_apply]
  refine (davie_gamelin (hB.comp g) z hz).trans ?_
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact polyNorm_comp_le g B

lemma diagExtV_smul (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) (c : 𝕜) (B : MLin 𝕜 X Y d) :

declarations.source:
lemma diagExtV_smul (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) (c : 𝕜) (B : MLin 𝕜 X Y d) :
