declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.etaV
declarations.signature: def etaV (d : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (m : ℕ) : ℝ

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.tendsto_etaV
declarations.signature:
lemma tendsto_etaV {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) :
    Tendsto (etaV d a) atTop (𝓝 0)
declarations.source:
lemma tendsto_etaV {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) :
    Tendsto (etaV d a) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have h := tendsto_alpha ha.le ha1
  have h1 : Tendsto (fun m => Real.sqrt (2 * ((7 * Kc (d + 1)) ^ (d + 1) * alpha a m)))
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have := ((h.const_mul ((7 * Kc (d + 1)) ^ (d + 1))).const_mul 2).sqrt
    rw [mul_zero, mul_zero, Real.sqrt_zero] at this
    exact this
  have := (h1.const_mul (hConst (d + 1))).add (h.const_mul (4 * (cPol (d + 1) + 1)))
  rw [mul_zero, mul_zero, add_zero] at this
  exact this

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.ordered_bound
declarations.doc:
Equation {lit}`eq:vordered`: for {lit}`m < i₁ < ⋯ < i_n`,
{lit}`|y_m^*(Q̌(x_{i₁},…,x_{i_n}))| ≥ M - η'_m`.
declarations.signature:
theorem ordered_bound [CompleteSpace Y] [Nontrivial X] (hA : IsSymm A)
    (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a) (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) (m : ℕ)
    (ι : Fin (d + 1) → ℕ) (hι : StrictMono ι) (hm : ∀ i, m < ι i) :
    polyNorm (diag (limQ A a)) - etaV d a m ≤
      ‖seqg A a m (limQ A a (fun i => seqx A a (ι i)))‖
declarations.source:
theorem ordered_bound [CompleteSpace Y] [Nontrivial X] (hA : IsSymm A)
    (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a) (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) (m : ℕ)
    (ι : Fin (d + 1) → ℕ) (hι : StrictMono ι) (hm : ∀ i, m < ι i) :
    polyNorm (diag (limQ A a)) - etaV d a m ≤
      ‖seqg A a m (limQ A a (fun i => seqx A a (ι i)))‖ := by
  set ℓ := ι (Fin.last d)
  set ι' : Fin (d + 1) → ℕ := Fin.cons m (fun i : Fin d => ι i.castSucc) with hι'def
  have hι' : StrictMono ι' :=
    strictMono_cons (hι.comp Fin.strictMono_castSucc) (fun i => hm _)
  have hℓ : ∀ i, ι' i < ℓ := by
    intro i
    induction i using Fin.cases with
    | zero => simpa [ι'] using hm (Fin.last d)
    | succ i => simpa [ι'] using hι (Fin.castSucc_lt_last i)
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hchain⟩ := defc_chain (A := A) ha ha8 ℓ d ι' hι' hℓ
  set E := (7 * Kc (d + 1)) ^ (d + 1) * alpha a m with hE
  have hK := one_le_Kc (d + 1)
  have hα := alpha_pos ha m
  have hE0 : 0 ≤ E := by positivity
  set g := c • seqg A a m with hgdef
  have hg : ‖g‖ ≤ 1 := norm_smul_seqg_le ha m hc
  set a' := g.compContinuousMultilinearMap (seqP A a m) with ha'
  have hMm1 := one_le_seqM hA1 ha ha8 m
  have hMm2 := seqM_le hA1 ha (by linarith) m
  have hsymm : IsSymm a' := (isSymm_seqP hA m).comp g
  have hpn : polyNorm (diag a') ≤ seqM A a m := by
    have := polyNorm_comp_le g (seqP A a m)
    have h0 : 0 ≤ seqM A a m := by linarith
    unfold seqM at *
    nlinarith [polyNorm_nonneg (diag (seqP A a m))]
  have hgeo := geometry_lemma hsymm (by linarith : 0 < seqM A a m) hpn
    (fun i => seqx A a (ι i)) (fun i => (norm_seqx ha _).le)
    (fun i => seqf A a (ι i.castSucc)) (fun i => (norm_seqf ha _).le) hE0 (by
      intro t ht
      have h := hchain (Fin.cons 0 t) (by
        intro i
        induction i using Fin.cases with
        | zero => simp
        | succ i => simpa using ht i)
      rw [chainApply_succ] at h
      simp only [Fin.cons_zero, substOp_zero] at h
      have heq : ι' 0 = m := rfl
      rw [heq] at h
      unfold defc at h
      have h2 : seqM A a m - E ≤ RCLike.re (g (diag (seqP A a m) (chainApply
          (Fin.tail fun i => seqf A a (ι' i)) (Fin.tail fun i => seqx A a (ι' i))
          (Fin.tail (Fin.cons 0 t : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ)) (seqx A a ℓ)))) := by
        linarith
      exact h2)
  -- pass from `P_m` to `Q`
  set u : Fin (d + 1) → X := fun i => seqx A a (ι i)
  have hu : ∀ i, ‖u i‖ ≤ 1 := fun i => (norm_seqx ha _).le
  have h1 : ‖a' u‖ ≤ ‖seqg A a m (seqP A a m u)‖ := by
    simp only [a', ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe, Function.comp_apply,
      g, smul_apply, norm_smul]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg c, norm_nonneg (seqg A a m (seqP A a m u))]
  have h2 : ‖seqg A a m (seqP A a m u)‖ ≤
      ‖seqg A a m (limQ A a u)‖ + cPol (d + 1) * (4 * alpha a m) := by
    have e : seqg A a m (seqP A a m u) =
        seqg A a m (limQ A a u) - seqg A a m ((limQ A a - seqP A a m) u) := by
      simp
    rw [e]
    refine (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (add_le_add le_rfl ?_)
    calc ‖seqg A a m ((limQ A a - seqP A a m) u)‖
        ≤ ‖seqg A a m‖ * ‖(limQ A a - seqP A a m) u‖ := (seqg A a m).le_opNorm _
      _ ≤ 1 * ‖limQ A a - seqP A a m‖ :=
          mul_le_mul (norm_seqg ha m) (norm_apply_le_of_ball _ hu) (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
      _ ≤ cPol (d + 1) * (4 * alpha a m) := by
          rw [one_mul]; exact opNorm_limQ_sub hA hA1 ha ha8 m
  have h3 := abs_polyNorm_limQ_sub hA hA1 ha ha8 m
  have h4 : Real.sqrt (seqM A a m * E) ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * E) := by
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    have : seqM A a m ≤ 2 := hMm2.trans (by rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]; linarith)
    nlinarith
  have hH : 0 ≤ hConst (d + 1) := (zero_le_one).trans (one_le_hConst (by omega))
  have h5 : hConst (d + 1) * Real.sqrt (seqM A a m * E) ≤ hConst (d + 1) * Real.sqrt (2 * E) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 hH
  rw [abs_le] at h3
  unfold etaV
  rw [← hE]
  have : ‖a' u‖ = ‖a' fun i => seqx A a (ι i)‖ := rfl
  linarith

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.core_attain
declarations.doc:
The core theorem for normalized symmetric forms: there is a symmetric {lit}`B` with
{lit}`‖B - A‖ < ε` (as polynomials) whose canonical extension attains its norm.
declarations.signature:
theorem core_attain [CompleteSpace Y] [Nontrivial X] (hA : IsSymm A)
    (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ B : MLin 𝕜 X Y (d + 1), IsSymm B ∧ polyNorm (diag (B - A)) < ε ∧
      ∃ z : Bidual 𝕜 X, ‖z‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖diagExtV z B‖ = polyNorm (diag B)
declarations.source:
theorem core_attain [CompleteSpace Y] [Nontrivial X] (hA : IsSymm A)
    (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ B : MLin 𝕜 X Y (d + 1), IsSymm B ∧ polyNorm (diag (B - A)) < ε ∧
      ∃ z : Bidual 𝕜 X, ‖z‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖diagExtV z B‖ = polyNorm (diag B) := by
  set a := min (1 / 16) (ε / 8) with hadef
  have ha : 0 < a := lt_min (by norm_num) (by linarith)
  have ha8 : a < 1 / 8 := (min_le_left _ _).trans_lt (by norm_num)
  have haε : 4 * a < ε := by
    have : a ≤ ε / 8 := min_le_right _ _
    linarith
  refine ⟨limQ A a, isSymm_limQ hA hA1 ha ha8,
    (polyNorm_limQ_sub_A hA hA1 ha ha8).trans_lt haε, ?_⟩
  have hx : ∀ k, ‖seqx A a k‖ ≤ 1 := fun k => (norm_seqx ha k).le
  set z := ultraPoint (𝕜 := 𝕜) (seqx A a) hx
  refine ⟨z, norm_ultraPoint_le _ _, le_antisymm
    (norm_diagExtV_le (isSymm_limQ hA hA1 ha ha8) z (norm_ultraPoint_le _ _)) ?_⟩
  have hlow : ∀ m, polyNorm (diag (limQ A a)) - etaV d a m ≤ ‖diagExtV z (limQ A a)‖ := by
    intro m
    have h := le_norm_diagExt_ultra (seqx A a) hx m (polyNorm (diag (limQ A a)) - etaV d a m)
      ((seqg A a m).compContinuousMultilinearMap (limQ A a)) (fun ι hι hm => by
        simpa using ordered_bound hA hA1 ha ha8 m ι hι hm)
    refine h.trans ?_
    rw [← diagExtV_apply]
    calc ‖diagExtV z (limQ A a) (seqg A a m)‖ ≤ ‖diagExtV z (limQ A a)‖ * ‖seqg A a m‖ :=
          (diagExtV z (limQ A a)).le_opNorm _
      _ ≤ ‖diagExtV z (limQ A a)‖ * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_seqg ha m) (norm_nonneg (diagExtV z (limQ A a)))
      _ = _ := mul_one _
  have ht := (tendsto_etaV (d := d) ha (by linarith)).const_sub (polyNorm (diag (limQ A a)))
  rw [sub_zero] at ht
  exact le_of_tendsto ht (Eventually.of_forall hlow)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.dual_norm_le_of_re_lt
declarations.doc: A bound on the unit ball bounds the norm of a functional.
declarations.signature:
lemma dual_norm_le_of_re_lt (h : StrongDual 𝕜 X) {u : ℝ}
    (hu : ∀ x : X, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → RCLike.re (h x) < u) : ‖h‖ ≤ u
declarations.source:
lemma dual_norm_le_of_re_lt (h : StrongDual 𝕜 X) {u : ℝ}
    (hu : ∀ x : X, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → RCLike.re (h x) < u) : ‖h‖ ≤ u := by
  have hu0 : 0 < u := by simpa using hu 0 (by simp)
  have hball : ∀ x : X, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖h x‖ ≤ u := by
    intro x hx
    by_cases hhx : h x = 0
    · rw [hhx, norm_zero]; exact hu0.le
    · set c : 𝕜 := (starRingEnd 𝕜) (h x) / ((‖h x‖ : ℝ) : 𝕜) with hc
      have hcn : ‖c‖ = 1 := by
        rw [hc, norm_div, RCLike.norm_conj, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_norm,
          div_self (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hhx)]
      have hcx : ‖c • x‖ ≤ 1 := by rw [norm_smul, hcn, one_mul]; exact hx
      have hval : h (c • x) = ((‖h x‖ : ℝ) : 𝕜) := by
        rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hc, div_mul_eq_mul_div, RCLike.conj_mul]
        rw [← RCLike.ofReal_pow, sq, RCLike.ofReal_mul, mul_div_assoc,
          div_self (by exact_mod_cast norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hhx), mul_one]
      have := hu _ hcx
      rw [hval, RCLike.ofReal_re] at this
      exact this.le
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hu0.le fun x => ?_
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · simp [hx0]
  · have hxpos : 0 < ‖x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hx0
    have h1 := hball (((‖x‖⁻¹ : ℝ) : 𝕜) • x) (by
      rw [norm_smul, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_inv, abs_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hxpos.ne'])
    rw [map_smul, norm_smul, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_inv, abs_norm] at h1
    rw [inv_mul_le_iff₀ hxpos] at h1
    linarith

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.local_goldstine
declarations.doc:
A finite-dimensional form of Goldstine's theorem: for {lit}`z ∈ B_{X**}`, finitely many
functionals {lit}`g ∈ G` and {lit}`η > 0` there is {lit}`x ∈ B_X` with {lit}`|g(x) - z(g)| < η` for {lit}`g ∈ G`.
declarations.signature:
theorem local_goldstine (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ 1) (G : Finset (StrongDual 𝕜 X))
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) : ∃ x : X, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ g ∈ G, ‖g x - z g‖ < η
declarations.source:
theorem local_goldstine (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ 1) (G : Finset (StrongDual 𝕜 X))
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) : ∃ x : X, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ g ∈ G, ‖g x - z g‖ < η := by
  classical
  set T : X →L[𝕜] (G → 𝕜) := ContinuousLinearMap.pi (fun g : G => (g : StrongDual 𝕜 X))
  set w : G → 𝕜 := fun g => z g
  set K : Set (G → 𝕜) := closure (T '' Metric.closedBall (0 : X) 1)
  have hKconv : Convex ℝ K := by
    apply Convex.closure
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ s t hs ht hst
    refine ⟨((s : ℝ) : 𝕜) • x + ((t : ℝ) : 𝕜) • y, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hx hy ⊢
      calc ‖((s : ℝ) : 𝕜) • x + ((t : ℝ) : 𝕜) • y‖
          ≤ ‖((s : ℝ) : 𝕜) • x‖ + ‖((t : ℝ) : 𝕜) • y‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = s * ‖x‖ + t * ‖y‖ := by
            rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, RCLike.norm_ofReal, RCLike.norm_ofReal,
              abs_of_nonneg hs, abs_of_nonneg ht]
        _ ≤ s * 1 + t * 1 := by gcongr
        _ = 1 := by linarith
    · rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := 𝕜) s,
        RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := 𝕜) t]
  by_cases hw : w ∈ K
  · rw [Metric.mem_closure_iff] at hw
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, hdist⟩ := hw η hη
    refine ⟨x, by simpa using hx, fun g hg => ?_⟩
    have := dist_le_pi_dist w (T x) ⟨g, hg⟩
    rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm] at this
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt this hdist
  · exfalso
    obtain ⟨φ, u, hK, hφw⟩ :=
      RCLike.geometric_hahn_banach_closed_point (𝕜 := 𝕜) hKconv isClosed_closure hw
    set e : G → (G → 𝕜) := fun g => Pi.single g (1 : 𝕜)
    set h : StrongDual 𝕜 X := ∑ g : G, φ (e g) • (g : StrongDual 𝕜 X)
    have hdecomp : ∀ v : G → 𝕜, φ v = ∑ g : G, v g * φ (e g) := by
      intro v
      conv_lhs => rw [show v = ∑ g : G, v g • e g by
        ext k; simp [e, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.single_apply]]
      rw [map_sum]
      simp
    have hhx : ∀ x, h x = φ (T x) := by
      intro x
      rw [hdecomp]
      simp [h, T, mul_comm]
    have hzh : z h = φ w := by
      rw [hdecomp]
      simp [h, w, map_sum, mul_comm]
    have hball : ∀ x : X, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → RCLike.re (h x) < u := by
      intro x hx
      rw [hhx]
      exact hK _ (subset_closure ⟨x, by simpa using hx, rfl⟩)
    have hnorm := dual_norm_le_of_re_lt h hball
    have : RCLike.re (φ w) ≤ ‖h‖ := by
      rw [← hzh]
      calc RCLike.re (z h) ≤ ‖z h‖ := RCLike.re_le_norm _
        _ ≤ ‖z‖ * ‖h‖ := z.le_opNorm h
        _ ≤ 1 * ‖h‖ := by gcongr
        _ = ‖h‖ := one_mul _
    linarith

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.PickInv
declarations.doc:
The invariant of the inductive choice of points {lit}`q 0, …, q (m-1)`: at every level, the
form is approximated by its partial extension at increasing tuples of chosen points.
declarations.signature:
def PickInv (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) (ε : ℝ) (q : ℕ → X) (m : ℕ) : ∀ {r : ℕ}, MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 r → Prop
  | 0, _ => True
  | r + 1, C => PickInv z ε q m (extLast z C) ∧
      ∀ ι : Fin (r + 1) → ℕ, StrictMono ι → (∀ i, ι i < m) →
        ‖C (fun i => q (ι i)) - extLast z C (fun i => q (ι i.castSucc))‖ ≤ ε
declarations.source:
def PickInv (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) (ε : ℝ) (q : ℕ → X) (m : ℕ) : ∀ {r : ℕ}, MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 r → Prop
  | 0, _ => True
  | r + 1, C => PickInv z ε q m (extLast z C) ∧
      ∀ ι : Fin (r + 1) → ℕ, StrictMono ι → (∀ i, ι i < m) →
        ‖C (fun i => q (ι i)) - extLast z C (fun i => q (ι i.castSucc))‖ ≤ ε

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.pickInv_approx
declarations.signature:
lemma pickInv_approx (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) (ε : ℝ) (q : ℕ → X) (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ {r : ℕ} (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 r), PickInv z ε q m C →
    ∀ ι : Fin r → ℕ, StrictMono ι → (∀ i, ι i < m) →
      ‖C (fun i => q (ι i)) - diagExt z C‖ ≤ r * ε
  | 0, C, _, ι, _, _ => by
    simp only [diagExt_zero, CharP.cast_eq_zero, zero_mul]
    have : (fun i => q (ι i)) = (fun i => Fin.elim0 i)
declarations.source:
lemma pickInv_approx (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) (ε : ℝ) (q : ℕ → X) (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ {r : ℕ} (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 r), PickInv z ε q m C →
    ∀ ι : Fin r → ℕ, StrictMono ι → (∀ i, ι i < m) →
      ‖C (fun i => q (ι i)) - diagExt z C‖ ≤ r * ε
  | 0, C, _, ι, _, _ => by
    simp only [diagExt_zero, CharP.cast_eq_zero, zero_mul]
    have : (fun i => q (ι i)) = (fun i => Fin.elim0 i) := funext fun i => Fin.elim0 i
    rw [this, sub_self, norm_zero]
  | r + 1, C, hC, ι, hι, hlt => by
    rw [diagExt_succ]
    have h1 := hC.2 ι hι hlt
    have h2 := pickInv_approx z ε q m (extLast z C) hC.1 (fun i => ι i.castSucc)
      (hι.comp Fin.strictMono_castSucc) (fun i => hlt _)
    calc ‖C (fun i => q (ι i)) - diagExt z (extLast z C)‖
        ≤ ‖C (fun i => q (ι i)) - extLast z C (fun i => q (ι i.castSucc))‖ +
          ‖extLast z C (fun i => q (ι i.castSucc)) - diagExt z (extLast z C)‖ := by
          rw [← dist_eq_norm, ← dist_eq_norm, ← dist_eq_norm]; exact dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ ≤ ε + r * ε := add_le_add h1 h2
      _ = ((r + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε := by push_cast; ring

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.pickInv_zero
declarations.signature:
lemma pickInv_zero (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) (ε : ℝ) (q : ℕ → X) :
    ∀ {r : ℕ} (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 r), PickInv z ε q 0 C
  | 0, _ => trivial
  | _ + 1, C => ⟨pickInv_zero z ε q (extLast z C), fun _ _ hlt => absurd (hlt 0) (Nat.not_lt_zero _)⟩
declarations.source:
lemma pickInv_zero (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) (ε : ℝ) (q : ℕ → X) :
    ∀ {r : ℕ} (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 r), PickInv z ε q 0 C
  | 0, _ => trivial
  | _ + 1, C => ⟨pickInv_zero z ε q (extLast z C), fun _ _ hlt => absurd (hlt 0) (Nat.not_lt_zero _)⟩

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.pickInv_extend
declarations.signature:
lemma pickInv_extend (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (q : ℕ → X) (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ {r : ℕ} (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 r), PickInv z ε q m C →
    ∃ G : Finset (StrongDual 𝕜 X), ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ ∀ x : X,
      (∀ g ∈ G, ‖g x - z g‖ < η) → PickInv z ε (Function.update q m x) (m + 1) C
  | 0, _, _ => ⟨∅, 1, one_pos, fun _ _ => trivial⟩
  | r + 1, C, hC => by
    classical
    obtain ⟨G1, η1, hη1, h1⟩
declarations.source:
lemma pickInv_extend (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (q : ℕ → X) (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ {r : ℕ} (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 r), PickInv z ε q m C →
    ∃ G : Finset (StrongDual 𝕜 X), ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ ∀ x : X,
      (∀ g ∈ G, ‖g x - z g‖ < η) → PickInv z ε (Function.update q m x) (m + 1) C
  | 0, _, _ => ⟨∅, 1, one_pos, fun _ _ => trivial⟩
  | r + 1, C, hC => by
    classical
    obtain ⟨G1, η1, hη1, h1⟩ := pickInv_extend z hε q m (extLast z C) hC.1
    set G2 : Finset (StrongDual 𝕜 X) :=
      univ.image (fun ι' : Fin r → Fin m => C.curryRight (fun i => q (ι' i)))
    refine ⟨G1 ∪ G2, min η1 ε, lt_min hη1 hε, fun x hx => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · exact h1 x (fun g hg => lt_of_lt_of_le (hx g (Finset.mem_union_left _ hg))
        (min_le_left _ _))
    · intro ι hι hlt
      by_cases hl : ι (Fin.last r) < m
      · have hall : ∀ i, ι i < m := fun i =>
          lt_of_le_of_lt (hι.monotone (Fin.le_last i)) hl
        have e1 : (fun i => Function.update q m x (ι i)) = fun i => q (ι i) := by
          funext i; rw [Function.update_of_ne (hall i).ne]
        have e2 : (fun i => Function.update q m x (ι (Fin.castSucc i))) =
            fun i => q (ι (Fin.castSucc i)) := by
          funext i; rw [Function.update_of_ne (hall _).ne]
        rw [e1, e2]
        exact hC.2 ι hι hall
      · have hlast : ι (Fin.last r) = m := by
          have := hlt (Fin.last r); omega
        have hinit : ∀ i : Fin r, ι i.castSucc < m := by
          intro i
          rw [← hlast]
          exact hι (Fin.castSucc_lt_last i)
        set v : Fin r → X := fun i => q (ι i.castSucc)
        have e1 : (fun i => Function.update q m x (ι i)) = Fin.snoc v x := by
          funext i
          induction i using Fin.lastCases with
          | last => rw [Fin.snoc_last, hlast, Function.update_self]
          | cast j =>
            rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc, Function.update_of_ne (hinit j).ne]
        have e2 : (fun i => Function.update q m x (ι (Fin.castSucc i))) = v := by
          funext i; rw [Function.update_of_ne (hinit i).ne]
        rw [e1, e2, extLast_apply, ← curryRight_apply']
        have hmem : C.curryRight v ∈ G1 ∪ G2 := by
          apply Finset.mem_union_right
          refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨fun i => ⟨ι i.castSucc, hinit i⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
          rfl
        exact (lt_of_lt_of_le (hx _ hmem) (min_le_right _ _)).le

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.exists_pick
declarations.signature:
lemma exists_pick (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ 1) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {r : ℕ}
    (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 r) : ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ q : ℕ → X, (∀ i, ‖q i‖ ≤ 1) ∧ PickInv z ε q N C
  | 0 => ⟨0, fun _ => by simp, pickInv_zero z ε 0 C⟩
  | N + 1 => by
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hinv⟩
declarations.source:
lemma exists_pick (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ 1) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {r : ℕ}
    (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 r) : ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ q : ℕ → X, (∀ i, ‖q i‖ ≤ 1) ∧ PickInv z ε q N C
  | 0 => ⟨0, fun _ => by simp, pickInv_zero z ε 0 C⟩
  | N + 1 => by
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hinv⟩ := exists_pick z hz hε C N
    obtain ⟨G, η, hη, hG⟩ := pickInv_extend z hε q N C hinv
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxG⟩ := local_goldstine z hz G hη
    refine ⟨Function.update q N x, fun i => ?_, hG x hxG⟩
    by_cases hi : i = N
    · subst hi; rw [Function.update_self]; exact hx
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne hi]; exact hq i

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.one_sub_descFactorial_div_le
declarations.doc: Number of non-injective maps: {lit}`1 - N^{(n)}/N^n ≤ n²/N` (falling factorial).
declarations.signature:
lemma one_sub_descFactorial_div_le {n N : ℕ} (hN : n ≤ N) (hN0 : 0 < N) :
    1 - (N.descFactorial n : ℝ) / (N : ℝ) ^ n ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 / N
declarations.source:
lemma one_sub_descFactorial_div_le {n N : ℕ} (hN : n ≤ N) (hN0 : 0 < N) :
    1 - (N.descFactorial n : ℝ) / (N : ℝ) ^ n ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 / N := by
  have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN0
  have h1 : ((N + 1 - n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ n ≤ N.descFactorial n := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.pow_sub_le_descFactorial N n
  have h2 : ((N : ℝ) - n) ≤ ((N + 1 - n : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]; push_cast; linarith
  have h3 : ((N : ℝ) - n) ^ n ≤ N.descFactorial n :=
    le_trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by have : (n : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN
                                   linarith) h2 n) h1
  have hbern : 1 + (n : ℝ) * (-(n : ℝ) / N) ≤ (1 + (-(n : ℝ) / N)) ^ n := by
    apply one_add_mul_le_pow
    have : (n : ℝ) / N ≤ 1 := by
      rw [div_le_one hNpos]; exact_mod_cast hN
    have : -(n : ℝ) / N = -((n : ℝ) / N) := by ring
    linarith
  have h4 : (1 + (-(n : ℝ) / N)) ^ n = ((N : ℝ) - n) ^ n / (N : ℝ) ^ n := by
    rw [← div_pow]; congr 1; field_simp; ring
  rw [h4] at hbern
  have h5 : ((N : ℝ) - n) ^ n / (N : ℝ) ^ n ≤ (N.descFactorial n : ℝ) / (N : ℝ) ^ n :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h3 (by positivity)
  have : (n : ℝ) * (-(n : ℝ) / N) = -((n : ℝ) ^ 2 / N) := by ring
  linarith

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.norm_diagExt_le_aux
declarations.doc:
The key estimate behind Davie–Gamelin: for every {lit}`ε > 0` and {lit}`N ≥ 1`,
{lit}`|ā(z,…,z)| ≤ ‖P‖ + nε + 2‖a‖(1 - N^{(n)}/N^n)`.
declarations.signature:
lemma norm_diagExt_le_aux {a : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 n} (ha : IsSymm a) (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ 1)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {N : ℕ} (hN0 : 0 < N) :
    ‖diagExt z a‖ ≤ polyNorm (diag a) + n * ε +
      2 * ‖a‖ * (1 - (N.descFactorial n : ℝ) / (N : ℝ) ^ n)
declarations.source:
lemma norm_diagExt_le_aux {a : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 n} (ha : IsSymm a) (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ 1)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {N : ℕ} (hN0 : 0 < N) :
    ‖diagExt z a‖ ≤ polyNorm (diag a) + n * ε +
      2 * ‖a‖ * (1 - (N.descFactorial n : ℝ) / (N : ℝ) ^ n) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hinv⟩ := exists_pick z hz hε a N
  set D := diagExt z a with hD
  have hDle : ‖D‖ ≤ ‖a‖ := by
    have := norm_diagExt_le z a
    calc ‖D‖ ≤ ‖a‖ * ‖z‖ ^ n := this
      _ ≤ ‖a‖ * 1 := by gcongr; exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg z) hz
      _ = ‖a‖ := mul_one _
  have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN0
  set c : 𝕜 := (((N : ℝ)⁻¹ : ℝ) : 𝕜)
  set avg : X := ∑ j : Fin N, c • q j
  have havg : ‖avg‖ ≤ 1 := by
    calc ‖avg‖ ≤ ∑ j : Fin N, ‖c • q j‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin N, (N : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
          gcongr with j
          rw [norm_smul, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hNpos)]
          calc (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖q j‖ ≤ (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * 1 := by gcongr; exact hq j
            _ = (N : ℝ)⁻¹ := mul_one _
      _ = 1 := by simp [hNpos.ne']
  -- expansion of `P(avg)`
  have hexp : diag a avg = c ^ n • ∑ g : Fin n → Fin N, a (fun i => q (g i)) := by
    rw [diag_apply, map_diag_sum_smul, Finset.smul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun g _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    rfl
  have hcn : c ^ n * ((N : 𝕜) ^ n) = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_pow]; simp only [c]; push_cast
    rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ (by exact_mod_cast hN0.ne'), one_pow]
  -- termwise bounds
  have hterm : ∀ g : Fin n → Fin N, ‖a (fun i => q (g i)) - D‖ ≤
      if Function.Injective g then n * ε else 2 * ‖a‖ := by
    intro g
    split_ifs with hg
    · set σ := Tuple.sort g
      have hmono : Monotone (g ∘ σ) := Tuple.monotone_sort g
      have hsm : StrictMono (g ∘ σ) := hmono.strictMono_of_injective (hg.comp σ.injective)
      have hsym : a (fun i => q (g i)) = a (fun i => q ((g ∘ σ) i : ℕ)) := by
        rw [← ha σ (fun i => q (g i))]
        rfl
      rw [hsym]
      exact pickInv_approx z ε q N a hinv (fun i => ((g ∘ σ) i : ℕ))
        (Fin.val_strictMono.comp hsm) (fun i => ((g ∘ σ) i).isLt)
    · calc ‖a (fun i => q (g i)) - D‖ ≤ ‖a (fun i => q (g i))‖ + ‖D‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖a‖ + ‖a‖ := add_le_add (norm_apply_le_of_ball a (fun i => hq _)) hDle
        _ = 2 * ‖a‖ := by ring
  set inj := (univ.filter fun g : Fin n → Fin N => Function.Injective g) with hinj
  have hcard_inj : (inj.card : ℝ) = N.descFactorial n := by
    have h1 : inj.card = Fintype.card {g : Fin n → Fin N // Function.Injective g} :=
      (Fintype.card_subtype _).symm
    rw [h1, Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.subtypeInjectiveEquivEmbedding _ _),
      Fintype.card_embedding_eq, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hcard_all : ((univ : Finset (Fin n → Fin N)).card : ℝ) = (N : ℝ) ^ n := by
    simp
  have hsplit := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
    (s := (univ : Finset (Fin n → Fin N))) (fun g => Function.Injective g)
  have hsum_bound : ∑ g : Fin n → Fin N, ‖a (fun i => q (g i)) - D‖ ≤
      (N.descFactorial n : ℝ) * (n * ε) + ((N : ℝ) ^ n - N.descFactorial n) * (2 * ‖a‖) := by
    calc ∑ g : Fin n → Fin N, ‖a (fun i => q (g i)) - D‖
        ≤ ∑ g : Fin n → Fin N, (if Function.Injective g then (n : ℝ) * ε else 2 * ‖a‖) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun g _ => hterm g
      _ = (inj.card : ℝ) * (n * ε) +
            ((univ.filter fun g : Fin n → Fin N => ¬ Function.Injective g).card : ℝ) *
              (2 * ‖a‖) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_ite, Finset.sum_const, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ = (N.descFactorial n : ℝ) * (n * ε) + ((N : ℝ) ^ n - N.descFactorial n) * (2 * ‖a‖) := by
          rw [hcard_inj]
          congr 2
          rw [← hcard_all, ← hcard_inj, ← hsplit]
          push_cast
          ring
  -- the difference `P(avg) - D`
  have hdiff : diag a avg - D = c ^ n • ∑ g : Fin n → Fin N, (a (fun i => q (g i)) - D) := by
    rw [hexp, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, smul_sub]
    congr 1
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin,
      Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc]
    push_cast
    rw [hcn, one_mul]
  have hcnorm : ‖c ^ n‖ = ((N : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ := by
    rw [norm_pow, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hNpos), inv_pow]
  have hdiff_bound : ‖diag a avg - D‖ ≤ n * ε + 2 * ‖a‖ * (1 - (N.descFactorial n : ℝ) / (N : ℝ) ^ n) := by
    rw [hdiff, norm_smul, hcnorm]
    have hNn : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) ^ n := by positivity
    calc ((N : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ * ‖∑ g : Fin n → Fin N, (a (fun i => q (g i)) - D)‖
        ≤ ((N : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ * ((N.descFactorial n : ℝ) * (n * ε) +
            ((N : ℝ) ^ n - N.descFactorial n) * (2 * ‖a‖)) := by
          gcongr
          exact (norm_sum_le _ _).trans hsum_bound
      _ ≤ ((N : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ * ((N : ℝ) ^ n * (n * ε) +
            ((N : ℝ) ^ n - N.descFactorial n) * (2 * ‖a‖)) := by
          gcongr
          exact_mod_cast Nat.descFactorial_le_pow N n
      _ = n * ε + 2 * ‖a‖ * (1 - (N.descFactorial n : ℝ) / (N : ℝ) ^ n) := by
          field_simp
  have hPavg := norm_diag_le_polyNorm a havg
  calc ‖D‖ ≤ ‖diag a avg‖ + ‖diag a avg - D‖ := by
        have := norm_sub_norm_le (diag a avg) D
        have := norm_sub_rev (diag a avg) D
        linarith [norm_le_insert' D (diag a avg)]
    _ ≤ polyNorm (diag a) + (n * ε + 2 * ‖a‖ * (1 - (N.descFactorial n : ℝ) / (N : ℝ) ^ n)) :=
        add_le_add hPavg hdiff_bound
    _ = _ := by ring

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.davie_gamelin
declarations.doc:
**Davie–Gamelin.** For a symmetric form {lit}`a` and {lit}`z ∈ B_{X**}`,
{lit}`|ā(z,…,z)| ≤ sup_{x ∈ B_X} |a(x,…,x)|`.
declarations.signature:
theorem davie_gamelin {a : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 n} (ha : IsSymm a) (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖diagExt z a‖ ≤ polyNorm (diag a)
declarations.source:
theorem davie_gamelin {a : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 n} (ha : IsSymm a) (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖diagExt z a‖ ≤ polyNorm (diag a) := by
  apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
  intro δ hδ
  set ε := δ / (2 * (n + 1)) with hε
  have hεpos : 0 < ε := by positivity
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (n + 4 * ‖a‖ * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 / δ)
  have hNn : n ≤ N := by
    have : (n : ℝ) < N := by
      have : 0 ≤ 4 * ‖a‖ * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 / δ := by positivity
      linarith
    exact_mod_cast this.le
  have hN0 : 0 < N := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) < N := by
      have : 0 ≤ 4 * ‖a‖ * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 / δ := by positivity
      have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
      linarith
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN0
  have h1 := norm_diagExt_le_aux ha z hz hεpos hN0
  have h2 := one_sub_descFactorial_div_le hNn hN0
  have h3 : (n : ℝ) * ε ≤ δ / 2 := by
    rw [hε]
    rw [mul_div_assoc']
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
    nlinarith
  have h4 : 2 * ‖a‖ * ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 / N) ≤ δ / 2 := by
    have hN' : 4 * ‖a‖ * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 / δ < N := by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hδ] at hN'
    rw [mul_div_assoc', div_le_div_iff₀ hNpos (by norm_num)]
    nlinarith
  have h5 : 2 * ‖a‖ * (1 - (N.descFactorial n : ℝ) / (N : ℝ) ^ n) ≤
      2 * ‖a‖ * ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 / N) := by
    gcongr
  linarith

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.Kc
declarations.signature: def Kc (n : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.source: def Kc (n : ℕ) : ℝ := Classical.choose (lemmaK n)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.one_le_Kc
declarations.signature: lemma one_le_Kc (n : ℕ) : 1 ≤ Kc n
declarations.source: lemma one_le_Kc (n : ℕ) : 1 ≤ Kc n := (Classical.choose_spec (lemmaK n)).1

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.Kc_spec
declarations.signature:
lemma Kc_spec (n : ℕ) : ∀ r : Polynomial ℝ, r.natDegree ≤ n →
    (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, 0 ≤ r.eval t) →
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, r.eval t ≤ Kc n * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, r.eval s
declarations.source:
lemma Kc_spec (n : ℕ) : ∀ r : Polynomial ℝ, r.natDegree ≤ n →
    (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, 0 ≤ r.eval t) →
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, r.eval t ≤ Kc n * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, r.eval s :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (lemmaK n)).2

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.defc
declarations.signature: def defc (k : ℕ) (g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y) (y : X) : ℝ
declarations.source:
def defc (k : ℕ) (g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y) (y : X) : ℝ :=
  seqM A a k - RCLike.re (g (diag (seqP A a k) y))

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.lam
declarations.signature: def lam (k : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.source: def lam (k : ℕ) : ℝ := (1 + alpha a k) * seqM A a k - seqM A a (k + 1)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.defc_nonneg
declarations.signature:
lemma defc_nonneg (k : ℕ) {g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y} (hg : ‖g‖ ≤ 1) {y : X} (hy : ‖y‖ ≤ 1) :
    0 ≤ defc A a k g y
declarations.source:
lemma defc_nonneg (k : ℕ) {g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y} (hg : ‖g‖ ≤ 1) {y : X} (hy : ‖y‖ ≤ 1) :
    0 ≤ defc A a k g y := by
  unfold defc seqM
  have h1 := RCLike.re_le_norm (g (diag (seqP A a k) y))
  have h2 := g.le_opNorm (diag (seqP A a k) y)
  have h3 := norm_diag_le_polyNorm (seqP A a k) hy
  have h4 : ‖g‖ * ‖diag (seqP A a k) y‖ ≤ 1 * polyNorm (diag (seqP A a k)) :=
    mul_le_mul hg h3 (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
  linarith

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.lam_nonneg
declarations.signature: lemma lam_nonneg [Nontrivial X] (ha : 0 < a) (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ lam A a k
declarations.source:
lemma lam_nonneg [Nontrivial X] (ha : 0 < a) (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ lam A a k := by
  have := (seqM_succ_bounds (A := A) ha k).2
  unfold lam; linarith

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.lam_le
declarations.signature:
lemma lam_le [Nontrivial X] (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) (k : ℕ) :
    lam A a k ≤ 2 * alpha a k ^ 2
declarations.source:
lemma lam_le [Nontrivial X] (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) (k : ℕ) :
    lam A a k ≤ 2 * alpha a k ^ 2 := by
  have h := (seqM_succ_bounds (A := A) ha k).1
  have hα := alpha_pos ha k
  have hα1 := alpha_le ha.le ha1 k
  unfold lam
  nlinarith

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.sum_lam_le
declarations.signature:
lemma sum_lam_le [Nontrivial X] (ha : 0 < a) (ha2 : a ≤ 1 / 2) (k N : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range N, lam A a (k + i) ≤ 4 * alpha a k ^ 2
declarations.source:
lemma sum_lam_le [Nontrivial X] (ha : 0 < a) (ha2 : a ≤ 1 / 2) (k N : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range N, lam A a (k + i) ≤ 4 * alpha a k ^ 2 := by
  calc ∑ i ∈ range N, lam A a (k + i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ range N, 2 * alpha a (k + i) ^ 2 :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => lam_le ha (by linarith) _
    _ = 2 * ∑ i ∈ range N, alpha a (k + i) ^ 2 := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ 2 * (2 * alpha a k ^ 2) := by gcongr; exact sum_alpha_sq_le ha.le ha2 k N
    _ = 4 * alpha a k ^ 2 := by ring

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.nextG
declarations.signature: def nextG (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y (d + 1)) (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y) : StrongDual 𝕜 Y
declarations.source:
def nextG (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y (d + 1)) (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y) : StrongDual 𝕜 Y :=
  g (seqw A a k) • seqg A a k

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.norm_nextG_le
declarations.signature:
lemma norm_nextG_le [Nontrivial X] (ha : 0 < a) (k : ℕ) {g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y} (hg : ‖g‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖nextG A a k g‖ ≤ 1
declarations.source:
lemma norm_nextG_le [Nontrivial X] (ha : 0 < a) (k : ℕ) {g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y} (hg : ‖g‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖nextG A a k g‖ ≤ 1 := by
  unfold nextG
  rw [norm_smul]
  have h1 : ‖g (seqw A a k)‖ ≤ 1 :=
    (g.le_opNorm _).trans (by
      have := norm_seqw_le (A := A) (a := a) k
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg g, norm_nonneg (seqw A a k)])
  have h2 := norm_seqg (A := A) ha k
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (g (seqw A a k)), norm_nonneg (seqg A a k)]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.continuous_defc_subst
declarations.signature:
lemma continuous_defc_subst (k : ℕ) (g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y) (f : StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u y : X) :
    Continuous fun t : ℝ => defc A a k g (substOp f u t y)
declarations.source:
lemma continuous_defc_subst (k : ℕ) (g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y) (f : StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u y : X) :
    Continuous fun t : ℝ => defc A a k g (substOp f u t y) := by
  unfold defc
  have := continuous_diag_substOp (g.compContinuousMultilinearMap (seqP A a k)) f u y
  exact continuous_const.sub (RCLike.continuous_re.comp this)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.deficit_identity
declarations.signature:
lemma deficit_identity (k : ℕ) (g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y) (y : X) :
    defc A a k g y + alpha a k * ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        defc A a k (nextG A a k g) (substOp (seqf A a k) (seqx A a k) t y) =
      defc A a (k + 1) g y + lam A a k
declarations.source:
lemma deficit_identity (k : ℕ) (g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y) (y : X) :
    defc A a k g y + alpha a k * ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        defc A a k (nextG A a k g) (substOp (seqf A a k) (seqx A a k) t y) =
      defc A a (k + 1) g y + lam A a k := by
  set a' := (nextG A a k g).compContinuousMultilinearMap (seqP A a k) with ha'
  have hint : ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
      defc A a k (nextG A a k g) (substOp (seqf A a k) (seqx A a k) t y) =
      seqM A a k - RCLike.re (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        a' (fun _ => substOp (seqf A a k) (seqx A a k) t y)) := by
    rw [re_integral_diag]
    have hfun : (fun t : ℝ =>
        defc A a k (nextG A a k g) (substOp (seqf A a k) (seqx A a k) t y)) =
        fun t => seqM A a k - RCLike.re (a' (fun _ => substOp (seqf A a k) (seqx A a k) t y)) := by
      funext t; simp [defc, ha', diag_apply]
    have hi : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun t : ℝ => RCLike.re (a' (fun _ => substOp (seqf A a k) (seqx A a k) t y)))
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
      (RCLike.continuous_re.comp (continuous_diag_substOp a' _ _ y)).intervalIntegrable _ _
    rw [hfun, intervalIntegral.integral_sub intervalIntegrable_const hi]
    simp
  have hval : g (diag (seqP A a (k + 1)) y) = g (diag (seqP A a k) y) +
      ((alpha a k : ℝ) : 𝕜) * ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        a' (fun _ => substOp (seqf A a k) (seqx A a k) t y) := by
    rw [diag_seqP_succ, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    congr 2
    rw [ha']
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe, Function.comp_apply,
      nextG, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, mul_comm]
  rw [hint]
  unfold defc lam
  rw [hval, map_add, RCLike.re_ofReal_mul]
  ring

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.integral_defc_nonneg
declarations.signature:
lemma integral_defc_nonneg [Nontrivial X] (ha : 0 < a) (k : ℕ) {g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y}
    (hg : ‖g‖ ≤ 1) {y : X} (hy : ‖y‖ ≤ 1) :
    0 ≤ ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        defc A a k (nextG A a k g) (substOp (seqf A a k) (seqx A a k) t y)
declarations.source:
lemma integral_defc_nonneg [Nontrivial X] (ha : 0 < a) (k : ℕ) {g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y}
    (hg : ‖g‖ ≤ 1) {y : X} (hy : ‖y‖ ≤ 1) :
    0 ≤ ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        defc A a k (nextG A a k g) (substOp (seqf A a k) (seqx A a k) t y) := by
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg zero_le_one
  intro t ht
  exact defc_nonneg k (norm_nextG_le ha k hg)
    ((norm_substOp_le (norm_seqf ha k).le (norm_seqx ha k).le ht.1 ht.2 y).trans hy)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.defc_backward
declarations.source:
lemma defc_backward [Nontrivial X] (ha : 0 < a) (k : ℕ) {g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y}
    (hg : ‖g‖ ≤ 1) {y : X} (hy : ‖y‖ ≤ 1) :
    defc A a k g y ≤ defc A a (k + 1) g y + lam A a k := by
  have h := deficit_identity (A := A) (a := a) k g y
  have h2 := integral_defc_nonneg (A := A) ha k hg hy
  have h3 := alpha_pos ha k
  nlinarith

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.defc_insert
declarations.signature:
lemma defc_insert [Nontrivial X] (ha : 0 < a) (k : ℕ) {g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y}
    (hg : ‖g‖ ≤ 1) {y : X} (hy : ‖y‖ ≤ 1) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    defc A a k (nextG A a k g) (substOp (seqf A a k) (seqx A a k) t y) ≤
      Kc (d + 1) / alpha a k * (defc A a (k + 1) g y + lam A a k)
declarations.source:
lemma defc_insert [Nontrivial X] (ha : 0 < a) (k : ℕ) {g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y}
    (hg : ‖g‖ ≤ 1) {y : X} (hy : ‖y‖ ≤ 1) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    defc A a k (nextG A a k g) (substOp (seqf A a k) (seqx A a k) t y) ≤
      Kc (d + 1) / alpha a k * (defc A a (k + 1) g y + lam A a k) := by
  set a' := (nextG A a k g).compContinuousMultilinearMap (seqP A a k) with ha'
  obtain ⟨p, hpdeg, hp⟩ := exists_poly_re a' (seqf A a k) (seqx A a k) y
  set r : Polynomial ℝ := Polynomial.C (seqM A a k) - p with hr
  have hreval : ∀ s, r.eval s =
      defc A a k (nextG A a k g) (substOp (seqf A a k) (seqx A a k) s y) := by
    intro s
    rw [hr, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_C, hp]
    simp [defc, ha', diag_apply]
  have hrdeg : r.natDegree ≤ d + 1 :=
    (Polynomial.natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans (by simp [hpdeg])
  have hrnn : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, 0 ≤ r.eval s := by
    intro s hs
    rw [hreval]
    exact defc_nonneg k (norm_nextG_le ha k hg)
      ((norm_substOp_le (norm_seqf ha k).le (norm_seqx ha k).le hs.1 hs.2 y).trans hy)
  have hK := Kc_spec (d + 1) r hrdeg hrnn t ht
  simp only [hreval] at hK
  have hid := deficit_identity (A := A) (a := a) k g y
  have h0 := defc_nonneg (A := A) (a := a) k hg hy
  have hα := alpha_pos ha k
  have hKpos : 0 ≤ Kc (d + 1) := (zero_le_one).trans (one_le_Kc _)
  have hI : ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
      defc A a k (nextG A a k g) (substOp (seqf A a k) (seqx A a k) s y) ≤
      (defc A a (k + 1) g y + lam A a k) / alpha a k := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hα]; nlinarith
  calc _ ≤ Kc (d + 1) * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        defc A a k (nextG A a k g) (substOp (seqf A a k) (seqx A a k) s y) := hK
    _ ≤ Kc (d + 1) * ((defc A a (k + 1) g y + lam A a k) / alpha a k) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hI hKpos
    _ = _ := by ring

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.defc_backward_iter
declarations.signature:
lemma defc_backward_iter [Nontrivial X] (ha : 0 < a) (ha2 : a ≤ 1 / 2) (k N : ℕ)
    {g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y} (hg : ‖g‖ ≤ 1) {y : X} (hy : ‖y‖ ≤ 1) :
    defc A a k g y ≤ defc A a (k + N) g y + 4 * alpha a k ^ 2
declarations.source:
lemma defc_backward_iter [Nontrivial X] (ha : 0 < a) (ha2 : a ≤ 1 / 2) (k N : ℕ)
    {g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y} (hg : ‖g‖ ≤ 1) {y : X} (hy : ‖y‖ ≤ 1) :
    defc A a k g y ≤ defc A a (k + N) g y + 4 * alpha a k ^ 2 := by
  have key : defc A a k g y ≤ defc A a (k + N) g y + ∑ i ∈ range N, lam A a (k + i) := by
    induction N with
    | zero => simp
    | succ N ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      have := defc_backward (A := A) ha (k + N) hg hy
      rw [show k + (N + 1) = k + N + 1 by ring]
      linarith
  linarith [sum_lam_le (A := A) ha ha2 k N]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.Bidual

declarations.source:
abbrev Bidual (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (X : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X] :=
