declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.extLast
declarations.doc:
One step of the canonical extension ({lit}`eq:partial`):
{lit}`(extLast z C)(v₁,…,vₘ) = z (v ↦ C(v₁,…,vₘ,v))`.
declarations.signature: def extLast (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) {m : ℕ} (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)) : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 m
declarations.source:
def extLast (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) {m : ℕ} (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)) : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 m :=
  z.compContinuousMultilinearMap C.curryRight

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.extLast_apply
declarations.signature:
lemma extLast_apply (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) {m : ℕ} (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)) (v : Fin m → X) :
    extLast z C v = z (C.curryRight v)
declarations.source:
lemma extLast_apply (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) {m : ℕ} (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)) (v : Fin m → X) :
    extLast z C v = z (C.curryRight v) := rfl

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.curryRight_apply'
declarations.signature:
lemma curryRight_apply' {m : ℕ} (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)) (v : Fin m → X) (x : X) :
    C.curryRight v x = C (Fin.snoc v x)
declarations.source:
lemma curryRight_apply' {m : ℕ} (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)) (v : Fin m → X) (x : X) :
    C.curryRight v x = C (Fin.snoc v x) := ContinuousMultilinearMap.curryRight_apply _ _ _

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.extLast_add
declarations.signature:
lemma extLast_add (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) {m : ℕ} (C D : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)) :
    extLast z (C + D) = extLast z C + extLast z D
declarations.source:
lemma extLast_add (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) {m : ℕ} (C D : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)) :
    extLast z (C + D) = extLast z C + extLast z D := by
  ext v
  simp only [extLast_apply, add_apply]
  rw [← map_add]
  congr 1

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.extLast_smul
declarations.signature:
lemma extLast_smul (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) {m : ℕ} (c : 𝕜) (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)) :
    extLast z (c • C) = c • extLast z C
declarations.source:
lemma extLast_smul (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) {m : ℕ} (c : 𝕜) (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)) :
    extLast z (c • C) = c • extLast z C := by
  ext v
  simp only [extLast_apply, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [← smul_eq_mul, ← map_smul]
  congr 1

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.norm_extLast_le
declarations.signature:
lemma norm_extLast_le (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) {m : ℕ} (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)) :
    ‖extLast z C‖ ≤ ‖z‖ * ‖C‖
declarations.source:
lemma norm_extLast_le (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) {m : ℕ} (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)) :
    ‖extLast z C‖ ≤ ‖z‖ * ‖C‖ := by
  unfold extLast
  refine (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
  rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.curryRight_norm]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.diagExt
declarations.doc: The value {lit}`Ā(z,…,z)` of the canonical extension of an {lit}`m`-linear form at the diagonal.
declarations.signature:
def diagExt (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) : ∀ {m : ℕ}, MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 m → 𝕜
  | 0, C => C (fun i => Fin.elim0 i)
  | _ + 1, C => diagExt z (extLast z C)
declarations.source:
def diagExt (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) : ∀ {m : ℕ}, MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 m → 𝕜
  | 0, C => C (fun i => Fin.elim0 i)
  | _ + 1, C => diagExt z (extLast z C)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.diagExt_zero
declarations.signature:
@[simp] lemma diagExt_zero (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 0) :
    diagExt z C = C (fun i => Fin.elim0 i)
declarations.source:
@[simp] lemma diagExt_zero (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 0) :
    diagExt z C = C (fun i => Fin.elim0 i) := rfl

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.diagExt_succ
declarations.signature:
@[simp] lemma diagExt_succ (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) {m : ℕ} (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)) :
    diagExt z C = diagExt z (extLast z C)
declarations.source:
@[simp] lemma diagExt_succ (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) {m : ℕ} (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)) :
    diagExt z C = diagExt z (extLast z C) := rfl

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.diagExt_add
declarations.signature:
lemma diagExt_add (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) : ∀ {m : ℕ} (C D : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 m),
    diagExt z (C + D) = diagExt z C + diagExt z D
  | 0, C, D => by simp
  | m + 1, C, D => by
    simp only [diagExt_succ, extLast_add]
    exact diagExt_add z _ _
declarations.source:
lemma diagExt_add (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) : ∀ {m : ℕ} (C D : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 m),
    diagExt z (C + D) = diagExt z C + diagExt z D
  | 0, C, D => by simp
  | m + 1, C, D => by
    simp only [diagExt_succ, extLast_add]
    exact diagExt_add z _ _

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.diagExt_smul
declarations.signature:
lemma diagExt_smul (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) : ∀ {m : ℕ} (c : 𝕜) (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 m),
    diagExt z (c • C) = c * diagExt z C
  | 0, c, C => by simp
  | m + 1, c, C => by
    simp only [diagExt_succ, extLast_smul]
    exact diagExt_smul z c _
declarations.source:
lemma diagExt_smul (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) : ∀ {m : ℕ} (c : 𝕜) (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 m),
    diagExt z (c • C) = c * diagExt z C
  | 0, c, C => by simp
  | m + 1, c, C => by
    simp only [diagExt_succ, extLast_smul]
    exact diagExt_smul z c _

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.diagExt_sub
declarations.signature:
lemma diagExt_sub (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) {m : ℕ} (C D : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 m) :
    diagExt z (C - D) = diagExt z C - diagExt z D
declarations.source:
lemma diagExt_sub (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) {m : ℕ} (C D : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 m) :
    diagExt z (C - D) = diagExt z C - diagExt z D := by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, diagExt_add, ← neg_one_smul 𝕜 D, diagExt_smul]; ring

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.norm_diagExt_le
declarations.signature:
lemma norm_diagExt_le (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) : ∀ {m : ℕ} (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 m),
    ‖diagExt z C‖ ≤ ‖C‖ * ‖z‖ ^ m
  | 0, C => by
    simp only [diagExt_zero, pow_zero, mul_one]
    simp
  | m + 1, C => by
    simp only [diagExt_succ]
    refine (norm_diagExt_le z (extLast z C)).trans ?_
    calc ‖extLast z C‖ * ‖z‖ ^ m ≤ (‖z‖ * ‖C‖) * ‖z‖ ^ m
declarations.source:
lemma norm_diagExt_le (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) : ∀ {m : ℕ} (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 m),
    ‖diagExt z C‖ ≤ ‖C‖ * ‖z‖ ^ m
  | 0, C => by
    simp only [diagExt_zero, pow_zero, mul_one]
    simp
  | m + 1, C => by
    simp only [diagExt_succ]
    refine (norm_diagExt_le z (extLast z C)).trans ?_
    calc ‖extLast z C‖ * ‖z‖ ^ m ≤ (‖z‖ * ‖C‖) * ‖z‖ ^ m := by
          gcongr; exact norm_extLast_le z C
      _ = ‖C‖ * ‖z‖ ^ (m + 1) := by ring

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.snoc_const
declarations.signature:
lemma snoc_const {m : ℕ} (x : X) : (Fin.snoc (fun _ : Fin m => x) x : Fin (m + 1) → X) =
    fun _ => x
declarations.source:
lemma snoc_const {m : ℕ} (x : X) : (Fin.snoc (fun _ : Fin m => x) x : Fin (m + 1) → X) =
    fun _ => x := by
  funext i
  refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
  · simp
  · simp

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.diagExt_inclusion
declarations.signature:
lemma diagExt_inclusion (x : X) : ∀ {m : ℕ} (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 m),
    diagExt (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual 𝕜 X x) C = C (fun _ => x)
  | 0, C => by
    simp only [diagExt_zero]
    congr 1
    funext i; exact Fin.elim0 i
  | m + 1, C => by
    simp only [diagExt_succ]
    rw [diagExt_inclusion x (extLast _ C), extLast_apply,
      NormedSpace.dual_def, curryRight_apply', snoc_const]
declarations.source:
lemma diagExt_inclusion (x : X) : ∀ {m : ℕ} (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 m),
    diagExt (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual 𝕜 X x) C = C (fun _ => x)
  | 0, C => by
    simp only [diagExt_zero]
    congr 1
    funext i; exact Fin.elim0 i
  | m + 1, C => by
    simp only [diagExt_succ]
    rw [diagExt_inclusion x (extLast _ C), extLast_apply,
      NormedSpace.dual_def, curryRight_apply', snoc_const]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.diagExtV
declarations.doc:
The vector-valued canonical extension at the diagonal ({lit}`eq:ABvector`):
{lit}`(diagExtV z A)(y*) = (y* ∘ A)‾(z,…,z)`.
declarations.signature: def diagExtV (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) {n : ℕ} (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : Bidual 𝕜 Y
declarations.source:
def diagExtV (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) {n : ℕ} (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : Bidual 𝕜 Y :=
  LinearMap.mkContinuous
    { toFun := fun g => diagExt z (g.compContinuousMultilinearMap A)
      map_add' := fun g h => by
        rw [← diagExt_add]
        congr 1
      map_smul' := fun c g => by
        simp only [RingHom.id_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        rw [← diagExt_smul]
        congr 1 }
    (‖A‖ * ‖z‖ ^ n)
    (fun g => by
      simp only [LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
      refine (norm_diagExt_le z _).trans ?_
      calc ‖g.compContinuousMultilinearMap A‖ * ‖z‖ ^ n ≤ (‖g‖ * ‖A‖) * ‖z‖ ^ n := by
            gcongr; exact ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _
        _ = ‖A‖ * ‖z‖ ^ n * ‖g‖ := by ring)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.diagExtV_apply
declarations.signature:
lemma diagExtV_apply (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) {n : ℕ} (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) (g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y) :
    diagExtV z A g = diagExt z (g.compContinuousMultilinearMap A)
declarations.source:
lemma diagExtV_apply (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) {n : ℕ} (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) (g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y) :
    diagExtV z A g = diagExt z (g.compContinuousMultilinearMap A) := rfl

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.symmForm
declarations.doc:
The symmetric {lit}`n`-linear form {lit}`Ǎ` associated with a homogeneous polynomial {lit}`P`
(the symmetrization of any {lit}`L` with {lit}`P = L(x,…,x)`; junk value {lit}`0` if {lit}`P` is not a
continuous {lit}`n`-homogeneous polynomial).
declarations.signature:
def symmForm (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X]
    {Y : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace 𝕜 Y] (n : ℕ) (P : X → Y) : MLin 𝕜 X Y n
declarations.source:
def symmForm (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X]
    {Y : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace 𝕜 Y] (n : ℕ) (P : X → Y) : MLin 𝕜 X Y n :=
  haveI := Classical.propDecidable (IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P)
  if h : IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P then symmetrize (Classical.choose h) else 0

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.isSymm_symmForm
declarations.signature: lemma isSymm_symmForm (P : X → Y) : IsSymm (symmForm 𝕜 n P)
declarations.source:
lemma isSymm_symmForm (P : X → Y) : IsSymm (symmForm 𝕜 n P) := by
  unfold symmForm
  split_ifs with h
  · exact isSymm_symmetrize _
  · exact IsSymm.zero

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.diag_symmForm
declarations.signature: lemma diag_symmForm {P : X → Y} (hP : IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P) : diag (symmForm 𝕜 n P) = P
declarations.source:
lemma diag_symmForm {P : X → Y} (hP : IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P) : diag (symmForm 𝕜 n P) = P := by
  unfold symmForm
  rw [dite_eq_left hP, diag_symmetrize]
  funext x
  exact (Classical.choose_spec hP x).symm

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.isHomPoly_diag
declarations.signature: lemma isHomPoly_diag (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : IsHomPoly 𝕜 n (diag A)
declarations.source: lemma isHomPoly_diag (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : IsHomPoly 𝕜 n (diag A) := ⟨A, fun _ => rfl⟩

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.symmForm_eq_of_isSymm
declarations.doc: The symmetric form is the unique symmetric {lit}`n`-linear map with diagonal {lit}`P`.
declarations.signature:
lemma symmForm_eq_of_isSymm {A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n} (hA : IsSymm A) :
    symmForm 𝕜 n (diag A) = A
declarations.source:
lemma symmForm_eq_of_isSymm {A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n} (hA : IsSymm A) :
    symmForm 𝕜 n (diag A) = A :=
  eq_of_diag_eq (isSymm_symmForm _) hA (diag_symmForm (isHomPoly_diag A))

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.symmForm_comp
declarations.signature:
lemma symmForm_comp {P : X → Y} (hP : IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P) (g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y) :
    symmForm 𝕜 n (fun x => g (P x)) = g.compContinuousMultilinearMap (symmForm 𝕜 n P)
declarations.source:
lemma symmForm_comp {P : X → Y} (hP : IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P) (g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y) :
    symmForm 𝕜 n (fun x => g (P x)) = g.compContinuousMultilinearMap (symmForm 𝕜 n P) := by
  have h1 : (fun x => g (P x)) = diag (g.compContinuousMultilinearMap (symmForm 𝕜 n P)) := by
    funext x
    simp only [diag_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe,
      Function.comp_apply]
    rw [← diag_apply, diag_symmForm hP]
  rw [h1, symmForm_eq_of_isSymm ((isSymm_symmForm P).comp g)]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.abExt
declarations.doc:
The canonical (Aron–Berner) extension {lit}`P̃ : X** → 𝕜` of a scalar polynomial {lit}`P`:
{lit}`P̃(z) = Ā(z,…,z)` with {lit}`A = Ǎ` ({lit}`eq:AB`).
declarations.signature:
def abExt (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X]
    (n : ℕ) (P : X → 𝕜) (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) : 𝕜
declarations.source:
def abExt (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X]
    (n : ℕ) (P : X → 𝕜) (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) : 𝕜 :=
  diagExt z (symmForm 𝕜 n P)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.abExtV
declarations.doc:
The canonical (Aron–Berner) extension {lit}`P̃ : X** → Y**` of a vector-valued polynomial:
{lit}`P̃(z)(y*) = (y* ∘ P)~(z)` ({lit}`eq:ABvector`); see {lit}`abExtV_apply`.
declarations.signature:
def abExtV (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X]
    {Y : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace 𝕜 Y]
    (n : ℕ) (P : X → Y) (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) : Bidual 𝕜 Y
declarations.source:
def abExtV (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X]
    {Y : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace 𝕜 Y]
    (n : ℕ) (P : X → Y) (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) : Bidual 𝕜 Y :=
  diagExtV z (symmForm 𝕜 n P)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.abExtV_apply
declarations.doc: The defining property {lit}`P̃(z)(y*) = (y* ∘ P)~(z)` of the vector-valued extension.
declarations.signature:
theorem abExtV_apply {P : X → Y} (hP : IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P) (z : Bidual 𝕜 X)
    (g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y) : abExtV 𝕜 n P z g = abExt 𝕜 n (fun x => g (P x)) z
declarations.source:
theorem abExtV_apply {P : X → Y} (hP : IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P) (z : Bidual 𝕜 X)
    (g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y) : abExtV 𝕜 n P z g = abExt 𝕜 n (fun x => g (P x)) z := by
  rw [abExtV, diagExtV_apply, abExt, symmForm_comp hP]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.abExt_inclusion
declarations.signature:
theorem abExt_inclusion {P : X → 𝕜} (hP : IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P) (x : X) :
    abExt 𝕜 n P (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual 𝕜 X x) = P x
declarations.source:
theorem abExt_inclusion {P : X → 𝕜} (hP : IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P) (x : X) :
    abExt 𝕜 n P (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual 𝕜 X x) = P x := by
  rw [abExt, diagExt_inclusion, ← diag_apply, diag_symmForm hP]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.dConst
declarations.signature: def dConst (n : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.source: def dConst (n : ℕ) : ℝ := (1 / (n.factorial : ℝ)) * ∑ r ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (n.choose r : ℝ) * (r : ℝ) ^ n

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.hConst
declarations.signature: def hConst (n : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.source: def hConst (n : ℕ) : ℝ := dConst n * (Real.sqrt 2 + 2 * n * (n - 1) * cPol n)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.cConstReal
declarations.signature: def cConstReal (n : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.source: def cConstReal (n : ℕ) : ℝ := dConst n * (1 + 2 * n * (n - 1) * cPol n)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.one_le_dConst
declarations.signature: lemma one_le_dConst {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : 1 ≤ dConst n
declarations.source:
lemma one_le_dConst {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : 1 ≤ dConst n := by
  unfold dConst
  have hfac : (0 : ℝ) < n.factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos n
  have hterm : (n : ℝ) ^ n ≤ ∑ r ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (n.choose r : ℝ) * (r : ℝ) ^ n := by
    have hmem : n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n := Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hn, le_rfl⟩
    have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun r => (n.choose r : ℝ) * (r : ℝ) ^ n)
      (fun r _ => by positivity) hmem
    simpa using this
  rw [one_div, inv_mul_eq_div, le_div_iff₀ hfac, one_mul]
  refine le_trans ?_ hterm
  exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le_pow n

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.dConst_nonneg
declarations.signature: lemma dConst_nonneg (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ dConst n
declarations.source: lemma dConst_nonneg (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ dConst n := by unfold dConst; positivity

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.one_le_hConst
declarations.signature: lemma one_le_hConst {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : 1 ≤ hConst n
declarations.source:
lemma one_le_hConst {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : 1 ≤ hConst n := by
  unfold hConst
  have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt 2 := by
    rw [show (1 : ℝ) = Real.sqrt 1 by simp]
    exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have h2 : 0 ≤ 2 * (n : ℝ) * (n - 1) * cPol n := by
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have := cPol_nonneg n
    have : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) - 1 := by linarith
    positivity
  have := one_le_dConst hn
  nlinarith

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.one_le_cConstReal
declarations.signature: lemma one_le_cConstReal {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : 1 ≤ cConstReal n
declarations.source:
lemma one_le_cConstReal {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : 1 ≤ cConstReal n := by
  unfold cConstReal
  have h2 : 0 ≤ 2 * (n : ℝ) * (n - 1) * cPol n := by
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have := cPol_nonneg n
    have : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) - 1 := by linarith
    positivity
  have := one_le_dConst hn
  nlinarith

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.sum_card_pow_eq
declarations.signature:
lemma sum_card_pow_eq {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (∑ F : Finset (Fin n), ((F.card : ℝ)) ^ n) = n.factorial * dConst n
declarations.source:
lemma sum_card_pow_eq {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (∑ F : Finset (Fin n), ((F.card : ℝ)) ^ n) = n.factorial * dConst n := by
  have h1 := Finset.sum_powerset_apply_card (fun m => ((m : ℝ)) ^ n) (x := (univ : Finset (Fin n)))
  rw [Finset.powerset_univ] at h1
  rw [h1]
  simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  unfold dConst
  have hfac : (n.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.factorial_pos n).ne'
  rw [← mul_assoc, mul_one_div_cancel hfac, one_mul]
  rw [Finset.range_eq_Ico, Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot (by omega)]
  have : Finset.Ico 1 (n + 1) = Finset.Icc 1 n := rfl
  rw [this]
  simp [zero_pow (by omega : n ≠ 0)]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.alt_sum_card_pow
declarations.signature:
lemma alt_sum_card_pow (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ F : Finset (Fin n), ((-1 : 𝕜) ^ (n - F.card)) * ((F.card : 𝕜)) ^ n) = n.factorial
declarations.source:
lemma alt_sum_card_pow (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ F : Finset (Fin n), ((-1 : 𝕜) ^ (n - F.card)) * ((F.card : 𝕜)) ^ n) = n.factorial := by
  have hsymm : IsSymm (ContinuousMultilinearMap.mkPiAlgebra 𝕜 (Fin n) 𝕜) := by
    intro σ v
    simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.mkPiAlgebra_apply, Function.comp_apply]
    exact Equiv.prod_comp σ v
  have := finite_polarization hsymm (fun _ => (1 : 𝕜))
  simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.mkPiAlgebra_apply, diag_apply, Finset.prod_const_one,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_one, Finset.sum_const, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] at this
  rw [this]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.geometry_core
declarations.doc:
The core of Lemma {lit}`lem:geometry`, with abstract defects {lit}`δ` (compatibility) and
{lit}`κ` (flatness along composed vectors).
declarations.signature:
theorem geometry_core {a : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (d + 1)} (ha : IsSymm a) {M : ℝ}
    (hPM : polyNorm (diag a) ≤ M) (f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin d → X) (x : X)
    (hf : ∀ i, ‖f i‖ ≤ 1) (hu : ∀ i, ‖u i‖ ≤ 1) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) {δ κ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hκ : 0 ≤ κ)
    (hcomp : ∀ i j : Fin d, i < j → ‖f i (f j x • u j) - f i x‖ ≤ δ)
    (hflat : ∀ t : Fin d → ℝ, (∀ i, t i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ‖diag a (chainApply f u t x) - (M : 𝕜)‖ ≤ κ) :
    ‖a (zv f u x) - (M : 𝕜)‖ ≤
      dConst (d + 1) * (((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * cPol (d + 1) * M * (d * δ) + κ)
declarations.source:
theorem geometry_core {a : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (d + 1)} (ha : IsSymm a) {M : ℝ}
    (hPM : polyNorm (diag a) ≤ M) (f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin d → X) (x : X)
    (hf : ∀ i, ‖f i‖ ≤ 1) (hu : ∀ i, ‖u i‖ ≤ 1) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) {δ κ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hκ : 0 ≤ κ)
    (hcomp : ∀ i j : Fin d, i < j → ‖f i (f j x • u j) - f i x‖ ≤ δ)
    (hflat : ∀ t : Fin d → ℝ, (∀ i, t i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ‖diag a (chainApply f u t x) - (M : 𝕜)‖ ≤ κ) :
    ‖a (zv f u x) - (M : 𝕜)‖ ≤
      dConst (d + 1) * (((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * cPol (d + 1) * M * (d * δ) + κ) := by
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (polyNorm_nonneg _).trans hPM
  set C' := ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * cPol (d + 1) * M * (d * δ) + κ with hC'
  have hC'0 : 0 ≤ C' := by
    have := cPol_nonneg (d + 1)
    positivity
  have hz : ∀ k, ‖zv f u x k‖ ≤ 1 := norm_zv_le hf hu hx
  -- (a) flatness on the convex hull (`eq:flat`)
  have hconv : ∀ θ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 ≤ θ k) → ∑ k, θ k = 1 →
      ‖diag a (∑ k, ((θ k : ℝ) : 𝕜) • zv f u x k) - (M : 𝕜)‖ ≤ C' := by
    intro θ hθ hθs
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hdist⟩ := chain_approx f u x δ hδ hf hu hcomp θ hθ hθs
    set y := chainApply f u t x
    set v := ∑ k, ((θ k : ℝ) : 𝕜) • zv f u x k
    have hy : ‖y‖ ≤ 1 := (norm_chainApply_le f u t hf hu ht x).trans hx
    have hv : ‖v‖ ≤ 1 := by
      calc ‖v‖ ≤ ∑ k, ‖((θ k : ℝ) : 𝕜) • zv f u x k‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ k, θ k * 1 := by
            gcongr with k
            rw [norm_smul, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_of_nonneg (hθ k)]
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hz k) (hθ k)
        _ = 1 := by simp [hθs]
    have hlip := lipschitz_diag ha hv hy
    calc ‖diag a v - (M : 𝕜)‖ ≤ ‖diag a v - diag a y‖ + ‖diag a y - (M : 𝕜)‖ := by
          rw [← dist_eq_norm, ← dist_eq_norm, ← dist_eq_norm]; exact dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ ≤ ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * cPol (d + 1) * polyNorm (diag a) * ‖v - y‖ + κ :=
          add_le_add hlip (hflat t ht)
      _ ≤ ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * cPol (d + 1) * M * (d * δ) + κ := by
          have hc0 : 0 ≤ ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * cPol (d + 1) := by
            have := cPol_nonneg (d + 1); positivity
          have hvy : ‖v - y‖ ≤ d * δ := by rw [norm_sub_rev]; exact hdist
          have := mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hPM hc0) hvy (norm_nonneg _)
            (by positivity)
          linarith
  -- (b) values on sums over subsets
  have hsub : ∀ F : Finset (Fin (d + 1)),
      ‖diag a (∑ j ∈ F, zv f u x j) - ((F.card : 𝕜)) ^ (d + 1) * (M : 𝕜)‖ ≤
        ((F.card : ℝ)) ^ (d + 1) * C' := by
    intro F
    rcases F.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hF
    · simp only [Finset.sum_empty, Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero]
      have : diag a (0 : X) = 0 := by
        simp only [diag_apply]
        exact a.map_coord_zero 0 rfl
      rw [this, zero_pow (by omega), zero_pow (by omega)]
      simp
    · have hcard : (0 : ℝ) < F.card := by exact_mod_cast hF.card_pos
      set θ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ := fun k => if k ∈ F then 1 / (F.card : ℝ) else 0
      have hθ : ∀ k, 0 ≤ θ k := fun k => by
        simp only [θ]; split_ifs <;> positivity
      have hθs : ∑ k, θ k = 1 := by
        simp only [θ]
        rw [Finset.sum_ite_mem, Finset.univ_inter, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        field_simp
      have hsum : (∑ j ∈ F, zv f u x j) =
          ((F.card : ℝ) : 𝕜) • ∑ k, ((θ k : ℝ) : 𝕜) • zv f u x k := by
        rw [Finset.smul_sum]
        have hk : ∀ k, ((F.card : ℝ) : 𝕜) • (((θ k : ℝ) : 𝕜) • zv f u x k) =
            if k ∈ F then zv f u x k else 0 := by
          intro k
          simp only [θ, smul_smul, ← RCLike.ofReal_mul]
          split_ifs with hk
          · rw [mul_one_div_cancel hcard.ne', RCLike.ofReal_one, one_smul]
          · simp
        simp_rw [hk]
        rw [Finset.sum_ite_mem, Finset.univ_inter]
      rw [hsum, diag_smul_arg]
      have h := hconv θ hθ hθs
      calc ‖(((F.card : ℝ) : 𝕜)) ^ (d + 1) • diag a (∑ k, ((θ k : ℝ) : 𝕜) • zv f u x k) -
            ((F.card : 𝕜)) ^ (d + 1) * (M : 𝕜)‖
          = ((F.card : ℝ)) ^ (d + 1) *
              ‖diag a (∑ k, ((θ k : ℝ) : 𝕜) • zv f u x k) - (M : 𝕜)‖ := by
            rw [smul_eq_mul, show ((F.card : 𝕜)) = (((F.card : ℝ)) : 𝕜) by simp, ← mul_sub,
              norm_mul, norm_pow, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_of_nonneg hcard.le]
        _ ≤ ((F.card : ℝ)) ^ (d + 1) * C' := by gcongr
  -- (c) polarization
  have hpol := finite_polarization ha (zv f u x)
  have halt := alt_sum_card_pow (𝕜 := 𝕜) (d + 1)
  have hfac : (0 : ℝ) < (d + 1).factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos (d + 1)
  have key : (((d + 1).factorial : 𝕜)) * (a (zv f u x) - (M : 𝕜)) =
      ∑ F : Finset (Fin (d + 1)), ((-1 : 𝕜) ^ ((d + 1) - F.card)) *
        (diag a (∑ j ∈ F, zv f u x j) - ((F.card : 𝕜)) ^ (d + 1) * (M : 𝕜)) := by
    rw [mul_sub, ← smul_eq_mul, hpol, ← halt]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun F _ => ?_
    ring
  have hbound : (((d + 1).factorial : ℝ)) * ‖a (zv f u x) - (M : 𝕜)‖ ≤
      (d + 1).factorial * dConst (d + 1) * C' := by
    have h1 : ‖(((d + 1).factorial : 𝕜)) * (a (zv f u x) - (M : 𝕜))‖ =
        ((d + 1).factorial : ℝ) * ‖a (zv f u x) - (M : 𝕜)‖ := by
      rw [norm_mul, RCLike.norm_natCast]
    rw [← h1, key]
    calc ‖∑ F : Finset (Fin (d + 1)), ((-1 : 𝕜) ^ ((d + 1) - F.card)) *
          (diag a (∑ j ∈ F, zv f u x j) - ((F.card : 𝕜)) ^ (d + 1) * (M : 𝕜))‖
        ≤ ∑ F : Finset (Fin (d + 1)), ‖((-1 : 𝕜) ^ ((d + 1) - F.card)) *
          (diag a (∑ j ∈ F, zv f u x j) - ((F.card : 𝕜)) ^ (d + 1) * (M : 𝕜))‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ F : Finset (Fin (d + 1)), ((F.card : ℝ)) ^ (d + 1) * C' := by
          gcongr with F
          rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_neg, norm_one, one_pow, one_mul]
          exact hsub F
      _ = (d + 1).factorial * dConst (d + 1) * C' := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul, sum_card_pow_eq (by omega)]
  have hb2 : ((d + 1).factorial : ℝ) * ‖a (zv f u x) - (M : 𝕜)‖ ≤
      ((d + 1).factorial : ℝ) * (dConst (d + 1) * C') := by
    rw [← mul_assoc]; exact hbound
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hb2 hfac

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.apply_zv
declarations.signature:
lemma apply_zv {a : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (d + 1)} (f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin (d + 1) → X) :
    a (zv f (fun i => u i.castSucc) (u (Fin.last d))) =
      (∏ i, f i (u (Fin.last d))) * a u
declarations.source:
lemma apply_zv {a : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (d + 1)} (f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin (d + 1) → X) :
    a (zv f (fun i => u i.castSucc) (u (Fin.last d))) =
      (∏ i, f i (u (Fin.last d))) * a u := by
  have h : zv f (fun i => u i.castSucc) (u (Fin.last d)) =
      fun k => (Fin.lastCases (1 : 𝕜) (fun j => f j (u (Fin.last d))) k : 𝕜) • u k := by
    funext k
    induction k using Fin.lastCases with
    | last => simp
    | cast j => simp
  rw [h, a.map_smul_univ, Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
  simp

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.norm_prod_le_one
declarations.signature:
lemma norm_prod_le_one {f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X} (hf : ∀ i, ‖f i‖ ≤ 1) {x : X}
    (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) : ‖∏ i, f i x‖ ≤ 1
declarations.source:
lemma norm_prod_le_one {f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X} (hf : ∀ i, ‖f i‖ ≤ 1) {x : X}
    (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) : ‖∏ i, f i x‖ ≤ 1 := by
  rw [norm_prod]
  refine Finset.prod_le_one₀ (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun i _ => ?_)
  calc ‖f i x‖ ≤ ‖f i‖ * ‖x‖ := (f i).le_opNorm x
    _ ≤ 1 * 1 := by gcongr; exact hf i
    _ = 1 := one_mul 1

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.chain_pair_value
declarations.doc: The vector {lit}`S_i(1) S_j(1/2) x` used in the compatibility step.
declarations.signature:
lemma chain_pair_value (f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin d → X) (x : X) {i j : Fin d}
    (hij : i < j) :
    chainApply f u (fun h => if h = i then 1 else if h = j then 1 / 2 else 0) x =
      ((1 / 2 : 𝕜) * (f i x + f j x * f i (u j))) • u i
declarations.source:
lemma chain_pair_value (f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : Fin d → X) (x : X) {i j : Fin d}
    (hij : i < j) :
    chainApply f u (fun h => if h = i then 1 else if h = j then 1 / 2 else 0) x =
      ((1 / 2 : 𝕜) * (f i x + f j x * f i (u j))) • u i := by
  rw [chainApply_pair f u _ i j hij (fun h hi hj => by simp [hi, hj])]
  have hji : j ≠ i := (ne_of_lt hij).symm
  simp only [ite_eq_right hji, substOp_apply]
  simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  push_cast
  simp only [sub_self, zero_smul, zero_add, one_smul]
  congr 1
  ring

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.geometry_lemma
declarations.doc:
**Lemma {lit}`lem:geometry`.** Let {lit}`a` be a symmetric {lit}`(d+1)`-linear form (the symmetric form of
{lit}`P`), {lit}`‖P‖ ≤ M`, {lit}`u₀,…,u_d ∈ B_X`, {lit}`f₀,…,f_{d-1} ∈ B_{X*}`, and suppose that
{lit}`Re P(S₀(t₀) ⋯ S_{d-1}(t_{d-1}) u_d) ≥ M - E` for all {lit}`tᵢ ∈ [0,1]`.  Then
{lit}`|a(u₀,…,u_d)| ≥ M - H_{d+1} √(ME)`.
declarations.signature:
theorem geometry_lemma {a : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (d + 1)} (ha : IsSymm a) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (hPM : polyNorm (diag a) ≤ M) (u : Fin (d + 1) → X) (hu : ∀ i, ‖u i‖ ≤ 1)
    (f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (hf : ∀ i, ‖f i‖ ≤ 1) {E : ℝ} (hE : 0 ≤ E)
    (hpath : ∀ t : Fin d → ℝ, (∀ i, t i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      M - E ≤ RCLike.re (diag a (chainApply f (fun i => u i.castSucc) t (u (Fin.last d))))) :
    M - hConst (d + 1) * Real.sqrt (M * E) ≤ ‖a u‖
declarations.source:
theorem geometry_lemma {a : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (d + 1)} (ha : IsSymm a) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (hPM : polyNorm (diag a) ≤ M) (u : Fin (d + 1) → X) (hu : ∀ i, ‖u i‖ ≤ 1)
    (f : Fin d → StrongDual 𝕜 X) (hf : ∀ i, ‖f i‖ ≤ 1) {E : ℝ} (hE : 0 ≤ E)
    (hpath : ∀ t : Fin d → ℝ, (∀ i, t i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      M - E ≤ RCLike.re (diag a (chainApply f (fun i => u i.castSucc) t (u (Fin.last d))))) :
    M - hConst (d + 1) * Real.sqrt (M * E) ≤ ‖a u‖ := by
  by_cases hEM : M ≤ E
  · have h1 : M ≤ Real.sqrt (M * E) := Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le (by nlinarith)
    have h2 := one_le_hConst (n := d + 1) (by omega)
    have h3 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (M * E) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (a u)]
  push Not at hEM
  set ρ := E / M with hρ
  have hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ := div_nonneg hE hM.le
  have hρ1 : ρ < 1 := (div_lt_one hM).mpr hEM
  set x := u (Fin.last d) with hxdef
  set u' : Fin d → X := fun i => u i.castSucc with hu'def
  have hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1 := hu _
  have hu' : ∀ i, ‖u' i‖ ≤ 1 := fun i => hu _
  -- compatibility (`eq:compatibility`)
  have hcomp : ∀ i j : Fin d, i < j → ‖f i (f j x • u' j) - f i x‖ ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt ρ := by
    intro i j hij
    set c : 𝕜 := (1 / 2 : 𝕜) * (f i x + f j x * f i (u' j)) with hc
    have hval := chain_pair_value f u' x hij
    set t : Fin d → ℝ := fun h => if h = i then 1 else if h = j then 1 / 2 else 0
    have ht : ∀ h, t h ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      intro h; simp only [t]; split_ifs <;> constructor <;> norm_num
    have hp := hpath t ht
    rw [hval, diag_smul_arg] at hp
    have hnfx : ‖f i x‖ ≤ 1 := by
      calc ‖f i x‖ ≤ ‖f i‖ * ‖x‖ := (f i).le_opNorm x
        _ ≤ 1 * 1 := by gcongr; exact hf i
        _ = 1 := one_mul 1
    have hnυ : ‖f j x * f i (u' j)‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [norm_mul]
      have h1 : ‖f j x‖ ≤ 1 := by
        calc ‖f j x‖ ≤ ‖f j‖ * ‖x‖ := (f j).le_opNorm x
          _ ≤ 1 * 1 := by gcongr; exact hf j
          _ = 1 := one_mul 1
      have h2 : ‖f i (u' j)‖ ≤ 1 := by
        calc ‖f i (u' j)‖ ≤ ‖f i‖ * ‖u' j‖ := (f i).le_opNorm _
          _ ≤ 1 * 1 := by gcongr; exacts [hf i, hu' j]
          _ = 1 := one_mul 1
      calc ‖f j x‖ * ‖f i (u' j)‖ ≤ 1 * 1 := by gcongr
        _ = 1 := one_mul 1
    have hcn : ‖c‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [hc, norm_mul]
      have : ‖f i x + f j x * f i (u' j)‖ ≤ 2 :=
        (norm_add_le _ _).trans (by linarith)
      have h2 : ‖(1 / 2 : 𝕜)‖ = 1 / 2 := by simp
      rw [h2]; linarith
    have hpu : ‖diag a (u' i)‖ ≤ M := (norm_diag_le_polyNorm a (hu' i)).trans hPM
    -- `M - E ≤ ‖c‖^(d + 1) M`
    have hcM : M - E ≤ ‖c‖ ^ (d + 1) * M := by
      calc M - E ≤ RCLike.re (c ^ (d + 1) • diag a (u' i)) := hp
        _ ≤ ‖c ^ (d + 1) • diag a (u' i)‖ := RCLike.re_le_norm _
        _ = ‖c‖ ^ (d + 1) * ‖diag a (u' i)‖ := by rw [norm_smul, norm_pow]
        _ ≤ ‖c‖ ^ (d + 1) * M := by gcongr
    have hcn' : 1 - ρ ≤ ‖c‖ ^ (d + 1) := by
      rw [hρ, sub_le_iff_le_add, ← sub_le_iff_le_add', le_div_iff₀ hM]
      linarith
    have hd2 : 2 ≤ (d + 1) := by
      have : (i : ℕ) < j := hij
      have : (j : ℕ) < d := j.isLt
      omega
    have hc2 : 1 - ρ ≤ ‖c‖ ^ 2 :=
      hcn'.trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (norm_nonneg _) hcn hd2)
    -- parallelogram law
    set ξ := f i x
    set υ := f j x * f i (u' j)
    have hυ : f i (f j x • u' j) = υ := by simp [υ]
    rw [hυ]
    have hpar := parallelogram_law_with_norm ℝ ξ υ
    have hsum : ‖ξ + υ‖ = 2 * ‖c‖ := by
      rw [hc, norm_mul]
      simp
    have hsq : ‖υ - ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ (2 * Real.sqrt ρ) ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hρ0, norm_sub_rev]
      have hξ1 := hnfx
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg ξ, norm_nonneg υ, norm_nonneg (ξ - υ)]
    exact (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity) two_ne_zero).mp hsq
  -- flatness along composed vectors
  have hflat : ∀ t : Fin d → ℝ, (∀ i, t i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ‖diag a (chainApply f u' t x) - (M : 𝕜)‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * (M * E)) := by
    intro t ht
    set w := diag a (chainApply f u' t x)
    have hw : ‖w‖ ≤ M :=
      (norm_diag_le_polyNorm a ((norm_chainApply_le f u' t hf hu' ht x).trans hx)).trans hPM
    have hre := hpath t ht
    apply Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le
    have h1 : ‖w - (M : 𝕜)‖ ^ 2 = ‖w‖ ^ 2 - 2 * M * RCLike.re w + M ^ 2 := by
      rw [RCLike.norm_sq_eq_def, RCLike.norm_sq_eq_def]
      simp only [map_sub, RCLike.ofReal_re, RCLike.ofReal_im, sub_zero]
      ring
    rw [h1]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg w]
  have hcore := geometry_core ha hPM f u' x hf hu' hx (by positivity) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    hcomp hflat
  -- simplify the constant
  have hsqrtρ : M * Real.sqrt ρ = Real.sqrt (M * E) := by
    rw [show M * E = M ^ 2 * ρ by rw [hρ]; field_simp, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg M),
      Real.sqrt_sq hM.le]
  have hconst : dConst (d + 1) * (((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * cPol (d + 1) * M * (d * (2 * Real.sqrt ρ)) +
      Real.sqrt (2 * (M * E))) = hConst (d + 1) * Real.sqrt (M * E) := by
    rw [hConst, Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
    have e1 : ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * cPol (d + 1) * M * (d * (2 * Real.sqrt ρ)) =
        2 * ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * d * cPol (d + 1) * (M * Real.sqrt ρ) := by ring
    rw [e1, hsqrtρ]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hconst] at hcore
  have hz := apply_zv (a := a) f u
  have hprod := norm_prod_le_one hf hx
  have hzu : ‖a (zv f u' x)‖ ≤ ‖a u‖ := by
    rw [hz, norm_mul]
    calc ‖∏ i, f i (u (Fin.last d))‖ * ‖a u‖ ≤ 1 * ‖a u‖ := by gcongr
      _ = ‖a u‖ := one_mul _
  have : M - ‖a (zv f u' x) - (M : 𝕜)‖ ≤ ‖a (zv f u' x)‖ := by
    have := norm_sub_norm_le (M : 𝕜) (a (zv f u' x))
    rw [norm_sub_rev (M : 𝕜), RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_of_pos hM] at this
    linarith
  linarith

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.geometry_lemma_real
declarations.doc:
**Remark {lit}`rem:real`.** Over {lit}`ℝ`, the conclusion of Lemma {lit}`lem:geometry` improves to
{lit}`|a(u₀,…,u_d)| ≥ M - C_{d+1} E` with {lit}`C_n = D_n (1 + 2n(n-1)c_n)`.
declarations.signature:
theorem geometry_lemma_real {a : MLin ℝ X ℝ (d + 1)} (ha : IsSymm a) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (hPM : polyNorm (diag a) ≤ M) (u : Fin (d + 1) → X) (hu : ∀ i, ‖u i‖ ≤ 1)
    (f : Fin d → StrongDual ℝ X) (hf : ∀ i, ‖f i‖ ≤ 1) {E : ℝ} (hE : 0 ≤ E)
    (hpath : ∀ t : Fin d → ℝ, (∀ i, t i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      M - E ≤ diag a (chainApply f (fun i => u i.castSucc) t (u (Fin.last d)))) :
    M - cConstReal (d + 1) * E ≤ |a u|
declarations.source:
theorem geometry_lemma_real {a : MLin ℝ X ℝ (d + 1)} (ha : IsSymm a) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (hPM : polyNorm (diag a) ≤ M) (u : Fin (d + 1) → X) (hu : ∀ i, ‖u i‖ ≤ 1)
    (f : Fin d → StrongDual ℝ X) (hf : ∀ i, ‖f i‖ ≤ 1) {E : ℝ} (hE : 0 ≤ E)
    (hpath : ∀ t : Fin d → ℝ, (∀ i, t i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      M - E ≤ diag a (chainApply f (fun i => u i.castSucc) t (u (Fin.last d)))) :
    M - cConstReal (d + 1) * E ≤ |a u| := by
  by_cases hEM : M ≤ E
  · have h2 := one_le_cConstReal (n := d + 1) (by omega)
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg (a u)]
  push Not at hEM
  set ρ := E / M with hρ
  have hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ := div_nonneg hE hM.le
  set x := u (Fin.last d) with hxdef
  set u' : Fin d → X := fun i => u i.castSucc with hu'def
  have hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1 := hu _
  have hu' : ∀ i, ‖u' i‖ ≤ 1 := fun i => hu _
  have hcomp : ∀ i j : Fin d, i < j → ‖f i (f j x • u' j) - f i x‖ ≤ 2 * ρ := by
    intro i j hij
    set c : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (f i x + f j x * f i (u' j)) with hc
    have hval := chain_pair_value f u' x hij
    set t : Fin d → ℝ := fun h => if h = i then 1 else if h = j then 1 / 2 else 0
    have ht : ∀ h, t h ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      intro h; simp only [t]; split_ifs <;> constructor <;> norm_num
    have hp := hpath t ht
    rw [hval, diag_smul_arg] at hp
    have hbound : ∀ (g : StrongDual ℝ X) (v : X), ‖g‖ ≤ 1 → ‖v‖ ≤ 1 → |g v| ≤ 1 := by
      intro g v hg hv
      calc |g v| = ‖g v‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
        _ ≤ ‖g‖ * ‖v‖ := g.le_opNorm v
        _ ≤ 1 * 1 := by gcongr
        _ = 1 := one_mul 1
    have hξ : |f i x| ≤ 1 := hbound _ _ (hf i) hx
    have hυ : |f j x * f i (u' j)| ≤ 1 := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      have h1 := hbound _ _ (hf j) hx
      have h2 := hbound _ _ (hf i) (hu' j)
      calc |f j x| * |f i (u' j)| ≤ 1 * 1 := by gcongr
        _ = 1 := one_mul 1
    have hcn : |c| ≤ 1 := by
      rw [hc, abs_mul]
      have : |f i x + f j x * f i (u' j)| ≤ 2 := (abs_add_le _ _).trans (by linarith)
      rw [abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)]; linarith
    have hpu : |diag a (u' i)| ≤ M := by
      have := (norm_diag_le_polyNorm a (hu' i)).trans hPM
      rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    have hcM : M - E ≤ |c| ^ (d + 1) * M := by
      calc M - E ≤ c ^ (d + 1) • diag a (u' i) := hp
        _ ≤ |c ^ (d + 1) • diag a (u' i)| := le_abs_self _
        _ = |c| ^ (d + 1) * |diag a (u' i)| := by rw [smul_eq_mul, abs_mul, abs_pow]
        _ ≤ |c| ^ (d + 1) * M := by gcongr
    have hcn' : 1 - ρ ≤ |c| ^ (d + 1) := by
      rw [hρ, sub_le_iff_le_add, ← sub_le_iff_le_add', le_div_iff₀ hM]
      linarith
    have hc1 : 1 - ρ ≤ |c| :=
      hcn'.trans (pow_le_of_le_one (abs_nonneg _) hcn (by omega))
    set ξ := f i x
    set υ := f j x * f i (u' j)
    have hυeq : f i (f j x • u' j) = υ := by simp [υ]
    rw [hυeq, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hsum : |ξ + υ| = 2 * |c| := by
      rw [hc, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)]; ring
    have hpm : |υ - ξ| + |ξ + υ| ≤ 2 := by
      rw [abs_le] at hξ hυ
      rcases abs_cases (υ - ξ) with ⟨h1, _⟩ | ⟨h1, _⟩ <;>
        rcases abs_cases (ξ + υ) with ⟨h2, _⟩ | ⟨h2, _⟩ <;> linarith
    linarith
  have hflat : ∀ t : Fin d → ℝ, (∀ i, t i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ‖diag a (chainApply f u' t x) - ((M : ℝ) : ℝ)‖ ≤ E := by
    intro t ht
    have hw : |diag a (chainApply f u' t x)| ≤ M := by
      have := (norm_diag_le_polyNorm a
        ((norm_chainApply_le f u' t hf hu' ht x).trans hx)).trans hPM
      rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    have hre := hpath t ht
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
    constructor
    · linarith
    · linarith [le_abs_self (diag a (chainApply f u' t x))]
  have hcore := geometry_core ha hPM f u' x hf hu' hx (by positivity) hE hcomp
    (by simpa using hflat)
  have hconst : dConst (d + 1) * (((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * cPol (d + 1) * M * (d * (2 * ρ)) + E) =
      cConstReal (d + 1) * E := by
    rw [cConstReal]
    have hMρ : M * ρ = E := by rw [hρ]; field_simp
    have e1 : ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * cPol (d + 1) * M * (d * (2 * ρ)) =
        2 * ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * d * cPol (d + 1) * (M * ρ) := by ring
    rw [e1, hMρ]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hconst] at hcore
  have hz := apply_zv (a := a) f u
  have hprod := norm_prod_le_one hf hx
  have hzu : |a (zv f u' x)| ≤ |a u| := by
    rw [hz, abs_mul]
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hprod
    calc |∏ i, f i (u (Fin.last d))| * |a u| ≤ 1 * |a u| := by gcongr
      _ = |a u| := one_mul _
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hcore
  have : M - |a (zv f u' x) - M| ≤ |a (zv f u' x)| := by
    have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub M (a (zv f u' x))
    rw [abs_sub_comm M, abs_of_pos hM] at this
    linarith
  simp only [RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id] at hcore
  linarith

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.evalc
declarations.doc: Evaluation of the polynomial with coefficient vector {lit}`c`.
declarations.signature: def evalc {n : ℕ} (c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ
declarations.source: def evalc {n : ℕ} (c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ k : Fin (n + 1), c k * t ^ (k : ℕ)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.continuous_evalc_uncurry
declarations.signature:
lemma continuous_evalc_uncurry (n : ℕ) :
    Continuous (Function.uncurry fun (c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => |evalc c t|)
declarations.source:
lemma continuous_evalc_uncurry (n : ℕ) :
    Continuous (Function.uncurry fun (c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => |evalc c t|) := by
  unfold evalc
  apply Continuous.abs
  apply continuous_finsetSum
  intro k _
  exact ((continuous_apply k).comp continuous_fst).mul (continuous_snd.pow _)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.Phi
declarations.signature: def Phi {n : ℕ} (c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) : ℝ
declarations.source: def Phi {n : ℕ} (c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) : ℝ := ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, |evalc c t|

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.continuous_Phi
declarations.signature: lemma continuous_Phi (n : ℕ) : Continuous (Phi (n := n))
declarations.source:
lemma continuous_Phi (n : ℕ) : Continuous (Phi (n := n)) :=
  intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
    (continuous_evalc_uncurry n) 0 1

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.evalc_smul
declarations.signature:
lemma evalc_smul {n : ℕ} (a : ℝ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    evalc (a • c) t = a * evalc c t
declarations.source:
lemma evalc_smul {n : ℕ} (a : ℝ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    evalc (a • c) t = a * evalc c t := by
  simp [evalc, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.Phi_smul
declarations.signature: lemma Phi_smul {n : ℕ} (a : ℝ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) : Phi (a • c) = |a| * Phi c
declarations.source:
lemma Phi_smul {n : ℕ} (a : ℝ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) : Phi (a • c) = |a| * Phi c := by
  simp only [Phi, evalc_smul, abs_mul]
  exact intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul _ _

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.Phi_nonneg
declarations.signature: lemma Phi_nonneg {n : ℕ} (c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) : 0 ≤ Phi c
declarations.source:
lemma Phi_nonneg {n : ℕ} (c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) : 0 ≤ Phi c :=
  intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg zero_le_one (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.Phi_pos
declarations.signature: lemma Phi_pos {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ} (hc : c ≠ 0) : 0 < Phi c
declarations.source:
lemma Phi_pos {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ} (hc : c ≠ 0) : 0 < Phi c := by
  by_contra hle
  push Not at hle
  have hzero : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, evalc c t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    by_contra hne
    have hcont : Continuous fun t => |evalc c t| :=
      (continuous_evalc_uncurry n).comp (Continuous.prodMk continuous_const continuous_id)
    have := intervalIntegral.integral_pos (a := 0) (b := 1) zero_lt_one hcont.continuousOn
      (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _) ⟨t, ht, abs_pos.mpr hne⟩
    exact absurd hle (not_le.mpr this)
  set p : Polynomial ℝ := ∑ k : Fin (n + 1), Polynomial.C (c k) * Polynomial.X ^ (k : ℕ)
  have hp_eval : ∀ t, p.eval t = evalc c t := by
    intro t; simp [p, evalc, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum]
  have hp0 : p = 0 := by
    apply Polynomial.eq_zero_of_infinite_isRoot
    apply Set.Infinite.mono (s := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    · intro t ht
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Polynomial.IsRoot, hp_eval]
      exact hzero t ht
    · exact Set.Icc_infinite zero_lt_one
  apply hc
  funext j
  have hcoeff : p.coeff j = c j := by
    simp only [p, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
    · simp
    · intro k _ hkj
      rw [ite_eq_right]
      intro h
      exact hkj (Fin.ext h.symm)
    · simp
  rw [← hcoeff, hp0]
  simp

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.lemmaK
declarations.doc:
**Lemma {lit}`lem:K`.** For every {lit}`n` there is {lit}`K ≥ 1` such that
{lit}`max_{0 ≤ t ≤ 1} r(t) ≤ K ∫₀¹ r(t) dt` for every real polynomial {lit}`r` of degree at most {lit}`n`
which is nonnegative on {lit}`[0,1]`.
declarations.signature:
theorem lemmaK (n : ℕ) : ∃ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K ∧ ∀ r : Polynomial ℝ, r.natDegree ≤ n →
    (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, 0 ≤ r.eval t) →
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, r.eval t ≤ K * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, r.eval s
declarations.source:
theorem lemmaK (n : ℕ) : ∃ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K ∧ ∀ r : Polynomial ℝ, r.natDegree ≤ n →
    (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, 0 ≤ r.eval t) →
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, r.eval t ≤ K * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, r.eval s := by
  have hS : IsCompact (Metric.sphere (0 : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) 1) := isCompact_sphere 0 1
  have hne : (Metric.sphere (0 : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) 1).Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨fun _ => 1, ?_⟩
    rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm, pi_norm_const]
    simp
  obtain ⟨c0, hc0S, hmin⟩ := hS.exists_isMinOn hne (continuous_Phi n).continuousOn
  have hc0 : c0 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; rw [h] at hc0S; simp at hc0S
  set m := Phi c0 with hm
  have hmpos : 0 < m := Phi_pos hc0
  refine ⟨max 1 ((n + 1) / m), le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro r hr hnonneg t ht
  set c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ := fun k => r.coeff k
  have heval : ∀ s, r.eval s = evalc c s := by
    intro s
    rw [Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range' (n := n + 1) (by omega), ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
    rfl
  have hint_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, r.eval s :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg zero_le_one hnonneg
  by_cases hc : c = 0
  · have : r.eval t = 0 := by rw [heval]; simp [evalc, hc]
    rw [this]
    exact mul_nonneg (le_trans zero_le_one (le_max_left _ _)) hint_nonneg
  · have hcpos : 0 < ‖c‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hc
    -- the integral equals `Φ(c) ≥ ‖c‖ m`
    have hint : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, r.eval s) = Phi c := by
      unfold Phi
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun s hs => ?_
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at hs
      rw [← heval, abs_of_nonneg (hnonneg s hs)]
    have hPhi : ‖c‖ * m ≤ Phi c := by
      have hunit : ‖c‖⁻¹ • c ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) 1 := by
        rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm, norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm,
          inv_mul_cancel₀ hcpos.ne']
      have h1 : Phi c0 ≤ Phi (‖c‖⁻¹ • c) := hmin hunit
      rw [Phi_smul, abs_inv, abs_norm] at h1
      rw [← hm] at h1
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hcpos.le
      rwa [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hcpos.ne', one_mul] at this
    -- pointwise bound `r(t) ≤ (n+1) ‖c‖`
    have hpt : r.eval t ≤ (n + 1) * ‖c‖ := by
      rw [heval]
      calc evalc c t ≤ |evalc c t| := le_abs_self _
        _ ≤ ∑ k : Fin (n + 1), |c k * t ^ (k : ℕ)| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ _k : Fin (n + 1), ‖c‖ := by
            gcongr with k
            rw [abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_of_nonneg ht.1]
            calc |c k| * t ^ (k : ℕ) ≤ |c k| * 1 := by
                  gcongr
                  exact pow_le_one₀ ht.1 ht.2
              _ = ‖c k‖ := by rw [mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
              _ ≤ ‖c‖ := norm_le_pi_norm c k
        _ = (n + 1) * ‖c‖ := by simp
    calc r.eval t ≤ (n + 1) * ‖c‖ := hpt
      _ = ((n + 1) / m) * (‖c‖ * m) := by field_simp
      _ ≤ ((n + 1) / m) * Phi c := by gcongr
      _ ≤ max 1 ((n + 1) / m) * Phi c := by
          gcongr
          · exact Phi_nonneg c
          · exact le_max_right _ _
      _ = max 1 ((n + 1) / m) * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, r.eval s := by rw [hint]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.polyNorm_seq_diff
declarations.signature:
lemma polyNorm_seq_diff [Nontrivial X] (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a)
    (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) (k N : ℕ) :
    polyNorm (diag (seqP A a (k + N) - seqP A a k)) ≤ 2 * alpha a k / (1 - a)
declarations.source:
lemma polyNorm_seq_diff [Nontrivial X] (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a)
    (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) (k N : ℕ) :
    polyNorm (diag (seqP A a (k + N) - seqP A a k)) ≤ 2 * alpha a k / (1 - a) := by
  have h1a : 0 < 1 - a := by linarith
  have key : polyNorm (diag (seqP A a (k + N) - seqP A a k)) ≤
      (∑ i ∈ range N, alpha a (k + i)) / (1 - a) := by
    induction N with
    | zero =>
      simp only [add_zero, sub_self, Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_div]
      exact polyNorm_le le_rfl (fun x _ => by simp [diag_apply])
    | succ N ih =>
      have h := polyNorm_diag_add_le (seqP A a (k + (N + 1)) - seqP A a (k + N))
        (seqP A a (k + N) - seqP A a k)
      rw [sub_add_sub_cancel] at h
      have hinc := polyNorm_seq_increment (A := A) ha (k + N)
      have hM := seqM_le hA1 ha (by linarith) (k + N)
      have hα := alpha_pos ha (k + N)
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, add_div]
      have : alpha a (k + N) * seqM A a (k + N) ≤ alpha a (k + N) / (1 - a) := by
        rw [div_eq_mul_one_div]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hM hα.le
      rw [show k + (N + 1) = k + N + 1 by ring] at h ⊢
      linarith
  refine key.trans ?_
  gcongr
  exact sum_alpha_le ha.le (by linarith) k N

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.opNorm_seq_diff
declarations.signature:
lemma opNorm_seq_diff [Nontrivial X] (hA : IsSymm A) (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a)
    (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) (k N : ℕ) :
    ‖seqP A a (k + N) - seqP A a k‖ ≤ cPol (d + 1) * (2 * alpha a k / (1 - a))
declarations.source:
lemma opNorm_seq_diff [Nontrivial X] (hA : IsSymm A) (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a)
    (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) (k N : ℕ) :
    ‖seqP A a (k + N) - seqP A a k‖ ≤ cPol (d + 1) * (2 * alpha a k / (1 - a)) :=
  (opNorm_le_cPol_mul ((isSymm_seqP hA _).sub (isSymm_seqP hA _))).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (polyNorm_seq_diff hA1 ha ha8 k N) (cPol_nonneg _))

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.cauchySeq_seqP
declarations.signature:
lemma cauchySeq_seqP [Nontrivial X] (hA : IsSymm A) (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a)
    (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) : CauchySeq (seqP A a)
declarations.source:
lemma cauchySeq_seqP [Nontrivial X] (hA : IsSymm A) (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a)
    (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) : CauchySeq (seqP A a) := by
  refine cauchySeq_of_le_tendsto_0 (fun k => 2 * (cPol (d + 1) * (2 * alpha a k / (1 - a))))
    ?_ ?_
  · intro m n N hm hn
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hm
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
    have h1 := opNorm_seq_diff hA hA1 ha ha8 N i
    have h2 := opNorm_seq_diff hA hA1 ha ha8 N j
    calc ‖seqP A a (N + i) - seqP A a (N + j)‖
        = ‖(seqP A a (N + i) - seqP A a N) - (seqP A a (N + j) - seqP A a N)‖ := by
          congr 1; abel
      _ ≤ ‖seqP A a (N + i) - seqP A a N‖ + ‖seqP A a (N + j) - seqP A a N‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ _ := by linarith
  · have h := tendsto_alpha ha.le (by linarith : a < 1)
    have := ((h.const_mul 2).div_const (1 - a)).const_mul (cPol (d + 1)) |>.const_mul 2
    simpa using this

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.limQ
declarations.signature: def limQ [CompleteSpace Y] (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y (d + 1)) (a : ℝ) : MLin 𝕜 X Y (d + 1)
declarations.source:
def limQ [CompleteSpace Y] (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y (d + 1)) (a : ℝ) : MLin 𝕜 X Y (d + 1) :=
  limUnder atTop (seqP A a)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.tendsto_limQ
declarations.signature:
lemma tendsto_limQ [CompleteSpace Y] [Nontrivial X] (hA : IsSymm A)
    (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a) (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) :
    Tendsto (seqP A a) atTop (𝓝 (limQ A a))
declarations.source:
lemma tendsto_limQ [CompleteSpace Y] [Nontrivial X] (hA : IsSymm A)
    (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a) (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) :
    Tendsto (seqP A a) atTop (𝓝 (limQ A a)) :=
  (cauchySeq_seqP hA hA1 ha ha8).tendsto_limUnder

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.isSymm_limQ
declarations.signature:
lemma isSymm_limQ [CompleteSpace Y] [Nontrivial X] (hA : IsSymm A)
    (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a) (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) : IsSymm (limQ A a)
declarations.source:
lemma isSymm_limQ [CompleteSpace Y] [Nontrivial X] (hA : IsSymm A)
    (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a) (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) : IsSymm (limQ A a) :=
  isClosed_isSymm.mem_of_tendsto (tendsto_limQ hA hA1 ha ha8)
    (Eventually.of_forall fun k => isSymm_seqP hA k)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.polyNorm_limQ_sub
declarations.signature:
lemma polyNorm_limQ_sub [CompleteSpace Y] [Nontrivial X] (hA : IsSymm A)
    (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a) (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) (k : ℕ) :
    polyNorm (diag (limQ A a - seqP A a k)) ≤ 4 * alpha a k
declarations.source:
lemma polyNorm_limQ_sub [CompleteSpace Y] [Nontrivial X] (hA : IsSymm A)
    (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a) (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) (k : ℕ) :
    polyNorm (diag (limQ A a - seqP A a k)) ≤ 4 * alpha a k := by
  have hα := alpha_pos ha k
  have hb : 2 * alpha a k / (1 - a) ≤ 4 * alpha a k := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]; nlinarith
  apply polyNorm_le (by linarith)
  intro x hx
  have hT := tendsto_limQ hA hA1 ha ha8
  have hT' : Tendsto (fun N => diag (seqP A a (k + N) - seqP A a k) x) atTop
      (𝓝 (diag (limQ A a - seqP A a k) x)) := by
    have h1 : Tendsto (fun N => seqP A a (k + N)) atTop (𝓝 (limQ A a)) :=
      hT.comp (tendsto_atTop_atTop_of_monotone (fun _ _ h => by omega)
        (fun b => ⟨b, by omega⟩))
    have h2 := (h1.sub_const (seqP A a k))
    have hc : Continuous fun B : MLin 𝕜 X Y (d + 1) => diag B x :=
      by unfold diag; fun_prop
    exact (hc.tendsto _).comp h2
  refine le_of_tendsto hT'.norm (Eventually.of_forall fun N => ?_)
  exact (norm_diag_le_polyNorm _ hx).trans ((polyNorm_seq_diff hA1 ha ha8 k N).trans hb)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.opNorm_limQ_sub
declarations.signature:
lemma opNorm_limQ_sub [CompleteSpace Y] [Nontrivial X] (hA : IsSymm A)
    (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a) (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) (k : ℕ) :
    ‖limQ A a - seqP A a k‖ ≤ cPol (d + 1) * (4 * alpha a k)
declarations.source:
lemma opNorm_limQ_sub [CompleteSpace Y] [Nontrivial X] (hA : IsSymm A)
    (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a) (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) (k : ℕ) :
    ‖limQ A a - seqP A a k‖ ≤ cPol (d + 1) * (4 * alpha a k) :=
  (opNorm_le_cPol_mul ((isSymm_limQ hA hA1 ha ha8).sub (isSymm_seqP hA _))).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (polyNorm_limQ_sub hA hA1 ha ha8 k) (cPol_nonneg _))

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.abs_polyNorm_limQ_sub
declarations.signature:
lemma abs_polyNorm_limQ_sub [CompleteSpace Y] [Nontrivial X] (hA : IsSymm A)
    (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a) (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) (k : ℕ) :
    |polyNorm (diag (limQ A a)) - seqM A a k| ≤ 4 * alpha a k
declarations.source:
lemma abs_polyNorm_limQ_sub [CompleteSpace Y] [Nontrivial X] (hA : IsSymm A)
    (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a) (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) (k : ℕ) :
    |polyNorm (diag (limQ A a)) - seqM A a k| ≤ 4 * alpha a k :=
  (abs_polyNorm_diag_sub_le _ _).trans (polyNorm_limQ_sub hA hA1 ha ha8 k)

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.polyNorm_limQ_sub_A
declarations.signature:
lemma polyNorm_limQ_sub_A [CompleteSpace Y] [Nontrivial X] (hA : IsSymm A)
    (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a) (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) :
    polyNorm (diag (limQ A a - A)) ≤ 4 * a
declarations.source:
lemma polyNorm_limQ_sub_A [CompleteSpace Y] [Nontrivial X] (hA : IsSymm A)
    (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a) (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) :
    polyNorm (diag (limQ A a - A)) ≤ 4 * a := by
  have := polyNorm_limQ_sub hA hA1 ha ha8 0
  simpa [seqP, alpha_zero] using this

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.cPol
declarations.signature: def cPol (n : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.source: def cPol (n : ℕ) : ℝ := (n : ℝ) ^ n / n.factorial

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.cPol_nonneg
declarations.signature: lemma cPol_nonneg (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ cPol n
declarations.source: lemma cPol_nonneg (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ cPol n := by unfold cPol; positivity

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.one_le_cPol
declarations.signature: lemma one_le_cPol (n : ℕ) : 1 ≤ cPol n
declarations.source:
lemma one_le_cPol (n : ℕ) : 1 ≤ cPol n := by
  unfold cPol
  rw [le_div_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos n), one_mul]
  exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le_pow n

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.map_diag_sum_smul
declarations.doc: Expansion of {lit}`A (∑ cⱼ vⱼ, …, ∑ cⱼ vⱼ)`.
declarations.signature:
lemma map_diag_sum_smul {m : ℕ} (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) (c : Fin m → 𝕜) (v : Fin m → X) :
    A (fun _ => ∑ j, c j • v j) = ∑ g : Fin n → Fin m, (∏ i, c (g i)) • A (v ∘ g)
declarations.source:
lemma map_diag_sum_smul {m : ℕ} (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) (c : Fin m → 𝕜) (v : Fin m → X) :
    A (fun _ => ∑ j, c j • v j) = ∑ g : Fin n → Fin m, (∏ i, c (g i)) • A (v ∘ g) := by
  change A.toMultilinearMap (fun i => ∑ j, (fun (_ : Fin n) j => c j • v j) i j) = _
  rw [MultilinearMap.map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun g _ => ?_
  exact A.map_smul_univ (fun i => c (g i)) (fun i => v (g i))

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.sum_superset_neg_one_pow
declarations.signature:
lemma sum_superset_neg_one_pow (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    (∑ F : Finset (Fin n), if S ⊆ F then ((-1 : 𝕜) ^ (n - F.card)) else 0) =
      if S = univ then 1 else 0
declarations.source:
lemma sum_superset_neg_one_pow (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    (∑ F : Finset (Fin n), if S ⊆ F then ((-1 : 𝕜) ^ (n - F.card)) else 0) =
      if S = univ then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  have h1 : (∑ F : Finset (Fin n), if S ⊆ F then ((-1 : 𝕜) ^ (n - F.card)) else 0) =
      ∑ T : Finset (Fin n), if T ⊆ Sᶜ then ((-1 : 𝕜) ^ T.card) else 0 := by
    refine Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.mk (fun F => Fᶜ) (fun T => Tᶜ) (fun F => by simp)
      (fun T => by simp)) _ _ (fun F => ?_)
    simp only [Equiv.coe_fn_mk]
    simp only [Finset.compl_subset_compl, Finset.card_compl, Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [h1, ← Finset.sum_filter]
  have h2 : (univ.filter fun T : Finset (Fin n) => T ⊆ Sᶜ) = (Sᶜ).powerset := by
    ext T; simp
  rw [h2]
  have h3 := Finset.sum_powerset_neg_one_pow_card (x := Sᶜ)
  have h4 : (∑ m ∈ (Sᶜ).powerset, (-1 : 𝕜) ^ m.card) =
      ((∑ m ∈ (Sᶜ).powerset, (-1 : ℤ) ^ m.card : ℤ) : 𝕜) := by push_cast; rfl
  rw [h4, h3]
  have : (Sᶜ = ∅) ↔ S = univ := by
    constructor
    · intro h; simpa using congrArg (fun T => Tᶜ) h
    · intro h; simp [h]
  by_cases hS : S = univ
  · simp [hS]
  · simp [hS, this.not.mpr hS]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.sum_bijective_eq_sum_perm
declarations.doc:
Sum over all maps {lit}`g : Fin n → Fin n` restricted to bijective ones is a sum over
permutations.
declarations.signature:
lemma sum_bijective_eq_sum_perm (F : (Fin n → Fin n) → Y) :
    (∑ g : Fin n → Fin n, if Function.Bijective g then F g else 0) =
      ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), F σ
declarations.source:
lemma sum_bijective_eq_sum_perm (F : (Fin n → Fin n) → Y) :
    (∑ g : Fin n → Fin n, if Function.Bijective g then F g else 0) =
      ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), F σ := by
  classical
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  symm
  refine Finset.sum_nbij' (fun σ => ⇑σ)
    (fun g => if h : Function.Bijective g then Equiv.ofBijective g h else 1) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro σ _; exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, σ.bijective⟩
  · intro g _; exact Finset.mem_univ _
  · intro σ _
    rw [dite_eq_left σ.bijective]
    exact Equiv.ext fun _ => rfl
  · intro g hg
    have hg' : Function.Bijective g := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hg).2
    rw [dite_eq_left hg']
    rfl
  · intro σ _; rfl

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.sum_perm_symm
declarations.signature:
lemma sum_perm_symm {A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n} (hA : IsSymm A) (v : Fin n → X) :
    (∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), A (v ∘ σ)) = (n.factorial : 𝕜) • A v
declarations.source:
lemma sum_perm_symm {A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n} (hA : IsSymm A) (v : Fin n → X) :
    (∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), A (v ∘ σ)) = (n.factorial : 𝕜) • A v := by
  simp only [hA _ v, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_perm, Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.finite_polarization
declarations.doc:
The finite polarization formula ({lit}`eq:finitepolar`):
{lit}`n! A(v₁,…,vₙ) = ∑_{F ⊆ {1,…,n}} (-1)^{n-|F|} P(∑_{j ∈ F} vⱼ)`.
declarations.signature:
theorem finite_polarization {A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n} (hA : IsSymm A) (v : Fin n → X) :
    (n.factorial : 𝕜) • A v =
      ∑ F : Finset (Fin n), ((-1 : 𝕜) ^ (n - F.card)) • diag A (∑ j ∈ F, v j)
declarations.source:
theorem finite_polarization {A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n} (hA : IsSymm A) (v : Fin n → X) :
    (n.factorial : 𝕜) • A v =
      ∑ F : Finset (Fin n), ((-1 : 𝕜) ^ (n - F.card)) • diag A (∑ j ∈ F, v j) := by
  classical
  have hexp : ∀ F : Finset (Fin n), diag A (∑ j ∈ F, v j) =
      ∑ g : Fin n → Fin n, (if ∀ i, g i ∈ F then (1 : 𝕜) else 0) • A (v ∘ g) := by
    intro F
    have : (∑ j ∈ F, v j) = ∑ j, (if j ∈ F then (1 : 𝕜) else 0) • v j := by
      simp only [ite_smul, one_smul, zero_smul]
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_mem, Finset.univ_inter]
    rw [diag_apply, this, map_diag_sum_smul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun g _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.prod_boole]
    simp
  simp_rw [hexp, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp_rw [← Finset.sum_smul]
  have hin : ∀ g : Fin n → Fin n,
      (∑ F : Finset (Fin n), (-1 : 𝕜) ^ (n - F.card) * if ∀ i, g i ∈ F then (1 : 𝕜) else 0) =
        if Function.Bijective g then 1 else 0 := by
    intro g
    have := sum_superset_neg_one_pow (𝕜 := 𝕜) (univ.image g)
    have e1 : ∀ F : Finset (Fin n), ((-1 : 𝕜) ^ (n - F.card) *
        if ∀ i, g i ∈ F then (1 : 𝕜) else 0) =
          if univ.image g ⊆ F then ((-1 : 𝕜) ^ (n - F.card)) else 0 := by
      intro F
      have : (∀ i, g i ∈ F) ↔ univ.image g ⊆ F := by
        simp [Finset.image_subset_iff]
      by_cases h : ∀ i, g i ∈ F
      · simp [h, this.mp h]
      · simp [h, this.not.mp h]
    simp_rw [e1]
    rw [this]
    have e2 : univ.image g = univ ↔ Function.Bijective g := by
      constructor
      · intro h
        apply Finite.surjective_iff_bijective.mp
        intro j
        have : j ∈ univ.image g := by rw [h]; exact Finset.mem_univ j
        obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp this
        exact ⟨i, hi⟩
      · intro h
        exact Finset.eq_univ_of_forall fun j => by
          obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h.2 j
          exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, hi⟩
    by_cases h : Function.Bijective g
    · rw [ite_eq_left h, ite_eq_left (e2.mpr h)]
    · rw [ite_eq_right h, ite_eq_right (e2.not.mpr h)]
  simp_rw [hin, ite_smul, one_smul, zero_smul]
  rw [sum_bijective_eq_sum_perm (fun g => A (v ∘ g)), sum_perm_symm hA]

declarations.signature: lemma norm_sgn (b : Bool) : ‖(sgn b : 𝕜)‖ = 1
declarations.source: lemma norm_sgn (b : Bool) : ‖(sgn b : 𝕜)‖ = 1 := by cases b <;> simp [sgn]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.sum_sign_inner
declarations.signature:
lemma sum_sign_inner (g : Fin n → Fin n) :
    (∑ ε : Fin n → Bool, (∏ j, (sgn (ε j) : 𝕜)) * ∏ i, (sgn (ε (g i)) : 𝕜)) =
      if Function.Bijective g then (2 : 𝕜) ^ n else 0
declarations.source:
lemma sum_sign_inner (g : Fin n → Fin n) :
    (∑ ε : Fin n → Bool, (∏ j, (sgn (ε j) : 𝕜)) * ∏ i, (sgn (ε (g i)) : 𝕜)) =
      if Function.Bijective g then (2 : 𝕜) ^ n else 0 := by
  classical
  by_cases hg : Function.Bijective g
  · rw [ite_eq_left hg]
    have : ∀ ε : Fin n → Bool, (∏ j, (sgn (ε j) : 𝕜)) * ∏ i, (sgn (ε (g i)) : 𝕜) = 1 := by
      intro ε
      have h := Equiv.prod_comp (Equiv.ofBijective g hg) (fun j => (sgn (ε j) : 𝕜))
      simp only [Equiv.ofBijective_apply] at h
      rw [h, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
      exact Finset.prod_eq_one (fun j _ => sgn_sq _)
    simp [this, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_bool]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hg]
    have hns : ¬ Function.Surjective g := fun h => hg (Finite.surjective_iff_bijective.mp h)
    simp only [Function.Surjective, not_forall, not_exists] at hns
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hns
    set F : (Fin n → Bool) → 𝕜 := fun ε => (∏ k, (sgn (ε k) : 𝕜)) * ∏ i, (sgn (ε (g i)) : 𝕜)
    let e : (Fin n → Bool) ≃ (Fin n → Bool) :=
      { toFun := fun ε => Function.update ε j (!ε j)
        invFun := fun ε => Function.update ε j (!ε j)
        left_inv := fun ε => by ext k; by_cases hk : k = j <;> simp [Function.update, hk]
        right_inv := fun ε => by ext k; by_cases hk : k = j <;> simp [Function.update, hk] }
    have hflip : ∀ ε, F (e ε) = - F ε := by
      intro ε
      simp only [F, e, Equiv.coe_fn_mk]
      have h1 : (∏ i, (sgn (Function.update ε j (!ε j) (g i)) : 𝕜)) =
          ∏ i, (sgn (ε (g i)) : 𝕜) := by
        refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [Function.update_of_ne (hj i)]
      have h2 : (∏ k, (sgn (Function.update ε j (!ε j) k) : 𝕜)) =
          - ∏ k, (sgn (ε k) : 𝕜) := by
        rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase univ _ (Finset.mem_univ j),
          ← Finset.mul_prod_erase univ (fun k => (sgn (ε k) : 𝕜)) (Finset.mem_univ j)]
        simp only [Function.update_self, sgn_not]
        rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun k hk => by
          rw [Function.update_of_ne (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hk)])]
        ring
      rw [h1, h2]; ring
    have hsum : (∑ ε, F ε) = - ∑ ε, F ε := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← Equiv.sum_comp e F]
      simp_rw [hflip, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    have : (2 : 𝕜) * ∑ ε, F ε = 0 := by linear_combination hsum
    simpa using this

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.sign_polarization
declarations.doc:
The sign polarization formula ({lit}`eq:signpolar`):
{lit}`2^n n! A(v₁,…,vₙ) = ∑_{ε ∈ {±1}^n} (∏ εⱼ) P(∑ εⱼ vⱼ)`.
declarations.signature:
theorem sign_polarization {A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n} (hA : IsSymm A) (v : Fin n → X) :
    ((2 : 𝕜) ^ n * n.factorial) • A v =
      ∑ ε : Fin n → Bool, (∏ j, (sgn (ε j) : 𝕜)) • diag A (∑ j, (sgn (ε j) : 𝕜) • v j)
declarations.source:
theorem sign_polarization {A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n} (hA : IsSymm A) (v : Fin n → X) :
    ((2 : 𝕜) ^ n * n.factorial) • A v =
      ∑ ε : Fin n → Bool, (∏ j, (sgn (ε j) : 𝕜)) • diag A (∑ j, (sgn (ε j) : 𝕜) • v j) := by
  classical
  simp_rw [diag_apply, map_diag_sum_smul, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp_rw [← Finset.sum_smul, sum_sign_inner, ite_smul, zero_smul]
  rw [sum_bijective_eq_sum_perm (fun g => ((2 : 𝕜) ^ n) • A (v ∘ g)), ← Finset.smul_sum,
    sum_perm_symm hA, smul_smul]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.opNorm_le_of_ball
declarations.doc: Passing from a bound on the unit ball to the operator norm.
declarations.signature:
lemma opNorm_le_of_ball {m : ℕ} (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y m) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (h : ∀ v : Fin m → X, (∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ 1) → ‖A v‖ ≤ C) : ‖A‖ ≤ C
declarations.source:
lemma opNorm_le_of_ball {m : ℕ} (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y m) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (h : ∀ v : Fin m → X, (∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ 1) → ‖A v‖ ≤ C) : ‖A‖ ≤ C := by
  refine ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound hC fun v => ?_
  by_cases hv : ∃ i, v i = 0
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hv
    rw [A.map_coord_zero i hi, norm_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg hC (Finset.prod_nonneg fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _)
  · push Not at hv
    have hpos : ∀ i, 0 < ‖v i‖ := fun i => norm_pos_iff.mpr (hv i)
    set w : Fin m → X := fun i => ((‖v i‖⁻¹ : ℝ) : 𝕜) • v i
    have hw : ∀ i, ‖w i‖ ≤ 1 := by
      intro i
      simp only [w, norm_smul, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_inv, abs_norm]
      rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ (hpos i).ne']
    have hvw : v = fun i => ((‖v i‖ : ℝ) : 𝕜) • w i := by
      ext i
      simp only [w, smul_smul, ← RCLike.ofReal_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (hpos i).ne',
        RCLike.ofReal_one, one_smul]
    have : A v = (∏ i, ((‖v i‖ : ℝ) : 𝕜)) • A w := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hvw]
      exact A.map_smul_univ _ _
    rw [this, norm_smul, norm_prod]
    simp only [RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_norm]
    rw [mul_comm]
    gcongr
    exact h w hw

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.opNorm_le_cPol_mul
declarations.doc: The polarization estimate ({lit}`eq:polarnorm`), upper half: {lit}`‖Ǎ‖ ≤ c_n ‖P‖`.
declarations.signature:
theorem opNorm_le_cPol_mul {A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n} (hA : IsSymm A) :
    ‖A‖ ≤ cPol n * polyNorm (diag A)
declarations.source:
theorem opNorm_le_cPol_mul {A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n} (hA : IsSymm A) :
    ‖A‖ ≤ cPol n * polyNorm (diag A) := by
  apply opNorm_le_of_ball A (mul_nonneg (cPol_nonneg n) (polyNorm_nonneg _))
  intro v hv
  have hfac : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ n * n.factorial := by positivity
  have key := sign_polarization hA v
  have hAv : A v = (((2 : 𝕜) ^ n * n.factorial))⁻¹ •
      ∑ ε : Fin n → Bool, (∏ j, (sgn (ε j) : 𝕜)) • diag A (∑ j, (sgn (ε j) : 𝕜) • v j) := by
    rw [← key, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (by exact_mod_cast hfac.ne'), one_smul]
  have hterm : ∀ ε : Fin n → Bool,
      ‖(∏ j, (sgn (ε j) : 𝕜)) • diag A (∑ j, (sgn (ε j) : 𝕜) • v j)‖ ≤
        polyNorm (diag A) * (n : ℝ) ^ n := by
    intro ε
    rw [norm_smul, norm_prod]
    simp only [norm_sgn, Finset.prod_const_one, one_mul]
    have hsum : ‖∑ j, (sgn (ε j) : 𝕜) • v j‖ ≤ n := by
      calc ‖∑ j, (sgn (ε j) : 𝕜) • v j‖ ≤ ∑ j, ‖(sgn (ε j) : 𝕜) • v j‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin n, (1 : ℝ) := by
            gcongr with j
            rw [norm_smul, norm_sgn, one_mul]; exact hv j
        _ = n := by simp
    exact (norm_diag_le A _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hsum n) (polyNorm_nonneg _))
  rw [hAv, norm_smul]
  calc ‖(((2 : 𝕜) ^ n * n.factorial))⁻¹‖ *
        ‖∑ ε : Fin n → Bool, (∏ j, (sgn (ε j) : 𝕜)) • diag A (∑ j, (sgn (ε j) : 𝕜) • v j)‖
      ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ n * n.factorial)⁻¹ * ∑ _ε : Fin n → Bool, polyNorm (diag A) * (n : ℝ) ^ n := by
        rw [norm_inv, norm_mul, norm_pow]
        simp only [RCLike.norm_ofNat, RCLike.norm_natCast]
        gcongr
        exact (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun ε _ => hterm ε)
    _ = cPol n * polyNorm (diag A) := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool,
          Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, cPol]
        push_cast
        field_simp

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.lipschitz_diag
declarations.doc:
The Lipschitz estimate ({lit}`eq:lipschitz`):
{lit}`‖P x - P y‖ ≤ n c_n ‖P‖ ‖x - y‖` for {lit}`x, y` in the unit ball.
declarations.signature:
theorem lipschitz_diag {A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n} (hA : IsSymm A) {x y : X} (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1)
    (hy : ‖y‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖diag A x - diag A y‖ ≤ n * cPol n * polyNorm (diag A) * ‖x - y‖
declarations.source:
theorem lipschitz_diag {A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n} (hA : IsSymm A) {x y : X} (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1)
    (hy : ‖y‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖diag A x - diag A y‖ ≤ n * cPol n * polyNorm (diag A) * ‖x - y‖ := by
  have h := A.norm_image_sub_le (fun _ => x) (fun _ => y)
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at h
  have hmax : max ‖(fun _ : Fin n => x)‖ ‖(fun _ : Fin n => y)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    apply max_le
    · exact (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg zero_le_one).mpr fun _ => hx
    · exact (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg zero_le_one).mpr fun _ => hy
  have hdiff : ‖(fun _ : Fin n => x) - (fun _ : Fin n => y)‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖ :=
    (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)).mpr fun _ => le_rfl
  simp only [diag_apply]
  calc ‖A (fun _ => x) - A (fun _ => y)‖
      ≤ ‖A‖ * n * max ‖(fun _ : Fin n => x)‖ ‖(fun _ : Fin n => y)‖ ^ (n - 1) *
          ‖(fun _ : Fin n => x) - (fun _ : Fin n => y)‖ := h
    _ ≤ (cPol n * polyNorm (diag A)) * n * 1 * ‖x - y‖ := by
        have h1 := opNorm_le_cPol_mul hA
        have h2 : max ‖(fun _ : Fin n => x)‖ ‖(fun _ : Fin n => y)‖ ^ (n - 1) ≤ 1 :=
          pow_le_one₀ (le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (le_max_left _ _)) hmax
        have h3 : 0 ≤ cPol n * polyNorm (diag A) :=
          mul_nonneg (cPol_nonneg n) (polyNorm_nonneg _)
        apply mul_le_mul _ hdiff (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        apply mul_le_mul _ h2 (by positivity) (by positivity)
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
    _ = n * cPol n * polyNorm (diag A) * ‖x - y‖ := by ring

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.substOp
declarations.doc: The substitution {lit}`S_{u,f}(t) x = (1-t) x + t f(x) u`.
declarations.signature: def substOp (f : StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : X) (t : ℝ) : X →L[𝕜] X
declarations.source:
def substOp (f : StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : X) (t : ℝ) : X →L[𝕜] X :=
  (((1 - t : ℝ) : 𝕜)) • ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 X + ((t : ℝ) : 𝕜) • f.smulRight u

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.substOp_apply
declarations.signature:
lemma substOp_apply (f : StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : X) (t : ℝ) (x : X) :
    substOp f u t x = ((1 - t : ℝ) : 𝕜) • x + ((t : ℝ) : 𝕜) • (f x • u)
declarations.source:
lemma substOp_apply (f : StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : X) (t : ℝ) (x : X) :
    substOp f u t x = ((1 - t : ℝ) : 𝕜) • x + ((t : ℝ) : 𝕜) • (f x • u) := by
  simp [substOp]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.substOp_zero
declarations.signature: @[simp] lemma substOp_zero (f : StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : X) (x : X) : substOp f u 0 x = x
declarations.source:
@[simp] lemma substOp_zero (f : StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : X) (x : X) : substOp f u 0 x = x := by
  simp [substOp_apply]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.substOp_one
declarations.signature: lemma substOp_one (f : StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : X) (x : X) : substOp f u 1 x = f x • u
declarations.source:
lemma substOp_one (f : StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : X) (x : X) : substOp f u 1 x = f x • u := by
  simp [substOp_apply]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.substOp_fix
declarations.signature:
lemma substOp_fix {f : StrongDual 𝕜 X} {u : X} (hfu : f u = 1) (t : ℝ) :
    substOp f u t u = u
declarations.source:
lemma substOp_fix {f : StrongDual 𝕜 X} {u : X} (hfu : f u = 1) (t : ℝ) :
    substOp f u t u = u := by
  rw [substOp_apply, hfu, one_smul, ← add_smul, ← RCLike.ofReal_add]
  simp

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.norm_substOp_le
declarations.signature:
lemma norm_substOp_le {f : StrongDual 𝕜 X} {u : X} (hf : ‖f‖ ≤ 1) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) {t : ℝ}
    (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) (x : X) : ‖substOp f u t x‖ ≤ ‖x‖
declarations.source:
lemma norm_substOp_le {f : StrongDual 𝕜 X} {u : X} (hf : ‖f‖ ≤ 1) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) {t : ℝ}
    (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) (x : X) : ‖substOp f u t x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
  rw [substOp_apply]
  calc ‖((1 - t : ℝ) : 𝕜) • x + ((t : ℝ) : 𝕜) • (f x • u)‖
      ≤ ‖((1 - t : ℝ) : 𝕜) • x‖ + ‖((t : ℝ) : 𝕜) • (f x • u)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = (1 - t) * ‖x‖ + t * (‖f x‖ * ‖u‖) := by
        rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, norm_smul, RCLike.norm_ofReal, RCLike.norm_ofReal,
          abs_of_nonneg (by linarith), abs_of_nonneg ht0]
    _ ≤ (1 - t) * ‖x‖ + t * ‖x‖ := by
        gcongr
        calc ‖f x‖ * ‖u‖ ≤ ‖f x‖ * 1 := by gcongr
          _ = ‖f x‖ := mul_one _
          _ ≤ ‖f‖ * ‖x‖ := f.le_opNorm x
          _ ≤ 1 * ‖x‖ := by gcongr
          _ = ‖x‖ := one_mul _
    _ = ‖x‖ := by ring

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.continuous_substOp_apply
declarations.signature:
lemma continuous_substOp_apply (f : StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : X) (x : X) :
    Continuous fun t : ℝ => substOp f u t x
declarations.source:
lemma continuous_substOp_apply (f : StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : X) (x : X) :
    Continuous fun t : ℝ => substOp f u t x := by
  simp only [substOp_apply]
  fun_prop

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.prod_ite_mem_const
declarations.signature:
lemma prod_ite_mem_const (s : Finset (Fin n)) (c d : 𝕜) :
    (∏ i, (if i ∈ s then c else d)) = c ^ s.card * d ^ (n - s.card)
declarations.source:
lemma prod_ite_mem_const (s : Finset (Fin n)) (c d : 𝕜) :
    (∏ i, (if i ∈ s then c else d)) = c ^ s.card * d ^ (n - s.card) := by
  rw [Finset.prod_ite, Finset.prod_const, Finset.prod_const]
  congr 2
  · congr 1; ext i; simp
  · rw [Finset.filter_not, Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _),
      Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    congr 2; ext i; simp

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.map_convex_expand
declarations.signature:
lemma map_convex_expand (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) (x w : X) (c d : 𝕜) :
    A (fun _ => c • x + d • w) =
      ∑ s : Finset (Fin n), (c ^ s.card * d ^ (n - s.card)) •
        A (s.piecewise (fun _ => x) (fun _ => w))
declarations.source:
lemma map_convex_expand (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) (x w : X) (c d : 𝕜) :
    A (fun _ => c • x + d • w) =
      ∑ s : Finset (Fin n), (c ^ s.card * d ^ (n - s.card)) •
        A (s.piecewise (fun _ => x) (fun _ => w)) := by
  classical
  have h1 : (fun _ : Fin n => c • x + d • w) = (fun _ => c • x) + (fun _ => d • w) := rfl
  rw [h1, A.map_add_univ]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => ?_
  have h2 : s.piecewise (fun _ : Fin n => c • x) (fun _ => d • w) =
      fun i => (if i ∈ s then c else d) • s.piecewise (fun _ : Fin n => x) (fun _ => w) i := by
    funext i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ s <;> simp [Finset.piecewise, hi]
  rw [h2, A.map_smul_univ, prod_ite_mem_const]

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.exists_poly_re
declarations.doc: {lit}`t ↦ Re A(S(t)y, …)` is a real polynomial of degree at most {lit}`n`.
declarations.signature:
lemma exists_poly_re (a : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 n) (f : StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u y : X) :
    ∃ p : Polynomial ℝ, p.natDegree ≤ n ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, p.eval t = RCLike.re (a (fun _ => substOp f u t y))
declarations.source:
lemma exists_poly_re (a : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 n) (f : StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u y : X) :
    ∃ p : Polynomial ℝ, p.natDegree ≤ n ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, p.eval t = RCLike.re (a (fun _ => substOp f u t y)) := by
  classical
  set cs : Finset (Fin n) → 𝕜 := fun s => a (s.piecewise (fun _ => y) (fun _ => f y • u))
  refine ⟨∑ s : Finset (Fin n), Polynomial.C (RCLike.re (cs s)) *
      ((1 - Polynomial.X) ^ s.card * Polynomial.X ^ (n - s.card)), ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le
    intro s _
    refine (Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans ?_
    refine (Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le).trans ?_
    have h1 : ((1 - Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℝ) ^ s.card).natDegree ≤ s.card := by
      refine (Polynomial.natDegree_pow_le).trans ?_
      have : (1 - Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℝ).natDegree ≤ 1 := by
        refine (Polynomial.natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans ?_
        simp
      calc s.card * (1 - Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℝ).natDegree ≤ s.card * 1 := by gcongr
        _ = s.card := mul_one _
    have h2 : ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℝ) ^ (n - s.card)).natDegree ≤ n - s.card := by
      simp
    have h3 : s.card ≤ n := by
      simpa using Finset.card_le_univ s
    omega
  · intro t
    have hexp : (fun _ : Fin n => substOp f u t y) =
        fun _ => ((1 - t : ℝ) : 𝕜) • y + ((t : ℝ) : 𝕜) • (f y • u) := by
      funext; rw [substOp_apply]
    rw [hexp, map_convex_expand]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_finsetSum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
      Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_one, Polynomial.eval_X,
      map_sum, smul_eq_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => ?_
    rw [← RCLike.ofReal_pow, ← RCLike.ofReal_pow, ← RCLike.ofReal_mul, RCLike.re_ofReal_mul]
    ring

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.Rop
declarations.doc:
The averaging operator {lit}`R_{u,f}` acting on symmetric forms: its diagonal is
{lit}`x ↦ ∫₀¹ P(S_{u,f}(t) x) dt` (see {lit}`diag_Rop`).
declarations.signature: def Rop (u : X) (f : StrongDual 𝕜 X) (a : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 n) : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 n

declarations.name: LindenstraussPolynomials.isSymm_Rop
declarations.signature: lemma isSymm_Rop (u : X) (f : StrongDual 𝕜 X) (a : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 n) : IsSymm (Rop u f a)
declarations.source:
lemma isSymm_Rop (u : X) (f : StrongDual 𝕜 X) (a : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 n) : IsSymm (Rop u f a) :=

declarations.source:
lemma continuous_diag_substOp (a : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 n) (f : StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u x : X) :
